title: Senior Application Security Engineer ID87004
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to strengthen secure coding and DevSecOps practices across engineering teams. This person deploys and tunes SAST, DAST, and IAST tools, conducts threat modeling, and integrates security controls into CI/CD pipelines. Comfort working across Python, JavaScript, or Java and cloud infrastructure such as AWS is essential.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Be a part of a bleeding-edge security organization that enables the agile development of secure and reliable applications and products.
- Deploy and tune code scanning solutions such as SAST, DAST, and IAST.
- Interpret code scanning results to ensure the team is focused on remediation of the highest-risk vulnerabilities.
- Perform threat modeling of applications to identify potential threat vectors in the technology stack that could be used by attackers and cause disruption or a potential data breach.
- Collaborate with technology stakeholders to establish metrics that demonstrate application security proficiency across all engineering teams.
- Steer the development of tools to improve the security of applications through automation and other means, allowing for faster and easier security gains by teams.
- Ensure processes associated with key systems are documented, maintained, and archived.

MUST HAVES
- You must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the US (e.g., Green card holders, TN visa holders, GC EAD, H4 EAD, U4U with EAD), as we are unable to sponsor or take over employment visa sponsorship at this time;
- Strong hands-on Application Security experience in a modern software-development environment of at least 4 years.
- Software engineering foundation with the ability to read, understand, and discuss code in Python, JavaScript, Java, or similar languages.
- Deep experience deploying, tuning, and interpreting SAST and DAST tools; IAST experience is a plus.
- Demonstrated experience conducting threat modeling and translating findings into practical security requirements.
- Experience integrating security testing and controls into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows.
- Working knowledge of AWS/cloud application security, APIs, authentication/authorization, secrets management, and common web-application vulnerabilities.
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or Salt.
- Ability to prioritize true security risk, reduce scanner noise, and drive timely remediation of meaningful vulnerabilities.
- Strong communication and influence skills: able to explain complex security issues clearly to engineers, engineering leaders, and nontechnical stakeholders.
- Collaborative, solutions-oriented approach; must be able to build trust with development teams and improve security without unnecessarily slowing product delivery.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Familiarity with security tools such as Nessus, Burp, and web application firewalls.
- Experience with Static/Dynamic Application Security Testing methodologies and tools.
- Experience with automation tools such as Terraform, Puppet, Chef, Salt, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
- Experience conducting a detailed threat model exercise.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how to assess them from a security perspective, including the integration of security tools with the pipeline.
- Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure and technologies, preferably AWS.
- A collaborator who will partner across the engineering organization to drive the establishment of a security posture.
- Results oriented and believes in steady continuous improvement.
- Curious and always goes beyond what is happening to discover why.
- An effective communicator with a solution-oriented mindset.
- A strategic thinker who focuses on integrating current initiatives and ideating on ways to improve while still meeting the needs of the business.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Senior Sales Solution Engineer
description:
Overview

Senior Sales Solution Engineer

📍 Location: Remote, USA 💻 Work Arrangement: Remote

About the Role

The Senior Sales Solution Engineer is responsible for providing technical and industry expertise to the sales team and customers throughout the pre-sales process. This role serves as the technical lead for complex customer engagements — applying deep solutions knowledge, industry insight, and best practices to design and deliver compelling solution strategies that drive customer confidence and accelerate deal momentum.

This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology and sales — bringing a consultative approach, a passion for problem-solving, and the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and persuasively to a wide range of audiences.

Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.

  • Act as the technical lead for complex customer engagements — applying extensive knowledge of solutions and industry verticals to lead pre-sales meetings, identify technical requirements, and formulate winning solution strategies.
  • Create and present demonstrations of proposed solutions to key customer stakeholders — applying solutions knowledge, experience, and best practice expertise to secure validation and buy-in from decision-makers.
  • Coordinate meetings with global services to transition key information — remaining actively involved in the process to ensure a seamless customer handoff and composing internal documentation that fully reflects all activity related to the solution strategy.

Role Essentials

What We'd Like to See

  • Experience composing detailed internal documentation and technical RFP responses — with strong attention to accuracy and the ability to fully capture all activity related to the solution strategy.
  • Experience presenting at trade shows, conferences, and industry events — serving as a knowledgeable and compelling representative of enterprise software solutions to key stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to mentor, coach, and provide feedback to team members — contributing to the overall growth and technical capabilities of a pre-sales or solution engineering team.
  • Experience collaborating with development and global services teams — supporting solution enhancements and ensuring seamless transitions throughout the customer engagement lifecycle.

title: Senior Sports Writer
description:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

THE ROLE

Sotheby’s is seeking an experienced Writer & Researcher to join its Sports team in New York. This full-time role will be responsible for researching, writing and fact-checking content across the department, with a particular focus on the information presented within Sports auction lots.

The successful candidate will be an exceptional writer and researcher who can identify what makes an object important and turn detailed research into engaging, accessible copy. A key part of the role will be shaping the story around each lot, understanding the moments, achievements and context that make the property interesting to collectors and communicating that clearly in Sotheby’s voice.

This person will also take a leading role in the Sports cataloguing process, setting standards for research, writing and review and helping ensure the department is producing the highest quality content for clients.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the Sports cataloguing process from a writing and research perspective, setting and maintaining clear standards for catalogue notes, sourcing, fact-checking, condition reporting and final review.
  • Research and write catalogue content for significant and high-value property, identifying the history, context and details that best communicate the importance and appeal of each lot.
  • Review catalogue content produced across the team, providing edits and guidance and ensuring work meets Sotheby’s standards for accuracy, clarity and quality before publication.
  • Develop and improve workflows for research, writing and quality control, giving the team a consistent structure for producing and reviewing catalogue content.
  • Conduct detailed research into players, teams, games, statistics, records, provenance and other relevant context using appropriate internal and external sources.
  • Write and proofread broader Sports content including sale and lot overview pages, editorial features, press materials, website content and social copy.
  • Inspect property and prepare condition reports, working with Specialists and relevant internal or external experts where needed.
  • Work closely with Specialists and colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Press, Social, Photography and other support departments to meet catalogue and publication deadlines.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIES

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in writing, research, editing, journalism, cataloguing or a related field.
  • Exceptional writing and research skills, with the ability to turn detailed information into engaging and concise copy.
  • Strong editorial judgment and an instinct for identifying the details that make a story or object compelling.
  • Experience setting or maintaining editorial, research or cataloguing standards and reviewing the work of others.
  • Strong editing skills and the ability to quickly adopt an established tone and style.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong fact-checking skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects and manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Strong knowledge of sports and sports history preferred.
  • Experience in sports media, journalism, publishing, editorial, research, sports memorabilia or collectibles preferred.
  • Auction house cataloguing or research experience helpful but not required.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

The proposed base salary for this position ranges from $70,000-$90,000. In addition to base salary successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus, as well as a competitive benefits package. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered.

title: IT Systems Engineer
description:
You own the identity, collaboration, and endpoint platforms every employee depends on: Active Directory and Entra ID, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, SSO for our SaaS stack, and device management across Windows and macOS. You script the repetitive work and document what you build.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer Active Directory and Entra ID: user lifecycle, groups, GPO, DNS, Entra Connect and hybrid sync health, Conditional Access, privileged-role and stale-account hygiene
  • Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Teams, licensing) and Google Workspace (org units, groups, Drive governance, Entra-federated auth, multi-domain coexistence)

  • Endpoint management: Intune for Windows and Jamf for macOS, covering enrollment, compliance policy, patching, app deployment, and configuration baselines, in partnership with the desktop support team

  • Use scripting to make IT operations faster and more consistent: PowerShell and Graph for bulk user and license changes, group cleanup, reporting on stale accounts and device compliance, and Intune/Jamf deployment scripts. Look for the repetitive manual task and script it away
  • Own certificate renewals, service accounts, and backup verification for identity and SaaS data
  • Hands-on presence for the KC HQ: server room and network closet work, hardware receiving and staging, and onsite backup for AV and conference systems when the desktop team needs it
  • Maintain runbooks in the IT Confluence space
  • Tier 2 escalation for identity, licensing, collaboration, and endpoint tickets

Qualities:

  • 4+ years in a Windows/Entra environment of 500+ users: AD (GPO, DNS, replication troubleshooting), Entra Connect, Conditional Access
  • Hands-on Intune and Jamf administration
  • 2+ years administering Google Workspace, ideally alongside M365
  • Comfortable in PowerShell: you write your own scripts for day-to-day admin work (bulk changes, reporting, Intune remediations) and can read and adapt Graph API calls
  • SSO configuration and troubleshooting (Entra enterprise apps)
  • Networking literacy (DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN)
  • Documents without being asked
  • Plus: Jira/Confluence administration, Mimecast, agency or professional-services background

title: Program Controller
description:
Start Date: Immediate

JHNA, CTSi, and EXPANSIA have come together to form a Defense Technology platform named Aether Aerospace focused on delivering high-impact technologies, technology-enabled services and advanced manufacturing solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense and related national security customers. Backed by Falfurrias Management Partners, the platform brings together deep domain expertise across Army, Navy, and Air Force and Space Force programs, digital engineering, systems integration, and specialized manufacturing capabilities.

OVERVIEW

Full-time/Permanent Employee

Location: Remote

As a Program Controller, you will be responsible for conducting financial research and analysis to support programmatic financial execution and contract compliance across assigned programs. You will analyze project budgets, monitor the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system (JAMIS/Costpoint), and track cost, funding, and labor data to ensure alignment with contractual and project requirements across FFP, T&M, and Cost Plus contract types.

In this role, you will build a broad skill set in financial management, program-level financial reporting, and knowledge management. title: Senior Science Writer/Editor - BBE
description:
Overview

Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. Based in Seattle, Fred Hutch is the only National Cancer Institute-designated cancer center in Washington.

With a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, HIV/AIDS prevention, immunotherapy and COVID-19 vaccines, Fred Hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. Fred Hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. Together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality.

At Fred Hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. Our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. Our commitment to learning across our differences and similarities make us stronger. We seek employees who bring different and innovative ways of seeing the world and solving problems.

The Biostatistics, Bioinformatics and Epidemiology (BBE) Program within the Vaccine and Infectious Disease Division (VIDD) is home to world-renowned quantitative scientists advancing research at the intersection of quantitative science, infectious diseases, immunology, and global health.

Our 40-plus faculty lead cutting-edge work in biostatistics, computational biology, mathematical modeling, clinical trials, genomic epidemiology and public health science. In collaboration with researchers within VIDD and across global research communities, our program plays a central role in clinical trials of novel therapeutics and preventive interventions; develops rigorous statistical and computational methods; extracts insights from complex immunological and virological data; and builds mathematical models to project the population-level impact of interventions or predict immune responses and viral evolution. Through both methodological innovation and collaborative science, we advance VIDD’s mission to accelerate vaccine and infectious disease research globally.

The Senior Science Writer/Editor provides support to the HIV Vaccine Trials Network (HVTN) and several other projects in BBE by managing the planning, writing, editing, and production of a variety of scientific and technical documents. This unique role is responsible for producing, editing, and finalizing highly specialized scientific and technical materials for publication, including scientific manuscripts, grant applications, regulatory documents, presentations, etc. The position also conducts scientific literature reviews, generates scientific illustrations, and assists project teams in navigating the document development process, and ensures that all materials meet established guidelines and standards of quality and content. The incumbent also works closely with other Fred Hutch departments such as Communications and Marketing, Shared Resources, and other Center/Consortium faculty and staff to ensure quality and productivity in producing written materials, web content, and other documents/communications. The Senior Science Writer/Editor reports to one of the Principal Investigators (PIs) of the HVTN.

Most Fred Hutch jobs require some on-campus work. However, there may be flexibility for certain positions. Please check with the recruiter if you are an out-of-state applicant interested only in working outside of the Seattle area.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare outlines for scientific manuscripts including drafting materials and methods sections in coordination with other authors and scientific staff involved in the study or trial.
  • Produce high-quality figures, tables, and graphics for publications, progress reports, grant applications, presentations, and other program-level and study-specific documents.
  • Copyedit and proofread scientific manuscripts and coordinate journal submission.
  • Gain concurrence of authors on edited materials; make further revisions as required.
  • Manage correspondence with journals related to pending manuscripts through submission and publication.
  • Ensure adherence to publication compliance rules (e.g. NIH public access policy).
  • Develop, review, and edit grant applications and grant-related documents such as annual progress reports (including human subjects and clinical trials documents), in partnership with faculty and study staff.
  • Conduct specialized reviews of scientific literature to support grant proposals, scientific manuscripts, clinical protocols, and regulatory filings. Review professional journals and scientific literature to stay abreast of new requirements in technical writing field.
  • Lead revisions to highly technical documents including grant proposals, manuscripts, book chapters, articles, reports, and presentations.
  • Analyze, interpret, and distill information, and collaborate with faculty and staff to ensure creation of clear, factual, and appropriately concise documents.
  • Translate complex scientific information to communicate research activities and results to lay audiences through program and lab websites, brochures, and other documents.
  • Draft, edit, and conduct study-specific correspondence with funding and regulatory agencies and collaborators, as needed.
  • Consult with project teams throughout the document development process as needed, including developing project timelines and ensuring that the content and format of all documents adhere to relevant guidelines and standards, are internally consistent, and are complete.
  • Create and maintain reference libraries to support accurate and rigorous citation practices within scientific and technical documents.
  • Review professional journals and books to stay abreast of new requirements in technical writing field.
  • Provide and lead other writing and editing support as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Doctoral degree (PhD) in mathematics, computer science, biostatistics, statistics, epidemiology, immunology, or related field.
  • 8-10 years’ experience in grant proposal development, scientific writing, or journalism.
  • Ability to define complex scientific concepts and words, and to prioritize and work with multiple projects at one time.
  • Strong demonstrated technical writing and editing skills.
  • Extensive familiarity with scientific and medical terminology, as well as scientific research methods.
  • Experience with grant preparation, writing/editing scientific manuscripts, drafting of medical protocols, and preparation of documents in support of regulatory filings.
  • Expertise in Word, Endnote, Adobe Acrobat, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Proficient in development of high-quality scientific graphics (Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop or equivalent).
  • Skilled at conducting scientific literature reviews and distilling results into concise summaries of relevant information.
  • Ability for quantitative analysis along with a basic understanding of statistics.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills and experience working collaboratively with a diverse team across several disciplines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity with U.S. government regulatory environment including grant funding policies and rules.

The annual base salary range for this position is from $104,458 to $165,090, and pay offered will be based on experience and qualifications.Although Fred Hutch is not sponsoring most H-1B visas at this time, candidates who already hold an H-1B sponsored by another organization and are currently in the U.S. may be eligible for this position.Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center offers employees a comprehensive benefits package designed to enhance health, well-being, and financial security. Benefits include medical/vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, life, disability, retirement, family life support, employee assistance program, onsite health clinic, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation (12-22 days per year), paid sick leave (12-25 days per year), paid holidays (13 days per year), and paid parental leave (up to 4 weeks).

Additional Information

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and Vietnam Era Veterans Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability (physical or mental), marital or veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, political ideology, or membership in any other legally protected class. We desire priority referrals of protected veterans. If due to a disability you need assistance/and or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process, please send a request to Human Resources at hrops@fredhutch.org or by calling 206-667-4700.

title: Senior Security Analyst
description:
Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com

Senior Security Analyst - Managed Detection and Response

Our mission at Bitdefender is to reduce risk to customers’ business to allow them to achieve their objectives. We are focused on delivering real security value for an affordable price – no snake oil. To help in this mission, we are looking for a Senior Security Analyst. You will work in a tight knit, experienced team backed up by an international organization that’s been in business for 18 years.

About Us

The Managed Detection & Response service is a new line of business (think division, business unit, etc). We are an experienced team having built successful Managed Security offerings in the past and staffed by a multitude of cybersecurity organizations and veteran cyber-warfare operators from the military and intelligence services. We all got into this business to provide security services that make customers safer. We must make some money to do that, but our primary goal is to provide services that secure, not just ones that sell.

Our team has been around the block together and operate in a 24x7 environment where we manage emergency situations for customers. For this to work, we must trust each other. As a leadership team, we focus on building that trust through accountability, processes and personal relationships. We have plenty of experienced team members with and without families and understand that not all teams can be built outside of work, but we focus on teamwork to build authentic and meaningful engagement.


About the Role

  • This is a full-time position in a 24/7 operation with a four 10-hour shifting schedule. Scheduled rotations for weekend shifts will be required

  • Serve as an escalation point for security events from multiple sources

  • Using the Cyber Kill Chain, indicators of activity and indicators of compromise with current intelligence information to proactively review customers environments searching for anomalous behavior across network, host and logs data

  • Lead an Incident Response Team to investigate and remediate active threats while accurately documenting results using standard incident response techniques

  • Develop analytic signatures to identify suspicious and malicious behaviors

About you:

Be able to demonstrate working knowledge and understanding of the following:

  • Cybersecurity principles
  • Cyber threats and vulnerabilities
  • Current incident response methodologies
  • Current cyber investigative techniques
  • Current cyber threat trends
  • Computer networking concepts and protocols, and network security methodologies
  • Knowledge of basic physical computer components and architectures, including the functions of various components and peripherals (e.g., CPUs, NICs, HDDs)
  • Perform analysis of log files from a variety of sources (e.g., individual host logs, network traffic logs, firewall logs, and intrusion detection system [IDS] logs) to identify possible threats to network security
  • Basic system administration, network, and operating system hardening techniques
  • Identifying, modifying, and manipulating applicable system components within Windows, Unix, or Linux (e.g., passwords, user accounts, files)
  • Conduct research, analysis, and correlation across a wide variety of all source data sets (indications and warnings)
  • Defense-in-depth principles and practices (e.g., defense-in-multiple places, layered defenses, security robustness)
  • Virtualization and cloud computing
  • Knowledge of which system files (e.g., log files, registry files, configuration files) contain relevant information and where to find those system files
  • Hacking methodologies
  • Networking protocols (e.g., TCP/IP), services (e.g., web, mail, DNS), and how they interact to provide network communications
  • Knowledge of encryption algorithms (e.g., Internet Protocol Security [IPSEC], Advanced Encryption Standard [AES], Generic Routing Encapsulation [GRE], Internet Key Exchange [IKE], Message Digest Algorithm [MD5], Secure Hash Algorithm [SHA]) and how they are used
  • How to perform packet-level analysis using appropriate tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump)
  • Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools - Searching, aggregating, and correlating data
  • Web Application Firewall (WAF)
  • Regular Expressions (Regex)

title: Patient Services Representative

Preferred:

This position is an onsite position at our South Lake Union location.

About Waythrough

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.

Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.

As a Healthcare Assistant, you will support the clinical team in delivering high-quality respiratory healthcare and wellbeing interventions to service users. Working within a multidisciplinary environment, you will provide practical clinical support to individuals with respiratory conditions, support smoking cessation initiatives, undertake healthcare assessments, and contribute to improving health outcomes across the community.

You will play an important role in delivering safe, person-centred care, supporting clinics and health programmes, promoting healthier lifestyles, and ensuring high standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and infection control.

Key Duties

  • Support service user assessments, care plans, and clinical reviews.

  • Undertake clinical procedures within your level of training and competency, including phlebotomy, ECGs, health observations, vaccinations, and respiratory assessments.

  • Support the delivery of respiratory care services, including services for individuals living with long-term respiratory conditions.

  • Assist with smoking cessation programmes, providing practical support and encouragement to service users seeking to quit smoking.

  • Conduct healthcare assessments and contribute to health improvement plans.

  • Support health promotion initiatives aimed at improving respiratory health and overall wellbeing.

  • Monitor and support individuals receiving community-based health interventions, including alcohol detoxification and recovery programmes where required.

  • Deliver health education and harm reduction advice.

  • Maintain accurate clinical records and service user information in line with organisational policies.

  • Maintain clean, safe clinical environments and adhere to infection prevention and control standards.

  • Work collaboratively with clinicians and wider healthcare professionals to ensure the delivery of effective care.

About You

You are a caring, compassionate, and proactive individual with a genuine desire to improve people's health and wellbeing. You are confident supporting clinical activities within a community healthcare setting and enjoy working as part of a multidisciplinary team.

You will ideally have:

  • Experience working as a Healthcare Assistant within a healthcare setting.

  • Experience in Respiratory Care and/or Smoking Cessation services.

  • Experience working within a clinic, community healthcare service, or GP surgery environment.

  • Phlebotomy and ECG experience, or a willingness to undertake training.

  • Experience supporting individuals with alcohol-related health needs, including exposure to alcohol cessation programmes and community alcohol detoxification support.

  • NVQ Level 2 in Health & Social Care (or equivalent).

  • Maths and English qualifications.

  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.

  • Knowledge of infection prevention and control principles.

  • Understanding of confidentiality, safeguarding, and data protection requirements.

  • Strong communication, organisational, and record-keeping skills.

  • The ability to carry out delegated clinical procedures following training and competency assessment.

What We Offer

We value the people who make a difference every day. Alongside meaningful work, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package:

  • 27 days’ annual leave, rising to 32 after 1 year (plus bank holidays)

  • Pension scheme with 4.5% employer contribution, matched up to 6.5%

title: Behavior Intervention Specialist L1 - Part Time (CLS)
description:
Overview

Provides comprehensive behavioral health and clinical support services to individuals by conducting assessments, developing and implementing individualized support plans, and delivering evidence-based interventions to maximize the intellectual, social, and emotional development and functioning of people supported under the supervision of Assistant Director of Psychology Services and Ph.D. licensed psychologist.

This position embraces diversity in all its forms and strives to create an inclusive, welcoming environment where every individual feels valued. They demonstrate cultural awareness and actively support a culture of equity and inclusion.

Responsibilities

  • Provide individual, collateral, group, on-site, and off-site clinical interventions in accordance with established support plans.
  • Conduct diagnostic and behavioral assessments, including evaluations of adaptive behavior, emotional functioning, mental status, preference assessments, and Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs).
  • Develop, implement, and monitor behavior support plans, monitoring plans, and dementia guidelines, ensuring appropriate follow-up, documentation, and plan implementation.
  • Monitor individual progress, review and analyze data, prepare summaries for providers as requested, and modify support plans when indicated.
  • Provide crisis intervention and follow-up assessments to address immediate behavioral and clinical needs.
  • Deliver staff training and education on Positive Behavior Supports, also supports the effective implementation of created behavior support plans.
  • Participate in required professional development and agency training, including Positive Behavior Supports (PBS), Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs), Person-Centered Outcome Measures (POM), Council on Quality and Leadership (CQL) standards, and other required agency trainings.
  • Maintain clinical records and documentation, complete required reviews, and participate in regular supervision with a Licensed Psychologist and/or Assistant Director/Clinical Supervisor.
  • Collaborate and communicate with interdisciplinary teams, including participation in case conferences, meetings, and consultations to support coordinated service delivery.
  • Promote and monitor workplace safety compliance, reporting unsafe conditions or practices to appropriate leadership, and perform all other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Note: This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. Responsibilities and tasks may evolve or change at the discretion of the organization.

Qualifications

title: Production Technician
description:
Overview

Eastern Additive Solutions is a new production 3D printing factory in Hopewell Junction. We run industrial HP Multi Jet Fusion equipment and make end-use plastic parts for medical, robotics, and industrial customers. Most of our current work is orthotics and prosthetics, which means the parts we make are worn by real people who are counting on them to fit and last.

We are a small team in a new facility. You would be our first production technician, working directly alongside the people who run the company

Pay

$22 to $28 per hour to start, depending on relevant experience, with defined step increases tied to station qualifications and quality reviewer certification. Standard benefits once eligible. We state the range up front on purpose. You should not have to discover it in a third interview.

Schedule

Monday through Friday, day shift, on-site at 20 Corporate Park, Hopewell Junction. Early on, the whole team works the same hours while we build out our processes together. As production grows, this role may move to a shifted schedule to extend floor coverage, and we will plan that together in advance.

Responsibilities

Who we are looking for

We would rather train the right person than hire someone who already knows how to do this. Almost nobody has run this equipment before, so we are not looking for a resume full of 3D printing. We are looking for someone who is good with their hands, careful by nature, and reliable, and who wants to learn a trade that very few people in this country actually have.

If you have worked with tools, run equipment, built things, fixed things, or done any work where doing it right mattered more than doing it fast, we want to hear from you. We will teach you the rest, station by station, from the ground up.

What you will do

• Post-process printed parts: remove powder from finished parts, including detailed hand work on complicated shapes, and run automated and manual blast equipment

• Tend industrial 3D printing equipment: load material, swap build units, unpack finished builds, and keep the machines clean and ready

• Support finishing operations, including vapor smoothing and dyeing

• Pack, label, and stage orders for shipment, keeping every part identified and traceable

• Support quality inspection: stage parts for measurement and photo documentation

• Keep the production floor in order: powder containment, station upkeep, and maintaining the separation between clean and dirty work zones. In a powder factory, cleaning is process control, not a chore.

• Help write our work instructions. As you learn each station, you will draft the procedure for it and our engineer will correct and approve it. You learn the process by documenting it.

• General floor support: material moves, setups, receiving, and whatever the day needs

How you will work

Everything here runs on written procedures and documented sign-offs. You will train one station at a time, and you will not be asked to run anything on your own until you have been trained and cleared on it. Nobody at EAS, at any level, signs off on their own work. Your job will be to follow the procedure exactly and to speak up when the procedure does not match what you are seeing on the floor. Both halves matter equally, and the second one matters more than new people usually expect.

Qualifications

What we need from you

• Mechanical aptitude and comfort with hands-on, physical work

• Ability to follow written procedures exactly, and to flag it when something does not look right

• Attention to detail, particularly with part identity, labeling, and keeping track of what is what

• Comfortable working in a powder environment with full PPE, including a respirator

• Able to lift 40 lbs and be on your feet for most of the shift

• Reliable attendance. Being here when you said you would be is the whole point of the role.

Backgrounds that tend to work well here

Carpentry, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, auto repair, machine shop, welding, landscaping, food production, kitchen work, warehouse, military, or any trade where you used tools and were responsible for the result. Formal manufacturing experience is welcome but not required, and neither is a degree.

Where this role goes

Pay increases are tied to what you can do, not how long you have been here. As you qualify on each station, your rate steps up. After full qualification there is a defined path to train as a quality reviewer, checking and confirming work done by others before it ships, and that certification carries its own pay step.

As the first technician here, you would be learning the whole process as we build it, which is not something you get at a larger shop.

Company Website

https://www.easternadditivesolutions.com/

title: Cybersecurity Engineer / Cybersecurity Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Army Tactical System
description:
Position Summary

The Cybersecurity Engineer / SME will support cybersecurity activities for an Army tactical system, with emphasis on Risk Management Framework (RMF), Army cybersecurity compliance, vulnerability management, DISA STIG reviews, cyber scan analysis, and authorization support. This position requires a hands-on cybersecurity professional with strong Army and DoD RMF experience and technical expertise reviewing DIDA STIGs, cybersecurity scans, vulnerability assessments, and authorization artifacts. The ideal candidate will be capable of independently analyzing technical findings, maintaining compliance evidence, supporting eMASS activities, coordinating with stakeholders, and adapting to evolving Army and DoD cybersecurity requirements.

Onsite: Ft. Belvoir

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and support Army RMF activities for system authorization, cybersecurity compliance and continuous monitoring efforts.
  • Review, analyze, and maintain DISA STIG compliance artifacts, including STIG Viewer checklists (.CKL files), supporting evidence, and remediation status.
  • Execute, review, and interpret cybersecurity scans, including SCAP Compliance Checker, ACAS, vulnerability scans, and related assessment results.
  • Correlate DISA STIG findings, scan results, vulnerability data, and security assessment findings to identify compliance gaps, assess risk, and establish remediation priorities.
  • Develop, review, and maintain cybersecurity documentation, including System Security Plans (SSP), Cybersecurity Strategies, POA&Ms, risk assessments, mitigation plans, and RMF authorization artifacts.
  • Maintain cybersecurity records and authorization package data within eMASS in support of IATT, ATO, Assess Only and Continuous Monitoring requirements.
  • Coordinate with Government stakeholders, Authorizing Officials (AO), Security Control Assessors (SCA), system engineers, software developers, cloud teams, vendors, and assessors to resolve cybersecurity findings and drive remediation efforts to closure.
  • Review Vendor’s cybersecurity deliverables for technical adequacy, compliance, and alignment with Army and DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Support cybersecurity test events, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, security reviews, and authorization readiness activities.
  • Evaluate cybersecurity risks and provide recommendations to program leadership regarding compliance posture, remediation status, risk acceptance, and authorization impacts.
  • Support implementation of new Army and DoD cybersecurity policies, guidance, and requirements and assess impacts to the program.
  • Serve as a cybersecurity advisor to program leadership and technical teams on RMF, vulnerability management, compliance, and risk management activities.

Requirements

  • Active Secret Clearance required to start
  • Security+ CE or higher DoD 8140/8570 compliant certification.
  • Strong experience with RMF activities for Army or DoD systems and supporting tactical systems through IATT, ATO, and Continuous Monitoring activities.
  • Solid knowledge of AR 25-2, DoD RMF, NIST 800-53 security controls, and Army cybersecurity requirements.
  • Hands-on experience reviewing DISA STIGs, STIG Viewer checklists, CKL files, and cybersecurity compliance evidence. Identify compliance gaps and remediation priorities.
  • Experience developing and maintaining POA&Ms, remediation plans, risk assessments, mitigation plans, and RMF authorization artifacts.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and effectively coordinate with Government personnel, assessors, engineers, software developers, cloud teams, and vendors.

Special Note

Education requirement:

  • BS Electrical Engineering and > 5 years of experience (LEVEL II)

or

  • MS Electrical Engineering or Equivalent and > 15 years of experience (LEVEL III)

Clearance Requirement

  • Active Secret Clearance

Benefits and Compensation

At MAG Aerospace, we value your contributions providing our employees with a robust Total Rewards package that supports your total well-being. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in MAG's Total Rewards programs. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits as well as paid leave, professional development, and tuition assistance. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our Total Rewards Program by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site: https://www.magaero.com/benefits/. Salary at MAG Aerospace is determined by various factors including but not limited to location, the particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $100,000 to $165,000 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of MAG's total compensation package for employees.

title: Fresh Foods Clerk

About Us

EEO/Inclusivity

description:
Property Description

Overview

This is a limited-duration role, available October 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027.

The Income Auditor safeguards the accuracy and integrity of the hotel's daily revenue. This role reviews financial activity from all operating departments, reconciles revenue and payment records across hotel systems, identifies and resolves discrepancies, and produces timely reports for leadership. The position works closely with Finance, Front Office, Food & Beverage, Reservations, Sales, and other departments to support sound internal controls and accurate financial reporting.

About Our Property

The Higgins Hotel & Conference Center’s name reflects the contributions of the extraordinary entrepreneur, Andrew Higgins, who designed and built over 20,000 boats in New Orleans that were used in every major amphibious assault of World War II.

Conveniently located directly across the street from The National WWII Museum, the hotel offers 230 era-inspired guest rooms and specialty suites, premium amenities, full-service restaurant, lounge, and a rooftop bar, as well as a second-floor conference center with more than 18,000 square feet of meeting and event space.

Higgins Hotel proudly welcomes veterans and individuals with disabilities. We value diverse experiences and are committed to an inclusive workplace.

Responsibilities

  • Audit daily hotel revenue and transactions for multiple departments
  • Reconcile the property-management system (PMS), point-of-sale (POS) system, credit card settlements, cash activity, direct billing, deposits, and supporting reports
  • Verify room revenue, occupancy, average daily rate, packages, taxes, service charges, gratuities, discounts, complimentary transactions, paid-outs, allowances, rebates, refunds, voids, and adjustments
  • Review night-audit reports and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, appropriate authorization, and compliance with established procedures
  • Research out-of-balance items and unusual transactions; communicate discrepancies promptly and follow through until they are resolved and documented.
  • Maintain organized electronic and paper audit records in accordance with hotel, management-company, brand, legal, and record-retention requirements

  • Prepare and distribute the daily revenue report, exception reports, and other scheduled financial reports accurately and on time
  • Verify cash deposits and deposit documentation; promptly report missing, late, or inconsistent deposits
  • Assist with month-end close, including reconciliations, schedules, accrual support, inventory verification, and audit documentation
  • Assist with internal and external audit requests and correcting control or documentation deficiencies
  • Partner professionally with department leaders to clarify transactions, correct posting practices, and strengthen financial controls
  • Attend required meetings and training and maintain current knowledge of hotel systems, policies, brand standards, and accounting procedures
  • Provide backup support within the Finance department and perform other related duties as assigned, consistent with the purpose of the position

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • At least five years of hotel accounting, income-audit, or closely related experience; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered
  • Prior income-audit experience in a full-service hotel
  • Strong numerical accuracy, analytical ability, organization, and attention to detail
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, email, and standard office technology
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, meet deadlines, and manage multiple priorities with limited supervision
  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with team members and management
  • Ability to read, write, and understand English sufficiently to review records, follow procedures, and prepare business communications

Preferred

  • Associate degree or coursework in accounting, finance, business, or hospitality management
  • Experience with hotel PMS, POS, accounting, credit-card settlement, and document-management systems; Hilton-branded hotel experience is a plus
  • Intermediate Excel skills, including formulas, filters, sorting, lookups, and reconciliation of large data sets

Davidson Hospitality Group is an award-winning, full-service hospitality management company overseeing hotels, restaurants, dining and entertainment venues across the US. A trusted partner and preferred operator for Hilton, Hyatt, Kimpton, Marriott, and Margaritaville, Davidson offers a unique entrepreneurial management style and owners’ mentality that provides the individualized personal service of a small company, enhanced by the breadth and depth of skill and experience of a larger company. In keeping with the company’s heritage of delivering value, Davidson is comprised of four highly specialized operating verticals: Davidson Hotels, Pivot, Davidson Resorts and Davidson Restaurant Group.

title: RF Phased Array Engineer II
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

RF PHASED ARRAY ENGINEER II

Based at Rocket Lab's global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the RF Phased Array Engineer is responsible for the development of new RF products and systems (including Rocket Lab’s phased arrays) and assessment of COTS components. The RF Phased Array Engineer will model and simulate antenna performance for current programs and proposals. The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of antennas at the component and system level and will thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

Product Development

  • Support end to end efforts including architecture design, prototyping, integration, test, and flight development – Ensure key design decisions and developments are in alignment with product / system needs
  • Model and simulate array performance
  • Work alongside an interdisciplinary team of RF, digital, power, mechanical, thermal, and structural engineers
  • Support transition developments from new product introduction to production
  • Interface with vendors and customers
  • Develop test plans and procedures for testing active antennas – included EIRP & G/T
  • Design and development of GSE and production automation

title: Sr. Integration Engineer
description:
SmarterDx is transforming how health systems use clinical AI to capture the full value of patient care delivered. Built by physician-data scientists and trained on clinically-validated EHR data, our clinical AI platform interprets the nuances behind every patient story and makes clinically-sound recommendations for revenue cycle teams — helping hospitals recover earned revenue, improve quality metrics, reduce denials, and streamline revenue cycle operations. As a Smartian, you’ll help build technology that makes healthcare more accurate, sustainable, and effective for everyone. Learn more at .

Sr. Integration Engineer

You are a healthcare integration engineer with deep expertise in interface engine development and HL7. You are equally comfortable developing complex interfaces, managing integration platforms and their cloud-hosted environments, and supporting mission-critical production integrations. You understand how to diagnose issues across interface engines, HL7, applications, network connectivity, and infrastructure, and bring the hands-on expertise needed to own problems through resolution.

You will be a technical owner of SmarterDx’s healthcare integration platform, with a primary focus on interface development, platform operations, production support, and technical best practices. Our platform processes a high volume of healthcare data across customer connections, making reliability and availability critical. You will help establish the standards, processes, and documentation that keep our integrations reliable and maintainable as we grow.

While this is primarily a hands-on technical role, you will also work directly with customer technical teams when needed to support implementations, connectivity, troubleshooting, and other integration needs.

At SmarterDx, your work will directly enable our mission of empowering hospitals to tell the most accurate patient stories.

***This role is fully remote within the US***

What You’ll Do

  1. Design, develop, test, deploy, and support healthcare integrations throughout their lifecycle, including routes, communication endpoints, filters, message transformations, mappings, and connectivity, primarily using HL7v2 across major EHR platforms including Epic and Oracle Health/Cerner.
  2. Serve as a technical owner and subject matter expert for SmarterDx’s integration platform, including configuration, administration, monitoring, upgrades, and production operations.
  3. Partner with Infrastructure and Security teams to operate our integration platform in a cloud-hosted environment, including AWS, VPN connectivity, networking, TLS/certificate management, HTTPS endpoints, and secure customer connectivity.
  4. Maintain the reliability and availability of our high-volume integration environment through proactive monitoring, safe change practices, and capacity and performance planning as message volumes and customer connections grow.
  5. Define and implement integration development and operational best practices, including reusable components, configuration standards, testing, change review, environment promotion and deployment, technical documentation, and documented operational processes.
  6. Serve as a senior technical escalation point for production issues, leading troubleshooting, root cause analysis, message recovery/reprocessing when needed, and durable remediation across the integration platform, HL7, connectivity, infrastructure, applications, and external systems.
  7. Participate in an after-hours on-call / Tier 3 support rotation for high-priority integration and platform incidents, with a focus on rapid recovery and minimizing customer impact.
  8. Serve as a technical point of contact for integration platform support cases, platform questions, upgrades, capacity planning, and technical escalations.
  9. Collaborate effectively within Integration Engineering and across Infrastructure, Security, Product, and other teams to solve technical problems and improve integration practices, while working directly with customer technical teams as needed during implementations, connectivity setup, and production support.

What You Bring

  1. 4+ years of healthcare integration experience, including building, deploying, and supporting hospital-based HL7v2 interfaces at scale.
  2. Deep, hands-on expertise building integrations from scratch within enterprise healthcare interface engines, including routes, communication endpoints, filters and connectors, transformations, mappings, reusable components, administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  3. Experience owning or administering an interface engine in a production environment, including configuration, monitoring, deployment, message recovery, troubleshooting, and operational support.
  4. Expert-level HL7v2 knowledge, including message structure, common message types and trigger events, acknowledgements, transformations, sequencing, and error handling.
  5. Strong JavaScript experience for message transformation and workflow logic; familiarity with Python or other scripting languages is a plus.
  6. Working SQL proficiency for validation, troubleshooting, and operational analysis.
  7. Experience supporting high-volume, mission-critical integration platforms in AWS or similar cloud-hosted environments, where reliable message delivery and availability are essential.
  8. Strong understanding of TCP/IP, MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS certificates, DNS, firewalls, VPNs, and secure connectivity.
  9. Strong production support and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate and resolve failures across interface engines, HL7, applications, network connectivity, infrastructure, and external dependencies.
  10. Ability to operate autonomously while working collaboratively within and across teams, taking ownership of complex technical problems and helping improve engineering standards, processes, and documentation.

Nice To Haves

  1. Experience operating enterprise healthcare interface engines in a SaaS or hosted deployment model and working directly with platform vendors or support teams.
  2. Certifications or formal training in healthcare integration platforms or interface engines.
  3. Deep knowledge of hospital workflows, clinical data structures, EHR integration patterns, and revenue cycle data flows.
  4. Experience with SFTP, flat files, X12, REST APIs, SOAP web services, and database connectivity.
  5. Experience with FHIR and multiple healthcare interface engines such as Mirth Connect, Cloverleaf, Corepoint, InterSystems, or similar platforms.
  6. Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, configuration management, and repeatable environment promotion for integration platforms.
  7. Experience with capacity planning and performance tuning of high-throughput integration environments.
  8. Entrepreneurial mindset, with a builder’s mentality and strong sense of ownership.

Our Tech Stack

  • Rhapsody, AWS, Snowflake, JIRA, HL7Spy

Compensation

  • $185k-$215K base + bonus potential

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision – Comprehensive plans with leading insurance providers, covering 75% of your premiums, depending on the plan.
  • Paid Parental Leave – Generous paid leave to support families through birth or adoption: Up to 12 weeks for parents.
  • Remote-First Team – Work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Unlimited PTO & 11 Holidays – So you can relax and recharge.
  • 401(k) with Traditional & Roth Options – Tax-advantaged retirement savings through Fidelity with a 4% match.
  • Minimal Bureaucracy – A fast-moving, high-impact environment where you can focus on what matters.
  • Incredible Teammates! – Work alongside smart, supportive, and mission-driven colleagues.

At Coastal Horizons, our mission is to provide a continuum of professional services to promote healthier lives, stronger families, and safer communities. LOCATION: Rocky Point, NC-Pender County

REQUIRED EDUCATIONAL/EXPERIENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Licensed by the state of North Carolina as a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner

SUMMARY OF POSITION:

Provides behavioral health and substance use treatment to patients within the Coastal Horizons Center clinic, under the direction of a supervising psychiatrist and medical director. Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) provides diagnosis, treatment, medication management, consultation, and follow up behavioral health and substance use care to agency patients. The PMHNP provides age and specialty appropriate care at the level of training achieved.

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS:

  • Responsible for providing psychiatric services to patients in a variety of clinical settings during scheduled hours.

  • Prescribe, recommend, and/or discontinue medications and treatments to treat mental, emotional, behavioral and substance use disorders in accordance with all state and federal regulations as well as the Collaborative Practice Agreement.
  • Provides medication management for patients on medication and intermittent reassessment (as needed) for those assessed (but not on medication). Medication provision could include the direct delivery of injectables.
  • Counsel patients during appointments on medication benefits and risks.
  • Order, interpret, and evaluate labs to identify and assess patient's clinical problems and health care needs. Records findings, and formulates plan and prognosis, based on patient's condition.
  • Participates in the initial assessment, prescreening and evaluation of preadmission for patients entering Opioid Treatment Program (OTP) or Outpatient-Based Opioid Treatment (OBOT) Program.
  • Respond to client emergencies and be accessible to crisis on-call clinicians when appropriate.
  • Collaborates with Medical Director, supervising psychiatrist, nursing staff, medical assistants, therapist, and other treatment team members to ensure patient needs are met.
  • Responsible for timely and accurate completion of medical records documentation, including assessment, treatment plan, progress notes, outcome measures, and billing entries.
  • May refer patients to other medical providers for consultation or specialized care for treatment.
  • Collaborate with guardians, relatives, and significant others on patient’s conditions and treatment when clinically appropriate.
  • Return calls and emails promptly (within 24 hours of receipt or sooner if clinically necessary)
  • Responsible for making independent decisions based on protocols developed utilizing national guidelines and standards of care for treatment interventions.
  • Actively participate in all agency and department education, training, and in-services to confirm.

SALARY & BENEFITS:

  • Competitive salary based on experience

We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Program Manager
description:
The Process Manager is Applied Fluid Power’s owner of how work flows through its ERP systems and how that work produces clean, reliable data. This role sits at the intersection of business operations and data integrity — responsible for the P21 golden template, ERP process design, and the pipeline that moves operational data into Applied Fluid Power’s analytics and AI platforms.

This is a critical hire for Applied Fluid Power’s three-year data strategy. Clean data at the point of entry is the foundation everything else is built on.

ERP Process Design & Governance

  • Own and maintain the P21 golden template across Applied Fluid Power’s ~20 subsidiaries

  • Define and enforce data entry standards at the process level — ensuring quality is built in, not corrected downstream

  • Identify and close process gaps that produce bad, missing, or inconsistent data

  • Partner with subsidiary operations leaders to align local processes to Applied Fluid Power standards

P21-to-Prism Pipeline

  • Own the data pipeline from P21 (ERP) to Prism (analytics layer) — ensuring completeness, timeliness, and accuracy

  • Define field mapping, transformation logic, and data quality thresholds

  • Work with IT to troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures

Epicor / Cloud Migration Coordination

  • Serve as the business-side point of contact for the Epicor lift-and-shift migration

  • Validate that cloud migration preserves data quality and process integrity

  • Ensure the golden template is carried forward, not overwritten, during migration

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate tightly with the Data Manager on governance, metadata standards, and AI pilot readiness

  • Ensure ERP processes support data tagging, supplier connectivity, and downstream AI use cases

  • Participate in the community of practice as the ERP and process subject matter expert

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of experience with ERP systems, with hands-on P21 / Epicor experience strongly preferred

  • Strong understanding of distribution or industrial business processes (order management, procurement, inventory, service)

  • Demonstrated ability to design and document business processes that produce clean, structured data

  • Experience working across multiple business units or subsidiaries with varying levels of process maturity

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and working without a large team beneath you

Preferred

  • Experience with ERP cloud migrations (lift-and-shift or re-implementation)

  • Familiarity with data pipelines, analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Prism), or data governance concepts

  • Prior experience at a fluid power, industrial distribution, or manufacturing company

How This Role Fits

The Process Manager reports into Applied Fluid Power’s Data & AI function and coordinates closely with IT, Finance, and subsidiary operations leadership. It works in tandem with the Data Manager — who owns governance standards and the business data framework — while this role owns the ERP-side execution of those standards.

This is a foundational hire. You won’t have a large team, but you’ll have executive visibility, meaningful scope, and the ability to shape how Applied Fluid Power’s operational data infrastructure evolves over the next three years.

Regular

Review the position description below and apply today to ensure your application is among the first to be reviewed and contacted for this role!

PRIMARY FUNCTION:

The Precision Measurement Equipment Lab (PMEL) Technician II applies comprehensive metrology principles to all measurement disciplines to calibrate and repair Test, Measurement and Diagnostic Equipment in support of the US Air Force Metrology and Calibration Program at specified locations.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Perform daily operations in accordance with established safety and security practices.
  • Perform daily work assignments to ensure QMS goals are met or exceeded.

REQUIREMENTS

title: Strategic Product Manager, Biotech Reagents Portfolio
description:
About GenScript

Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions.

Product Planning and Development, Scientific Product Strategy – Life Science & Biotech Reagents

Position Type: Full-time, Strategic/Front-end Portfolio Management

The ideal candidate will have a strong scientific background and industry experience in biotechnology or life sciences, combined with experience in product management, product strategy, or related roles. We are particularly interested in candidates who can leverage their scientific expertise and industry knowledge to drive product strategy and translate scientific insights into business and product opportunities.

This is a front-end product strategy and planning role where you'll define what GenScript should build over the next 3–5 years by identifying unmet customer needs, evaluating emerging technologies, and shaping the future portfolio of life science research reagents.

Location: Remote, with occasional travel to Piscataway, New Jersey

Compensation: The estimated salary range is $125,000 - $155,000 based upon experience level.

Job Scope:

At GenScript, we believe great products begin long before the first experiment. Under GenScript's Catalog Products Business Unit, you won't simply manage existing products—you will design the future of our life science research portfolio.

This role sits at the intersection of science, technology, customer insight, and business strategy, helping define WHAT products GenScript should build over the next 3–5 years. Focused purely on front-end strategic planning, you will define the target specifications (What) while liberating R&D to explore the best execution (How).

You will work closely with R&D, Marketing, Business Development, Commercial, and executive leadership to discover unmet customer needs, identify emerging technology opportunities, design high-barrier product portfolios, and shape long-term innovation strategy.

Key Responsibilities (What You'll Do):

1) Design Future Product Portfolio & Roadmaps

  • Portfolio Strategy: Build long-term product portfolio strategies across antibodies, recombinant proteins, enzymes, bioassays, protein purification products, Cell & Gene Therapy (GCT) reagents, and emerging technology platforms.
  • White Space Identification: Pinpoint technology white spaces and unarticulated customer needs to establish a sustainable, high-margin product menu.
  • Strategic Roadmapping: Formulate and maintain future product roadmaps aligned with global business unit growth objectives.

2) Customer Insights & Actionable VOC

  • Deep Workflow Understanding: Transform scientific insights into commercial opportunities by deep-diving into customer workflows, Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD), and Voice of the Customer (VOC).
  • Market Intuition: Keep a pulse on emerging research trends, technology evolution, and the global competitive landscape. Your goal is to discover latent opportunities that customers have not yet articulated.

3) Shape Innovation & Platform Strategy

  • Multidimensional Evaluation: Evaluate future portfolio opportunities by integrating scientific feasibility, customer value, market potential, competitive differentiation, intellectual property (IP), and business economics.
  • Make vs. Buy Assessment: Conduct thorough "Build vs. Buy vs. Partner" assessments to support annual strategic planning and executive innovation reviews.

4) Connect Science with Business

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner seamlessly with R&D, Marketing, Business Development, Commercial, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and QA/RA to transform raw ideas into high-impact product development programs.
  • Executive Communication: Develop data-driven strategic recommendations and business cases to guide executive investment decisions.

Education:

  • PhD preferred (Master’s degree with exceptional industry experience will also be highly considered) in:
    • Biology / Cell Biology
    • Immunology
    • Protein Engineering / Antibody Engineering
    • Biochemistry / Bioengineering or related life science disciplines.

Experience:

We are looking for an individual who seamlessly combines scientific depth with corporate strategic thinking. Preferred experience includes one or more of the following:

  • Protein engineering, Antibody discovery & optimization
  • Cell & Gene Therapy (GCT) reagent development
  • Functional proteins and Bioassays
  • Advanced protein purification technologies

Highly Desirable: Experience and service in Early Discovery, Platform Development, or CMC within biopharma or top-tier CROs.

A Strong Plus: Direct experience interacting with biopharma customers, supporting business development, technical marketing, or corporate strategic planning.

Core Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking & Systems Thinking
  • Scientific Curiosity & Innovation Management
  • Customer-Centric Mindset (VOC/JTBD)
  • Portfolio Design & Market Insight
  • Cross-functional Leadership & Executive Communication
  • Data-driven Decision Making

What Makes You Successful:

You are someone who naturally enjoys asking questions such as:

  • Why do customers need this? What problem are we really solving?
  • Is this the best, highest-barrier product we could build?
  • What technology will define the next five years of drug discovery?

You possess the rare ability to synthesize Scientific Innovation, Customer Insight, Business Opportunity, and Technology Strategy into clear, decisive product definitions.

#LI-EB1

#GS

Benefits:

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as a 401(k) retirement plan with a company match that vests fully on day one. We offer paid parental leave after just three (3) months of employment, and a paid time off policy that includes vacation time, personal time, sick time, floating holidays, and company holidays. Additional benefits include flexible spending and health savings accounts, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, legal assistance, and supplemental plans such as pet, critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance. We also provide commuter benefits, well-being initiatives, and peer-to-peer recognition programs; demonstrating our ongoing commitment to building a culture where our people feel empowered, supported, and inspired to do their best work.

It is the Company's policy to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status, uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
