title: ERP Integration Expert
description:
GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP or Oracle. Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

Tasks

  • Own the integration architecture for new customers end to end: assess their ERP landscape, choose the right interface pattern (OData, RFC/BAPI, IDoc/EDI, CPI/BTP, staging tables, file-based), and design something their IT will approve and operate.
  • Lead technical discovery with customer IT, basis, and process teams, and surface the blocking constraint in week one, not week nine.
  • Own the data and field mapping from the customer's order, item, partner, and pricing structures onto our internal model, including the custom fields that carry the real business logic.
  • Design and build our ERP connectors in Python (S/4HANA and ECC, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce) and turn per-customer work into reusable abstractions, so the tenth connector costs a fraction of the first.
  • Build durable, long-running integration workflows with safe write-back into customer systems of record: idempotency, retries, replay semantics, and recovery paths from the start.
  • Own integration observability: know when a sync is stuck, degraded, or silently writing the wrong thing before the customer notices.
  • Define the authentication, network, and security posture per customer and get it through their review.
  • Feed what you learn in customer landscapes back into the product. You will see the same five problems before anyone else does.

Requirements

  • ERP integration depth, non-negotiable: you have delivered productive ERP integrations and know the interface landscape first-hand (IDoc, BAPI/RFC, OData/Gateway, CPI/BTP Integration Suite), on both S/4HANA and ECC, and you know which one to reach for and why.
  • Functional grounding: fluent in at least one of SD (order-to-cash) or MM (procure-to-pay), credible in the other, plus the FI touchpoints for AP/AR. You know what a schedule line, a condition record, and a three-way match actually are.
  • Engineering, not just configuration: 5+ years building and operating backend systems with real Python depth, owning production services rather than just delivering features.
  • Reliability instinct: idempotency, retries, and observability are part of how you design, not afterthoughts. A workflow engine like Temporal in production is a strong plus.
  • Customer-facing credibility: you can stand in front of an enterprise IT department, absorb their constraints, push back where it matters, and leave them confident.
  • End-to-end ownership: you identify what's broken or missing before you're asked, and you don't leave the system worse than you found it.
  • Professional English; German is a strong advantage given our customer base.
  • You're happy being in the office five days a week.

title: 22457 - Probation Service Officer - Offender Personality Disorder - Kent, Surrey and Sussex
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
This permanent Probation Service Officer post is initially based within the Chiron Team, Surrey's Intensive Interventions and Risk Management Service (IIRMS), part of the Offender Personality Disorder (OPD) Pathway for a minimum of 12 months. Working alongside probation and NHS colleagues, the role supports individuals transitioning from custody to the community through intensive, psychologically informed interventions.

This is an exciting opportunity to join Surrey as a permanent Probation Service Officer initially based within the Chiron Team, Surrey's Intensive Interventions and Risk Management Service (IIRMS), which forms part of the Offender Personality Disorder (OPD) Pathway.

The successful candidate will work as part of a multidisciplinary team of probation and NHS professionals, providing tailored, psychologically informed support to a small cohort of individuals transitioning from long custodial sentences into the community. The team adopts a psychosocial approach, informed by desistance theory, the Good Lives Model and individual psychological formulations, to support people in building stable and meaningful lives in the community.

The role is varied and rewarding, involving pre-release prison visits, accompanying individuals to community appointments, supporting engagement with services, undertaking community-based work and contributing to the operation of the Chiron community hub. The postholder will build positive working relationships with service users, colleagues and partner agencies to promote rehabilitation, manage risk and support successful reintegration into the community.

In addition, the postholder will contribute to the effective delivery of the OPD Pathway through maintaining accurate records, coordinating activities, monitoring information and liaising with a range of internal and external partners to support service delivery and positive outcomes for service users.

The successful candidate will have access to a range of specialist training, professional development and learning opportunities to support their ongoing growth and development.

Helping to keep the public safe. Giving people the chance to turn their lives around. Building a rewarding professional career. There are many reasons to join the Probation Service. What will yours be?

We’re looking for empathetic, patient, and organised people to join us in this varied role, which offers the chance to make a difference, gain new skills and build a rewarding career within the Probation Service.

If this sounds like you, apply now.

If you are successful in the recruitment process to join the Probation Service, your starting salary will be £28,064

The Probation Service offers the opportunity for annual pay progression through a Competency Based Framework (CBF), which if eligible, will see your pay increase. CBF is designed to enable you to move up through the pay band range as your competence grows.

New entrants are expected to join on the minimum of the pay band.

Probation Service also increase their pay band ranges annually in line with Civil Service Pay guidance, which will also apply an increase to band pay ranges where applicable.

Overview of the job

The job holder will undertake the full range of work with people on probation before and after sentence. This will include assessment, sentence implementation, offender management and producing reports. The job holder will provide case management support to a full range of people on probation utilising service procedures and practice directions that underpin professional judgement.

For further information on the summary, responsibilities, activities, duties of the role and the Civil Service Success Profile Criteria which will be used in the assessment process, please refer to the full Job Description Attachment.

Right to work in the UK

You must have the right to work in the UK and Civil Service ().

Skilled Worker visa changes from 22 July 2025

In accordance with current immigration rules, this role is not eligible for a new Skilled Worker visa.

From 22 July 2025, the Government introduced changes to the eligibility criteria for Skilled Worker visas. As a result:

HM Prison and Probation Service (HMPPS) cannot consider sponsoring you to work as a probation services officer unless you have held a Skilled Worker visa prior to the 22 July 2025 changes.

If you have held a Skilled Worker visa continuously, please raise this during your pre-employment checks and your eligibility will be assessed in accordance with the immigration rules and transitional provisions in place.

If you apply to be a probation services officer and you have not held a Skilled Worker visa prior to 22 July 2025, you will need to consider your options for obtaining and/or maintaining your right to work in the UK in light of these changes.

If your application is successful, you will need to ensure that you have and maintain the legal right to live and work in the Civil Service and in the United Kingdom.

HMPPS will continue to comply with UK Immigration Rules applied in the UK and Civil Service. You can read more about Skilled Worker visas and the eligibility criteria here.

Civil Service recruitment: nationality rules

Civil Service

This guide is intended to assist departments with managing their responsibilities on nationality rules related to Civil Service recruitment.

You can read more about Skilled Worker visas and the eligibility criteria here ()

About us:

By managing offenders in the community, the Probation Service protects the public from the effect of crime and gives offenders the chance to turn their lives around. Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive team that thrives on sharing knowledge and expertise.

Successful applicants may be based a wide variety of office, court, team, or prison locations within the Probation Service region. Allocations will be made according to business need.

To find out more about working as a Probation Service Officer please click here

About the Recruitment Process

To apply to this role you will be required to complete a short application form and detail responses to Civil Service Behaviours and Experience based question.

As part of this application, you will also be required to sit the Civil Service Judgement test (CSJT). The CSJT is a two-part test which looks at your ability to make decisions in relation to specific civil service behaviours.

The CSJT is stage one of your application process and you will have the option to complete a practice test immediately before taking the test, to give you an insight of what to expect before you start.

If you would like more information relating to reasonable adjustments and the CSJT, please see more details here. You can also watch a short a video here.

You can find out more about the CSJT and complete a practice test now here.

If you are successful in passing this stage, your full application will be sifted once the application deadline has closed. You will then receive further instruction on the progress and outcome of your application.

If we receive a high volume of applications, we may assess and progress candidates through the recruitment process in stages (tranches). Candidates who meet the required standard at sift may be held pending future assessment stages rather than progressing immediately. Interview invitations and subsequent offers will be managed in line with the tranche in which candidates are assessed and their position in merit order

If you apply for multiple vacancies for the same role, only one of your applications will be progressed. Any assessment scores achieved will be applied consistently across all applications for that role, this will be valid for 6 months.

Candidates who do not meet the minimum benchmark at either the Sift or Interview stage will not be eligible to reapply for the same role for six months from the date their assessment scores are progressed. There is also no guarantee that you will progress to the next stages of the recruitment process; however, we will keep you informed at each stage.

Take a look at a short video about Probation Service Officer Role here

About the role

Probation services officers can help make a real difference to peoples’ lives. It’s not always easy to help someone turn their life around, but it can be immensely rewarding.

Probation services officers are required to work within a variety of settings. There may be opportunities for positions within Probation Delivery Units (PDU), Courts, Prisons, Approved Premises etc. depending on business requirement.

Probation services officers are based in a wide variety of settings, listed below:
  • Accredited Programmes
  • Structured Interventions & Attendance Centres
  • Community Accommodation Services
  • Community Integration and Contracts
  • Contracts
  • Courts
  • Integrated Offender Management
  • Performance & Quality
  • Personality Disorder Projects
  • Prisons
  • Public Protection (Custody)
  • Public Protection (Community)
  • The Homeless Prevention Taskforce
  • Service Centre
  • Unpaid Work (community payback)
We’re looking for empathetic, patient and resilient people to join us as probation services officers. As well as making a difference to others, the role offers plenty of on-the-job training and a real chance to build a career in the Probation Service.

As a PSO, you’ll have a similar job to a fully qualified probation officer. The main difference is you’ll work with medium and lower risk people of probation. That’s not to say it’ll be easy. There’s no doubt this is a challenging role.

Day-to-day, you’ll manage a caseload of offenders before and after sentence. We’ll look to you to assess and manage risks, provide information to courts and work closely with agencies throughout the justice system. You’ll also do everything you can to support offenders. This could involve everything from providing practical advice about housing and employment to simply listening and empathising.

About you

You don’t need a degree for this role. We’re much more interested in your personal qualities. Ideally with experience of working with people who have social or personal difficulties, you’ll be empathetic, patient and resilient. Good writing skills are also essential. You must be able to produce clear and accurate reports to tight deadlines.

.

Responsibilities

A Day in the Life of a Service Coordinator:

As a Liberty Military Housing Service Coordinator, you will assist with the resident move in/move out process of a multi-family residential community. Your role includes heavy customer interaction and the ability to effectively schedule maintenance work including the work of vendors and contractors and to ensure all service requests and work orders are completed in a timely manner. Your role requires the ability to work efficiently as well as being able to effectively communicate and deliver on our mission of providing exemplary service according to Liberty Military Housing’s quality service and customer satisfaction standards

Your Responsibilities include, but not limited to:

  • Schedule and conduct home inspections as it relates to the move in/move out process, including pre-move in/pre-move out, and final inspections.
  • Assist with the ordering and scheduling of vendor services.
  • Maintain and monitor make-ready boards to ensure work is accurately distributed and meets completion time lines.
  • Work in conjunction with the maintenance team to ensure service requests are assigned and scheduled appropriately and completed in a timely manner.
  • Provide residents with any charges related to move out/final inspection results.
  • Create purchase orders for all vendor maintenance services and products (i.e. paint, flooring, etc.).
  • Generate work orders for make readies and other maintenance service requests.
  • Assist with the closing of work orders/tickets once work is completed.
  • Schedule and monitor water intrusion which includes communicating to residents, follow up and 3-day notices.
  • Resident follow-ups after services are rendered/completed.
  • Promote positive resident relations by ensuring resident concerns and requests are responded to in a timely manner to ensure resident satisfaction.
  • Address and follow up on customer service concerns from Satisfacts survey.
  • Assist with maintaining systems and logs (Keytrak, pest control, vendor/product logs, etc.).
  • Perform various administrative and computer tasks, email communications, input of information/data into various software and information systems (Payscan, Yardi, and other company-related systems).
  • Assist with the distribution of correspondence/notices (3-day notices, move out charges, water intrusion, other important resident notices that pertain to maintenance services, etc.).
  • Participate in property walks/inspections (grounds, common areas, parking lots, community rooms, make-readies, quality control, etc.) to ensure community is well maintained according to LMH’s quality standards.

  • Operate a company or personal vehicle to travel to various locations for work purposes.

title: Full Time Overnight Worker
description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

Job Purpose:

At Sudbury Cedar Place we care, nurture possibilities, advocate strongly, and offer hope. The full time overnight worker is responsible to provide a safe and welcoming environment. To provide assistance to individuals and families through community referrals and housing supports. To ensure nightly meals are prepared and while giving purposeful support to those in need.

Prescreen guest and be mindful to a new person accordingly with current policies that adhere to our standards that are consistent with the values and philosophy of The Salvation Army Women and Family Shelter. Track turnaways into the HIFIS system.

EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE:

SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES:

Ability and willingness to develop an understanding and support for the mission and purpose of The Salvation Army in Canada and its implications as related to position responsibilities.

title: Construction Administrator
description:
About Willmeng

Arizona-based Willmeng Construction is a 100-percent employee-owned general contractor that has been dedicated to helping our people build their “Genuine Place of Purpose” since 1977. We prioritize our exceptional company culture, which has us ranked in the Top 5 of the Phoenix Business Journal’s Best Places to Work for more than a decade and made us the only Arizona construction firm on the Inc. Best Workplaces list for three consecutive years. We have earned multiple appearances on AZ Big Media’s Most Admired Companies list, and ranked No. 1 for Healthiest Employers for two consecutive years.

Our people and our culture have also created an atmosphere that encourages going above and beyond for our clients and our community. Our team’s dedication to its craft has earned us NAIOP (CREDA) Arizona General Contractor of the Year six times, while at the same time donating more than $1 million annually to community organizations.

Our strategic vision focuses on supporting prelease transactions, competitively bidding projects of all sizes, and fostering our altruistic service culture by recruiting highly talented individuals of great character who want to make a genuine impact on our communities.

The Role

The Construction Administrator plays a vital role in the successful delivery of Willmeng construction projects, supporting the full project lifecycle from startup through closeout. Working closely with Project Managers, Superintendents, and the broader operations team, the CA serves as a central hub for project documentation and communication — ensuring all team members have accurate, current information at every stage of construction. This role is essential to keeping projects on schedule, completed efficiently, and to Willmeng's standards of excellence.

What you will accomplish

  • Serves as the accounting and documentation point of contact for all projects within a given silo, ensuring accuracy and timely processing in close coordination with Project Managers.
  • Tracks and maintains all owner and subcontractor contracts, certifications, and team training requirements to keep the project team compliant and current.
  • Acts as the primary liaison for subcontractor inquiries and coordinates all project accounting functions, including accounts receivable, client payment follow-up, subcontractor payments, and reconciliation of accounting, change order management and operations records.
  • Manages equipment rentals and maintains a organized filing system for all project documents and records.
  • Supports project closeout by coordinating required documentation including final billings, subcontractor warranties, lien waivers, and punch lists.
  • Manage compliance requirements for all subcontractors.

What we would like you to have

  • Bachelor's degree preferred; minimum 5 years of experience in an administrative role within the construction industry.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project, Outlook, and construction management software including Procore.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and adapt readily to changing priorities.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a strong focus on detail and accuracy.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking, accountability, and a willingness to ask questions, accept constructive feedback, and continuously learn.

You’re inspired by our values

  • Altruistic - Our foundation is built upon the authentic, selfless concern we share for the success and wellbeing of others.
  • Fair 360 - We illuminate with kindness by seeking to understand before being understood and by caring more than may seem reasonable so we can achieve genuine success for all.
  • Strategic - The blueprint that guides the creation of a genuine place of purpose expresses the clarity of our vision, the rigor of our thought and the character of our word.
  • Sincere - We present no facades, only genuine elevations of truth, trust, and wholehearted loyalty to the employees we mentor, the clients we serve and the communities we call home.
  • Nimble - Our structural integrity is ensured through the balance of resourcefulness, responsiveness, and adaptability and strengthened by being well-rounded in the market to serve at the highest levels.

Compensation

Alongside cash, our total compensation package includes comprehensive benefits and 100% employee ownership. From wellness to work life, our benefits support our employees' total wellbeing.

Benefits

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan
  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee medical, dental, and vision insurance 100% covered, with options to add dependents at 50% coverage by Willmeng
  • Flexible Time Off Policy
  • 9 paid company holidays
  • 3 consecutive weeks of parental bonding leave, with an additional 3-5 weeks of disability leave for delivery recovery
  • Spacious break rooms with healthy meals & snacks provided at no additional cost
  • Team-building activities, including volunteer opportunities

Willmeng places nothing more important to the organizational health of the company than its overall focus on culture. By bringing different personalities together and embracing their individual contributions, the culture is rich, strong and uniquely different. With a true family feel and the opportunity to participate in building a genuine place of purpose for clients and employees, Willmeng has the distinct advantage of something exceptional and special in the culture.

title: Freelance Graphic Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer with strong experience in logo design and visual identity to join the Tendem project (** and create high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in logo design, branding, visual communication, typography, and layout to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, you'll work across a variety of visual design tasks, with a particular focus on logo design, brand identity, and visual concept development. You may also work on layouts, infographics, social media templates, one-pagers, and other marketing and communication assets. We are looking for a versatile designer who can translate ideas and brand concepts into clear, distinctive visual solutions while maintaining a high level of craft and consistency across different formats.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design distinctive, professional logos and visual identity concepts based on different brand requirements and creative briefs.
  • Explore and develop multiple logo directions, using strong conceptual thinking to translate brand ideas into effective visual symbols and systems.
  • Apply branding principles across different assets to maintain a consistent and recognizable visual identity.
  • Create clean layouts, modern infographics, and clear visual hierarchies to ensure readable and engaging content.
  • Design reusable templates for social media channels, marketing materials, and impactful one-pagers.
  • Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
  • Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.
  • Enforce design quality standards through systematic verification of visual alignment, color usage, and layout consistency prior to delivery.

Important note

Please submit your CV in English. Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with relevant graphic design work. Portfolios featuring strong logo design and visual identity projects will be particularly important for this role. Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

This is project-based freelance work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, complete the qualification process, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills — on your own schedule.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, digital design, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio demonstrating professional graphic design work, with relevant examples of logo design, branding, or visual identity development. We are particularly interested in designers who can demonstrate the ability to create original logo concepts and translate brand ideas into effective visual solutions. A broader portfolio showcasing formats such as social media graphics, marketing collateral, infographics, and one-pagers is also highly valued. We are looking for versatile specialists with an exceptional grasp of typography, visual composition, color, and grid systems. An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented approach is essential, along with the ability to work independently to solve visual challenges.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Logo & Identity Design: Proven ability to develop original logo concepts and visual identities, from initial exploration through polished final execution.
  • Branding: Strong understanding of brand identity principles, including typography, color, visual language, consistency, and practical application across different formats.
  • Concept Development: Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate abstract brand ideas into distinctive, relevant, and visually effective concepts.
  • Layout & Typography: Exceptional grasp of typography, precise grid systems, and visual composition to elevate everyday materials.
  • Visual Asset Creation: Proven ability to structure information cleanly through modern infographics and compelling social media templates.
  • Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma to handle a wide spectrum of visual tasks.
  • Format Versatility: Seamlessly switch between designing impactful one-pagers and highly engaging digital templates, adapting to the constraints of each medium.

Additional requirements

  • An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Strong dedication to delivering visually polished, professional-grade assets.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to manage diverse visual tasks simultaneously.
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with graphic design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant graphic design cases, will not be considered.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Design Systems Designer
description:
About Genius AI

Genius AI is building technology to help local businesses run themselves. Genius AI products do the admin work that keeps practitioners from the work they love and the people they serve. From GlossGenius to Reception, its products work 24/7 on busywork like booking, marketing, client management, finances, staff and inventory management, and more.

We’re looking for a Senior Design Systems Designer to join our growing design systems team. At this level, you’re not just maintaining the system, you’re driving its vision, raising the bar for craft, and becoming a force multiplier for every designer and engineer at Genius AI.

As we scale, invest in AI across our product, and undergo a company-wide rebrand in partnership with Porto Rocha, the design system is more critical than ever. We’re looking for someone who can take real ownership, operate with minimal oversight, influence cross-functional partners, and help shape where design systems goes at Genius AI over the next several years.

  • Architect and maintain a robust component library with well-documented, reusable UI components that work seamlessly across mobile and web

  • Lead the development of design tokens, Figma libraries, variables, and naming conventions that support a scalable, consistent visual language

  • Drive the design-to-dev handoff process, partnering closely with engineering to bridge Figma and production and reduce friction in every release

  • Champion accessibility, quality, and craft standards across every component and pattern in the system

  • Play a key role in our company-wide rebrand, ensuring the new visual language is systematized and applied consistently across the product

  • Mentor and collaborate with other designers, raising the craft level of the broader team

  • Influence roadmap and prioritization for the design systems team, bringing a strategic point of view to what gets built and when

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of product design experience with significant, hands-on focus on design systems, component libraries, or design infrastructure

  • A portfolio that shows strong UI craft alongside end to end product thinking.

  • Proven track record of owning and scaling a design system in a production environment, not just contributing, but leading

  • Expert-level Figma skills, components, variables, auto layout, libraries, and prototyping

  • Deep systems thinker, you see patterns others miss, build for edge cases, and design with scale in mind from day one

  • Strong cross-functional collaborator who can align engineers, PMs, and designers around shared standards without heavy oversight

  • Ability to articulate and defend design decisions clearly, you have strong opinions and know how to communicate them

  • Mobile-first mindset, our product is mobile-first and you design with that context naturally

  • Experience contributing to the pillars of a design system such as: Tokens, Accessibility, working with code/developers, Documentation, and Contribution models.

  • Passion for empowering small business owners; a high level of empathy for our customers and a strong desire to understand their needs

  • Nice to have: Storybook, Tokens Studio, Style Dictionary; rebrand or platform evolution experience; curiosity about AI tools like Cursor or Claude

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive health & dental insurance options

  • Flexible PTO

  • Annual stipend for professional development and continued learning

  • High performers at 5 years receive a $5,000 bonus to use however you recharge best

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and adoption benefits via Carrot

  • Local events - in-person gathering opportunities throughout the year for our distributed team

At Genius AI, we celebrate our differences and are committed to creating a workplace where all employees feel supported and empowered to do their best work. We believe this benefits not only our employees but our product, customers, and community as well. Genius AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer.

Personal Information: Notice at Collection for Employees and Applicants

Agency Submissions
If a resume or applicant is submitted to Genius AI by a third party without a signed search agreement in place, it will become the property of Genius AI and no fee will be paid, irrespective of whether the candidate is hired.

description:
Employment Type:

Full time

Shift:

Day Shift

Description:

At Saint Alphonsus Health System, we are looking for people who are living out their calling. We want you to be passionate about coming to work, and challenged to achieve your potential. Living by these virtues, we pride ourselves on exceptional service and the highest quality of care.

The Nampa Joint Orthopedics and Sports Medicine clinic are looking for a passionate and organized Medical Assistant!

Position Summary & Highlights:

  • This MA position will be supporting an Orthopedic surgeon and a PA-C with the Nampa Orthopedics team and working alongside with MAs, RNs, and Athletic Trainers.

  • In addition to rooming patient duties, you will assist providers during clinic visits, apply and remove casts and splints, draw up injections for minor procedures, complete chart prep, DME application, and suture removals.

  • You will also assist with patient phone calls, messages and follow up communication, and complete and manage clinic paperwork and documentation including prior authorizations, in-basket tasks, regulatory items, and MRI authorizations.

  • This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop orthopedic clinical skills while working closely with a dedicated team of providers and caring for a diverse patient population.

An ideal candidate will have:

  • Orthopedic experience or knowledge or a strong interest in orthopedics;

  • Enjoys working in a team environment and supporting multiple providers;

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, is adaptable, detail-oriented, and patient-focused.

Work Schedule:

  • 40 hours/week, 5 - 8 hour shifts, Mondays – Fridays, hours varying around 7:30am - 5:30pm.

  • Shift start and end time can vary based on providers' schedules and staffing needs.

Location:

  • Nampa: 4424 E Flamingo Ave., Ste. 110, Nampa, Idaho 83687 (Near the Nampa Medical Center campus)

Highlights and Benefits

When Saint Alphonsus takes care of you, you can take better care of our patients. We foster personal and professional growth and offer opportunities that empower our colleagues to develop their careers. Our belief in work-life balance compliments the natural beauty, diverse landscapes, and outdoor recreation lifestyle that is unique to Idaho and Oregon.

Saint Alphonsus Health System is a faith-based ministry and not-for-profit health system serving Idaho, Oregon, and northern Nevada communities. The health system boasts 4 hospitals, 609 licensed beds, and 73 clinic locations. title: Christian Life Coaching Online Adjunct (Graduate Program) - School of Divinity
description:
Adjuncts are essential to Liberty University’s mission of Training Champions for Christ. It is expected that ‎‎‎‎‎‎an adjunct member models a personal commitment to the goals and values of Liberty University, engage ‎‎‎‎‎‎in an active commitment to, and experience of, personal spiritual formation within a biblically informed ‎‎‎‎‎‎Christian worldview. Adjuncts should view their teaching, engagement with students, and scholarship as a ‎‎‎‎means to a significant educational ‎‎end. They should strive to employ a variety of techniques for the ‎‎‎‎development of good learning ‎‎conditions, view each student as a unique individual, and insofar as it is ‎‎‎‎possible, provide for individual ‎‎differences, abilities, and interests. ‎

We are seeking a Life Coaching professor with a terminal degree in a related field, professional credentials, and demonstrated experience helping others pursue growth, purpose, and personal flourishing through biblically grounded, evidence-based coaching practices.

Applicant must also have experience in one or more of the following areas:
• Trauma-informed care
• Neuroscience-informed care
• Health and wellness
• Addiction

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

Faculty and Curriculum

  • Emphasize and model excellence in teaching and learning.

  • Distribute departmental communication in accordance with established guidelines.

  • Ensure instruction is based in or defensible before the academic community, that personal views are so identified, and that it is compatible with the University’s Christian worldview, as reflected in the doctrinal statement.

  • Seek to develop faculty that encourage independent thinking in students and critical discussion of differing points of view as they pertain to the issues of each course.

  • Encourage excellence in students with appropriate course requirements.

  • Provide appropriate evaluations of student progress through grading and consultation.

title: Sr Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI
location: WA - Seattle; CA - San Francisco; UT - Cottonwood Heights
description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

SoFi is building an internal AI platform that will change how employees across the company work. It combines models, enterprise context, tools, memory, governed capabilities, and an extensible agent harness so teams can move beyond chat and apply AI to meaningful business workflows.

You will work with the AI Platform engineering team, product leader, and subject-matter experts across the company. You will help departments reimagine how their work gets done, build the first workflows that make that future real, and turn what you learn in the field into durable platform capabilities.

Because you will be the first person in this role, you will also define what forward deployment means at SoFi: how we discover opportunities, onboard departments, build and evaluate workflows, measure outcomes, support users, and translate repeated needs into platform investments. Your work will establish the technical and operating foundation for a broader AI enablement capability.

This role does not have a playbook. It is an opportunity to write one and to define how applied AI changes the way work gets done across SoFi. This is a rare opportunity to shape both an enterprise AI platform and the organization that brings it to life.

What You’ll Do

  • You will operate as a product-minded engineer, platform architect, and hands-on builder. One week you may be mapping a complex Finance workflow with domain experts; the next, prototyping an agentic solution, defining its evaluations, and contributing a new capability to the shared platform.
  • Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across SoFi to identify high-value opportunities to transform work with AI.
  • Embed with internal departments to understand their workflows, systems, data, constraints, and measures of success and deploy AI-enabled workflows that solve real business problems.
  • Lead departments from initial discovery through onboarding, adoption, production use, and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop the playbooks, technical patterns, and operating practices that allow AI enablement to scale across the company.
  • Build reusable skills, tools, integrations, agents, and workflow components on top of SoFi's internal AI platform.
  • Contribute directly to the platform when field deployments reveal missing capabilities or opportunities to improve the developer and user experience.
  • Create tight feedback loops among users, AI Enablement, product, and platform engineering.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior business and technology leaders navigating the opportunities and tradeoffs of applied AI.

What You’ll Need

  • Deep experience building and operating sophisticated software systems at Sr Staff Engineer equivalent scope.
  • A track record of leading technically ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through production adoption.
  • Strong product judgment and an instinct for finding the real problem behind a feature request.
  • Experience designing applications, platforms, developer tools, workflow systems, or distributed systems.
  • Practical experience building with large language models, including tool use, context engineering, agents, evaluations, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • The judgment to distinguish among a prototype, a department-specific solution, and a capability that belongs in a shared platform.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills across technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Comfort creating structure, standards, and momentum in a space where the operating model is still being formed.

Nice to Have

  • Experience as a founding or early Forward Deployed Engineer, product engineer, product manager, solutions architect, or technical leader for an enterprise platform.
  • Experience building an internal developer platform, AI platform, enterprise productivity product, or agentic system.
  • Experience building evaluation and feedback systems for nondeterministic or AI-enabled products.
  • Experience operating in financial services or another highly regulated environment.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Established a repeatable model for taking departments from opportunity discovery to successful production use.
  • Delivered AI-enabled workflows that create measurable improvements in speed, quality, capacity, or employee experience.
  • Built a trusted partnership among internal users, AI Enablement, and the AI Platform organization.
  • Converted insights from early deployments into reusable capabilities within the shared platform.
  • Defined standards for onboarding, workflow development, evaluation, deployment, support, and continuous improvement.
  • Created the technical and operating foundation from which SoFi can scale its Forward Deployed Engineering and AI Enablement capabilities.

title: Competitive Intelligence and Market Research Intern (Winter/January 2027, 12 Months)
location: Oakville, Ontario - Canada; Toronto, Ontario - Canada
description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Competitive Intelligence and Market Research Intern who will assist the team with research projects on emerging trends, products and competitors, sharing acquired knowledge with internal teams to ensure strategic decisions and positioning. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader - we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Competitive Intelligence and Market Research Intern your key area of responsibility will be assisting with performing market analysis on emerging trends and competitors including new market presence, expansion of capabilities, market news as well product positioning of competitors. You will also support the collection of relevant data from various sources, such as industry reports, market research studies, news articles, social media, and competitor websites. This is done by utilizing both primary and secondary research methods to gather information. You will need to work closely with Geotab Product, Product Marketing, Sales and Marketing teams.

To be successful in this role you will be a self-starter with strong written and verbal communication skills, and have the ability to effectively communicate findings to key stakeholders. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong analytical skills to complete research and analysis of data on Geotab’s market and competitor with an ability to identify key insights for internal stakeholders. The successful candidate will also be able to manage multiple timelines and contrasting priorities to ensure timely results.

The opportunity:

  • 12-month work-term beginning January 2027.
  • Full-time, paid internship: Monday - Friday, 37.5hrs/week.
  • Your first week at Geotab begins with 'GEO Launch' - a one-week Employee Orientation. Click here to learn more!
  • Learn more about the Geotab Campus Program here.

title: Principal, Data Insights Focused
description:
Precision is an award-winning integrated strategy and marketing agency based in Washington, DC and New York, NY. Powered by data, we bring world-class experts in each of our service areas to conceive, develop, and run campaigns that help our clients seize opportunities and solve their biggest challenges. We’re at the center of today’s biggest debates and defining moments, inside the Beltway, across New York’s media and financial worlds, and in state capitals across the country. Our work sits at the intersection of politics, business, and culture, helping leaders and organizations make an impact when it matters most. We hire people who are the best at what they do, and who like to have fun doing it; we don’t just break through. We break new ground.

Our team is seeking a Principal to join our Data & Analytics team in New York, NY or Washington, D.C. This is an exciting opportunity for a sharp, curious intelligence professional to do some of the most interesting data and insights work in the industry — helping translate social listening, reputation monitoring, and AI-powered analysis into communications strategy for some of the world's most influential organizations.

What You Will Do:

Client Management

  • Support and manage day-to-day client workstreams across analysis, monitoring, intelligence, and insights engagements, ensuring high-quality outputs and timely delivery.
  • Serve as a reliable client contact on assigned accounts, communicate clearly, anticipate needs, and escalate complex challenges to senior leadership with context and recommended solutions.
  • Follow Precision client management processes. Help ensure the team is delivering high-quality work within scope and budget.

Data & Intelligence

  • Contribute to social listening and digital intelligence workstreams — help synthesize monitoring data into clear, compelling insights that inform client strategy and communications activations.
  • Assist in managing primary research workstreams from fielding through analysis and reporting, ensuring data quality, timeline adherence, and outputs that tell a compelling and accurate story.
  • Support the delivery of terrAIn, Precision's proprietary Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) offering, helping package and communicate GEO findings in ways that are accessible, strategic, and relevant to client priorities.
  • Execute reputation analysis and monitoring workflows, track client reputational landscapes in real time and flag emerging issues with speed and precision.
  • Produce strategic insights reports and intelligence briefings that translate data into actionable recommendations, helping clients understand not just what is happening, but what to do about it.

Collaboration & People Management

  • Work cross-functionally with strategic communications, creative, and paid media teams to ensure data and intelligence outputs are integrated into broader client campaigns.
  • Support junior staff through day-to-day guidance, feedback, and task delegation; contribute to a collaborative, high-performance team culture.
  • Keep internal teams informed of relevant developments on assigned accounts; participate actively in internal meetings and contribute to knowledge-sharing across the data practice.

Project & Time Management

  • Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously with strong attention to detail and follow-through. Proactively flag timeline risks, track deliverables, and keep projects moving with limited oversight.

Strategy

  • Bring a strategic lens to intelligence and insights work — go beyond data delivery to offer thoughtful analysis and recommendations that drive client outcomes.
  • Stay current on trends in social listening, polling, GEO, AI-driven discovery, and reputation management; bring new ideas and approaches to the team and help elevate the quality of Precision's outputs.

Business Development

  • Support pitches and new business presentations by contributing research, insights, and data-driven narratives; identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through new ideas and proactive thinking.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in social listening, digital intelligence, market research, polling, qualitative research, reputation monitoring, communications analytics, or related fields. Prior agency experience a strong plus.
  • Hands-on experience with social and digital listening platforms (e.g. Brandwatch, Meltwater, Sprinklr, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to turn data into strategic communications recommendations.
  • Experience with different primary research methodologies (e.g. surveys, focus groups, in-depth interviews, etc.) is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with the evolving GEO landscape and curiosity about how AI-driven discovery environments affect client reputation and visibility.
  • Some experience managing or mentoring junior staff.
  • Ability to manage multiple clients and workstreams simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Creative, energetic, and possesses an entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Spanish language skills are a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Annual bonus opportunity
  • Flexible hybrid remote/in office plan
  • Retirement plan with automatic 3% safe-harbor contribution from Precision
  • Healthcare coverage - medical, dental and vision with 90% of costs covered by Precision
  • Paid vacation and sick leave
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development stipend

The salary range for this position is $85,000 – $105,000.

We are currently working in a hybrid model and require staff to work in the office 50% of working days per month.

Precision is committed to building a diverse team that will positively and authentically impact the communities we serve. Centering our strategies around the authentic voices and cultures of the communities we are engaging with is paramount to our work – and our work can only be as inclusive as our team is representative. We strongly encourage women, Black, Latino, Hispanic, AAPI, and Indigenous people, LGBTQ+, gender expansive or GNC folks, people of all ages, disabled people, and veterans to apply.

title: Associate, Real Estate and Office Services
description:
About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Real Estate and Corporate Security

The Real Estate & Office Services team at Gemini is responsible for building and maintaining world-class office environments that reflect our culture, values, and operational needs. Our team ensures that each physical location supports productivity, collaboration, employee experience, safety, and business operations. We act as trusted partners and problem-solvers—creating spaces where Gemini can thrive.

The Role: Associate, Real Estate and Office Services

We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and hands-on Real Estate and Office Services Associate to support the day-to-day operations of Gemini's Arizona Operations Center and broader Real Estate & Office Services initiatives. This individual serves as the primary on-site Office Services representative and partners closely with RESO leadership, Corporate Security, IT, People, property management, and external vendors across workplace operations, facilities, physical access, space planning, office projects and moves, on-sites and events, and employee experience.

Given the nature of our workplace and 24/7 operations, this role requires a high degree of professionalism, maturity, discretion, and security awareness. The Associate must be able to work independently while consistently following established policies, procedures, security protocols, and escalation paths.

The ideal candidate is a mature, dependable, highly professional, and service-oriented operator who takes ownership and follows through. They are proactive and capable of working independently, while respecting established processes, decision-making authority, and escalation paths. They are security-conscious, follow protocols to a T, exercise good judgment, and know when to escalate. They remain organized and professional when priorities change and can be trusted to represent Gemini appropriately with employees, visitors, vendors, and external partners.

This role is required to be in person five days per week at our Tempe, AZ (soon to be Scottsdale) office.

Responsibilities:

Workplace Operations & Employee Experience

  • Serve as the primary on-site Office Services point of contact and oversee day-to-day workplace operations.
  • Maintain a professional, secure, organized, and employee-ready office environment, including shared spaces, pantry, supplies, mail, shipping/receiving, and workplace services.
  • Support the workplace needs of a 24/7 Operations Center, including seating, parking, access, shared spaces, and general office readiness.
  • Support the workplace portion of employee onboarding by helping ensure desks, building access, parking, and general office readiness are coordinated with the appropriate teams.
  • Support employee on-sites, leadership visits, and office events, including rooms, catering, transportation, vendors, and related logistics.
  • Maintain familiarity with building procedures, emergency contacts, office service schedules, and key vendor contacts to ensure continuity of local operations.

Facilities, Property Management & Vendors

  • Serve as the day-to-day liaison with property management, building security, engineering, parking, and other building teams.
  • Coordinate building access, parking, maintenance, repairs, COIs, deliveries, vendor access, and other facilities requirements.
  • Manage scheduling and day-to-day relationships with workplace vendors, including cleaning, pantry/beverage, furniture, moving, maintenance, shredding, and other office services.
  • Proactively identify workplace issues, track them through resolution, and escalate as appropriate.

Space, Supplies & Inventory

  • Maintain seating charts and coordinate desk assignments, shared seating, workstation changes, and capacity needs.
  • Manage office furniture, supplies, and workplace inventory, including tracking, storage, and readiness.
  • Coordinate with the appropriate internal teams when technology, security, or other specialized support is needed for the workplace.
  • Anticipate workplace needs associated with headcount changes, onboarding, team on-sites, and operational schedules.

Office Moves & Projects

  • Partner with RESO leadership, Corporate Security, IT, and other stakeholders on office moves, openings, buildouts, decommissions, and workplace projects.
  • Coordinate on-site execution, including vendors, packing, furniture, deliveries, access, employee communications, and move logistics.
  • Track project tasks, timelines, open items, and office readiness and communicate risks or roadblocks to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Participate in project meetings, site walkthroughs, vendor meetings, and move-in/move-out activities as needed.

Security & Access

  • Partner closely with Corporate Security to administer employee badges/access, vendor and visitor access, and other physical security requirements.
  • Maintain a security-minded approach to all workplace activities and ensure established access and security procedures are followed consistently.
  • Follow security and operational protocols precisely; do not make exceptions or create workarounds without appropriate approval.
  • Recognize when an issue requires escalation and engage RESO leadership, Corporate Security, People, IT, or other functional owners as appropriate.
  • Support emergency preparedness, building incidents, and employee safety procedures in coordination with the appropriate teams.

Administration & Cross-Functional Support

title: Associate Environmental Scientist for Emergency Response Team
description:
At Weston Solutions, Inc. you will do meaningful work and make valuable contributions. Employee ownership at Weston is a path to professional growth and access to diverse opportunities in a highly connected community that works together across key service areas to make a difference in the environment. Weston has continued to evolve and adapt to our changing world as a premier provider of environmental and infrastructure services for over sixty years. In both the public and private sectors our teams help identify, solve, mitigate, and manage critical environmental issues to help clients achieve a more sustainable future.

Weston is seeking an Associate Environmental Scientist to support the operation, maintenance, and monitoring of water treatment systems. This hands-on position combines field and office work, including system monitoring, environmental sampling, equipment maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational documentation.

This position supports an anticipated project award with work expected to begin in the near term. Weston is proactively interviewing to prepare for onboarding as project activities ramp up. Start timing will align with project award, kickoff, and mobilization schedules.

Location: West Chester, PA

Expected Outcomes:

  • Operate and monitor water treatment systems, including filtration units, pumps, valves, piping, chemical feed systems, and instrumentation.
  • Perform routine inspections, operational checks, preventive maintenance, and minor equipment repairs.
  • Monitor system performance and record flow, pressure, totalizer, and other meter readings.
  • Prepare chemical feed solutions and follow established chemical-handling procedures.
  • Collect water, groundwater, soil, and other environmental samples using approved procedures.
  • Calibrate, operate, and maintain field monitoring and sampling equipment.
  • Identify and troubleshoot operational or mechanical issues involving pumps, valves, piping, treatment equipment, and instrumentation.
  • Maintain accurate operating logs, field notes, analytical results, maintenance records, and daily reports.
  • Organize project files and prepare documentation of field, treatment-system, and maintenance activities.
  • Follow site-specific safety requirements, environmental regulations, standard operating procedures, and established safe work practices.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to support treatment-system operations.
  • Respond promptly to system alarms, shutdowns, and operational issues, including after-hours and weekend events while on call.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Sciences or related field and 0-2 years of related experience.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to follow technical procedures and read operating manuals, equipment instructions, or schematics.
  • Strong attention to detail, safety, documentation, and data accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently when appropriately trained and to collaborate effectively with the project team.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying terrain and weather conditions.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods and lift and carry up to 50 pounds, including field equipment, supplies, and PPE.
  • Ability to work after hours and weekends when assigned to the rotating on-call schedule.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to obtain a security clearance or site access authorization if required.

Preferred:

  • Technical training, coursework, certificate, or associate degree in water treatment, environmental technology, mechanical systems, industrial maintenance, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree or coursework in Environmental Science, Engineering, Physical Science, Life Science, or a related discipline.
  • Previous internship, military, laboratory, field, construction, utilities, mechanical, or water treatment experience.
  • Familiarity with pumps, valves, piping, filtration systems, chemical feed systems, or environmental monitoring equipment.
  • Experience collecting environmental samples or maintaining field and operational documentation.
  • OSHA, HAZWOPER, water treatment, first aid, or other relevant safety and technical training.

We fully invest in our people: Weston provides a generous, comprehensive benefits package program that offers employees high value options with solid financial protection, meeting the personal needs of its people and their families.

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with base and matching employer stock contributions.
  • Paid time off includes personal, holiday and parental.
  • Life and disability plans.
  • Critical illness and accident plans.
  • Work/Life flexibility.
  • Professional development opportunities.

Compensation will vary based upon experience, education, skill level, and other compensable factors.
