title: RHVAC Technician
description:
SIGN ON TO NEW HIRES!

Please Note: City US anticipates that this position will become union-represented in late 2026. Additional information will be shared as details become available. Guided by our values of communication, coordination, collaboration, care, and change, we remain focused on supporting our people and building for the future.

POSITION SUMMARY

The RHVAC Technician is responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing refrigeration, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems and equipment in commercial environments. The role requires a solid understanding of HVAC and refrigeration systems, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team to ensure that all systems operate efficiently and safely.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Maintenance & Service:

  • Perform regular preventative maintenance tasks such as changing filters, inspecting refrigerant levels, calibrating sensors, and checking for system leaks.

  • Lubricate system components, check for proper system pressure, and replace worn-out parts as necessary.

  • Conduct system diagnostics to identify issues with airflow, temperature regulation, or other mechanical problems.

Troubleshooting & Repairs:

  • Diagnose and troubleshoot issues in HVAC and refrigeration systems, including but not limited to electrical failures, mechanical breakdowns, refrigerant leaks, and sensor malfunctions.

  • Provide timely, effective repairs and replacements of parts as needed to restore system function.


Installation:

  • Install new HVAC and refrigeration systems (e.g., compressors, coils, split systems, RTUs, heaters, walk-in coolers & freezer units) in compliance with local codes and safety regulations.

  • Ensure proper integration of ductwork, electrical wiring, and piping for optimal system functionality.


Customer Interaction:

  • Communicate effectively with clients regarding service issues, solutions, and recommendations for system improvements or upgrades.

  • Provide guidance on optimal system usage and maintenance schedules to ensure long-term performance and energy efficiency.


Safety & Compliance:

  • Follow all safety procedures and regulations when handling refrigerants, operating electrical systems, and working with pressurized equipment.

  • Ensure that all installations and repairs comply with federal, state, and local codes, including environmental regulations related to refrigerant handling.

  • Follow lockout/tagout (LOTO) and other safety procedures when working on equipment to prevent accidents and injuries.

  • Complete safety training provided by company.


Training & Development:

  • Stay current with new technologies, systems, and industry best practices through ongoing training and certification programs.

  • Assist in the training of RHVAC Apprentices as required.


Record Keeping & Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate service records, including details of all inspections, repairs, and maintenance performed in the computerized maintenance management system.

  • Complete necessary paperwork and reports for warranty claims, service contracts, and parts inventory.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Valid driver’s license.

  • Must be able to pass pre-employment DMV check, drug screening and background check.

  • Refrigeration license required as defined by State(s) regulations and preferred in all areas.

  • EPA Certification is required.

  • OSHA 10-Hour certification required within 30 days of employment (company provided training available).

  • High school diploma or equivalent (required); post-secondary education in RHVAC is a plus.

  • Completion of an apprenticeship or formal RHVAC training program.

SKILLS/COMPETENCIES

  • Proficiency in the use of tools and equipment necessary for RHVAC installation and repair.

  • Strong knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, as well as refrigeration principles.

  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow technical diagrams and schematics.

  • Effective communication skills for working with customers and colleagues.

  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to lift heavy equipment and materials (up to 50 lbs or more).

  • Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and in environments that may require protective equipment (e.g., gloves, hard hats, safety glasses).

  • Ability to perform physically demanding tasks such as climbing, standing, bending, and crouching for extended periods while working on equipment.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Field-based, working on customer sites.

  • May require work in noisy, hot, or dusty environments.

  • Rotating on-call evenings and weekends.

  • Overtime or weekend work may be required depending on business needs.

  • Ability to store company issued vehicle preferred.


ABOUT CITY FM

City Facilities Management (US) LLC is a leader in end-to-end integrated facilities management for some of the top retailers and grocers across the nation. Through our unparalleled self-performance team of highly skilled technicians, customer service gurus, energy experts and more, City FM delivers exceptional service quality and cost savings using a holistic, data-driven approach to facilities management.

With offices in Jacksonville, FL and Burlington, MA since 2016, City FM is part of the GDI Ainsworth family founded 90 years ago. Ainsworth is Canada’s leading integrated multi-trade services provider with over 4,000 team members across US and Canada.


WHY SHOULD YOU WORK AT CITY FM?
City FM is part of a global network of leading facilities management, professional services, and data-driven sustainability solutions, for starters. Also, we offer a generous benefits package that includes 28 days of PTO along with a 401(k) match with immediate vesting and company match.

We don’t just hire anyone at City FM; we’re looking for loyal team members with a deep sense of responsibility and a thirst for constant learning and growth with a willingness to always lend a helping hand.

When you join City FM, you’re committing to making a difference. We make a commitment to you too – helping you embark on a career with purpose! Whether through our world-class training programs, over 1,500 e-learning classes through City University or Leadership Development framework – City FM cares passionately about the people we hire and ensures that growth is always on the horizon.

Wondering if your values align with ours? If you put clients first, care passionately about what you do and are committed to working on a team that respects each other, you will fit right in!

So, if you’re ready to get started, we’re ready for you.

City FM is An Affirmative Action / Equal Opportunity Employer. The Company has a Drug-Free Workplace Policy in effect that is strictly adhered to.

title: Director, Logistics
description:
About Us

Centric Brands is a leading lifestyle brand collective that designs, sources, markets and sells high quality products in multiple segments, including women’s, men’s and kid’s apparel, accessories, entertainment and beauty. Centric Brands is focused on our customers and our brands that will drive the company’s future growth. We are defined by innovation as we seize new opportunities and thrive in an environment informed by creativity and thinking that is both analytical and outside the box. Centric Brands reflects a team built on respect, for others and for the hard work it takes to achieve our goals and build our bright future together.

As one of the world’s premier lifestyle brand collectives, we want to ensure that warehouses, factories, retail outlets and on-line retailers all over the world have what they need, when they need it. You’ll be part of a team that leverages leading-edge technology – and innovative solutions – to deliver goods and materials on time, on schedule and in great condition. It’s a career path the offers non-stop challenges and endless variety – along with the opportunity to learn the business from the best.

Specific Responsibilities Would Include

Position Description and Requirements:

Centric Brands has an opportunity for an experienced Logistics/Carrier Operations Director who will be a key Leader/Owner and influencer within our Global Supply Chain. This position will report directly to the VP, Logistics. The Director will lead the team’s accountability for all international carrier (ocean/air/parcel) operations globally for our Fashion Apparel & Accessories business. This is a critical position that will involve strategic planning of our international transportation network, operational execution of all shipments to delivery, negotiation of contracts with carriers and 3pl/4pl providers and development of team members. This role will also lead the audit/payment of our shipments globally and the 3rd party operators.

An ideal candidate will be innovative, highly influential, will drive result-oriented solutions, and able to steer through ambiguity while providing balanced decision-making while assessing tradeoffs. They are passionate about solving complex problems and developing team members in a high-volume and growth environment, with a mindset for building durable solutions to complex problems at scale, approaching their work with determination, understanding potential impacts with give/take both internally and externally. They will have spent considerable time in logistics management of carriers, people, problems, processes, visibility platforms, and consolidators. Candidates will be able to demonstrate excellence, possess the ability to learn quickly and strive for perfection within a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic

  • Develop and implement short/long-term logistics/carrier/operation strategies to support the growth of the organization in a cost-effective manner while improving service and reliability
  • Work collaboratively across internal divisions to understand key areas of growth and shifts with sourcing/customers, container utilization, shipment consolidations and alternative routings to ensure logistics strategy is in alignment needs
  • Negotiate ocean/air/parcel contracts, rates, capacity leveraging relationships to support seasonality shipping requirements by Division and origin
  • Support our Asia Operations/Allocation/Booking teams with carrier oversight/improvements
  • Direct the relationship with our 3rd party freight auditor, ensuring timely, accurate payment at above average standards/operations at a competitive rate
  • Propose/create/develop/execute transportation allocation, capacity and transit strategies developing contingency plans to cost-effectively support varying levels of company sales and changes to supply/demand patterns as well as market volatility
  • Identify, develop, implement, and enhance shipping visibility tools/reports/dashboards and milestone timeliness/completeness to proactively manage and improve the logistics network
  • Direct/support the development of staff and team members to ensure continued growth in position within Centric Brands Logistics department.
  • Once on-board original port of load through transshipment ports ensuring timely movement through to destination port, including facilitating faster service/support.
  • Oversee the continued movement of freight (origin/transshipments) while providing complete, timely and accurate data for our quoted, booked, in-transit and delivered shipments for the business and our internal customers weekly/monthly/quarterly including fiscal accruals and payment information for ocean/air/parcel shipments globally

Team Management

  • Develop an action-based and customer service-oriented team through coaching, directing, illustrating through action etc cultivating a culture of exceeding expectations, continuous improvement, and proactive problem-solving improving KPI’s, processes and costs
  • Develop robust, trusting relationships and positive experiences with and for the team, our internal customers and partners (team/carrier) on all logistic items, capabilities, and service standards
  • Lead team of 4+ direct reports and supporting staff located across the globe

Day to Day Operations

  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with effective communication and thorough follow through
  • Create/develop/execute transportation allocation, capacity strategies developing contingency plans to cost-effectively support varying levels of company sales and changes to supply/demand patterns as well as market volatility
  • Facilitate complete/accurate visibility with where our freight is at any given time, keeping our freight moving, for example pulling in transshipments with improved sailing options, leveraging relationships and opportunities with actual shipping options (not asking for what is available with approx. volumes of 13K containers
  • Proactively prevent issues from occurring/reoccurring, being active in solving issues before internal customers identity bringing solutions and answers
  • Develop the team and utilize key performance indicators (KPIs), metrics and reporting to help drive execution, understand drivers, accountability and process uniformity and compliance across all divisions, regions, with all transportation providers and vendors
  • Owns the transit time performance, models, and updates to ensure we have the most accurate data and best performance available
  • Lead weekly Carrier calls reviewing items including performance, open items, delayed shipments, pending bookings, mqc performance with future forecasts while ensuring all milestones are accurate and provided timely
  • Participate in off hour origin, forwarder and vendor calls when needed
  • Standardize, document, and improve logistics processes, standard operating procedures, and playbooks, ensuring implementation of best practices across the department
  • Other items as needed by leadership including but not limited to various ad hoc analysis

Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have

  • 12+ years of international transportation experience in a fast-paced environment with at least 7 years in a leadership role for an importer (US and/or Global) or 3rd Party Logistics Provider (apparel experience is a plus)
  • BS/BA degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business Management preferred or equivalent
  • Able to hit the ground running – a confident, entrepreneurial self-starter with the ability to manage and prioritize projects to delegate tasks appropriately

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
At TL Consulting, we simplify modern complexity with advanced, sustainable engineering. As a proudly Australian-owned consultancy with over 15 years of experience, we empower businesses to innovate and achieve measurable outcomes through scalable, cloud-native solutions. Our 50+ consultants operate across key sectors including banking, financial services & insurance (BFSI), government, retail, education, and entertainment. This cross-industry expertise allows us to deliver customer-centric solutions that combine deep technical capability with a clear understanding of each client’s strategic vision. Our approach leverages proven, scalable blueprints tailored to your business direction - enabling accelerated outcomes, maximized ROI, and sustainable long-term adoption.

We maintain strategic partnerships with organizations that share our vision for a cloud-native future. Through our collaborations with Microsoft, GitHub, and Databricks, we ensure our capabilities stay aligned with evolving best practices. These partnerships also provide access to innovation programs, co-funding opportunities, and dedicated support - helping us accelerate time-to-value for our clients.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize modern data platform across Azure Databricks and Fabrics. This role will be instrumental in architecting and developing scalable data solutions using Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. A key role will be mentoring Data engineers.

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform Development

  • Design and implement robust data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows using Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
  • Architect and maintain lakehouse solutions leveraging Delta Lake and OneLake architectures
  • Optimize data processing workflows for performance, cost-efficiency, and scalability
  • Develop and maintain real-time and batch data integration solutions

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the implementation of data architecture standards and best practices
  • Mentor junior and mid-level data engineers on modern data engineering techniques
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements
  • Evaluate and recommend new technologies and tools to enhance the data platform

Data Quality & Governance

  • Implement data quality frameworks and monitoring solutions
  • Establish and enforce data governance policies and security controls
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organizational standards
  • Design and implement data lineage and metadata management solutions

Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor and optimize query performance across Databricks and Fabric environments
  • Implement cost optimization strategies for cloud data infrastructure
  • Troubleshoot complex data pipeline issues and implement solutions

Skills & Experience

Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering roles
  • 3+ years of experience in a consulting or professional services environment.
  • Proven experience in leading data engineering teams and delivering client-focused solutions.

Technical Skills:

  • Expertise in data analytics tools and platforms (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Apache Spark, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Expertise in Azure services and analytics platforms such as Databricks, Synapse and MS Fabric.
  • Strong expertise with Databricks platform including Delta Lake, Spark, and MLflow
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Synapse, Power BI, OneLake)
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for data processing
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with query optimization
  • Experience with other cloud platforms (AWS, or GCP) is a plus
  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform, ARM templates) would be a plus
  • Has worked with Databricks Assets Bundles
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for data workflows
  • Certifications in Databricks and/or Microsoft Azure
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling

Soft Skills:

  • Strong client focus and ensures effective relationships are in place with key client stakeholders to deliver that service.
  • Excellent client relationship management skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Solid experience in relationship management, conflict resolution, influencing and negotiation.
  • Must be able to work independently but also lead Consulting engagements in a highly matrixed environment (especially for short-term engagements).

  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Consulting experience in various industries (e.g., finance, healthcare, manufacturing).
  • Azure and Databricks certifications are a plus.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management tools.

WHY JOIN US

  • Be part of a dynamic consultancy firm that values innovation, growth, and professional development.
  • Lead a growing practice at the forefront of data-driven business transformation.
  • Work with diverse, top-tier clients across multiple industries, delivering impactful solutions.

This is a Sydney based, permanent opportunity and will be hybrid in nature. No agencies please. Candidates must have valid visa with full work rights in Australia. Visas will not be transferred or sponsored.

TL Consulting Group understands the importance of fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. title: RF Phased Array Engineer I
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

RF PHASED ARRAY ENGINEER I

Based at Rocket Lab's global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the RF Phased Array Engineer is responsible for the development of new RF products and systems (including Rocket Lab’s phased arrays) and assessment of COTS components. The RF Phased Array Engineer will model and simulate antenna performance for current programs and proposals. The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of antennas at the component and system level and will thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

Product Development

  • Support end to end efforts including architecture design, prototyping, integration, test, and flight development – Ensure key design decisions and developments are in alignment with product / system needs
  • Model and simulate array performance
  • Work alongside an interdisciplinary team of RF, digital, power, mechanical, thermal, and structural engineers
  • Support transition developments from new product introduction to production
  • Interface with vendors and customers
  • Develop test plans and procedures for testing active antennas – included EIRP & G/T
  • Design and development of GSE and production automation
  • Support the development of product documentation including ICDs and User Manuals

Customer/Program Support

  • Support proposals and requirements specifications to assess compliance based on existing unit capabilities vs development needs
  • Implement development activities for new requirements
  • Support engineering reviews such as PDRs, CDRs and TRRs
  • Provide technical support to internal/external customers including general questions and anomaly troubleshooting
  • Maintain broad awareness of product development and production schedules to ensure the needs of customers and programs are satisfied

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelors degree in electrical engineering, RF communications (or an equivalent qualification)
  • Fundamental RF knowledge including link budget analysis and linearity. A solid theoretical and practical understanding of RF communications and navigation systems and components
  • Basic knowledge of antenna and array modeling
  • Ability to obtain TS / SCI

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Extensive experience in space grade system design
  • Extensive experience in analyses including worst case, reliability, FMECA, thermal, and derating analyses
  • Extensive experience supporting and leading complex engineering programs and developing associated documentation
  • Experience designing, integrating, and testing RF communications systems for launch vehicles or satellites
  • Demonstrated expertise in mentoring others.
  • Experience leading incident management and investigations.
  • Experience in conflict resolution and dealing with difficult people.
  • The ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
  • Effective communication skills and the ability to build strong working relationships
  • Project management experience

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance.

Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package, giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total Compensation (base and equity)
$89,350—$115,025 USD
Base Salary
$82,400—$103,000 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

title: Operational Requirements/Acquisition Documentation Specialist

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Management, Engineering or a related field; 5–10 years of relevant experience.
  • Proficiency with the DHS Acquisition Lifecycle and developing Acquisition Decision Event documents and other related technical documentation.
  • Proven technical writing and editing experience.
  • Experience with fact-checking, citation management, and style guides.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint); advanced skills in Word’s Track Changes and document formatting.
  • Background in marketing, communications, business, or change management.
  • Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills; able to coordinate tasks and set priorities with minimal supervision.
  • Detail-oriented, team-oriented, and adaptable in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to pass a government background investigation (financial, criminal, residential, educational, foreign affiliation, prohibited substance abuse, employment verifications); active CBP background investigation preferred. U.S. citizenship required for suitability determination.

title: Recruiting Coordinator - 6-month Contract
description:
About Electra

At Electra, we’re building the EL9 — a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology unlocks thousands of new operating locations and enables what we call Direct Aviation: quiet, point-to-point regional travel that gets people from where they are to where they want to go, without the congestion of major airports or the noise of conventional aviation.

A global company, headquartered in Manassas, VA, Electra is backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell, and Safran, has filed for FAA Part 23 type certification, and carries 2,000+ intent to purchase from operators worldwide. We’re a team of ~100 people moving fast toward first EL9 test flights in 2027 and certification by late 2029 or 2030. Every hire matters at this stage — and this role is no exception.

The Role

As our Recruiting Coordinator, you'll own the day-to-day execution of Electra's interview process - spanning scheduling, panel coordination, and interview kit prep as our small TA team scales hiring across the company. You'll be the first point of contact for many of our candidates, ensuring every interaction reflects the caliber of team and mission we're building.

This is a high-visibility role at a company where candidate experience isn't an afterthought - it's part of how we represent Electra to the talent market. You'll work directly with recruiters and hiring managers across the business, keeping a high volume of interviews running smoothly and on time.

What You'll Do

  • Own interview logistics end-to-end: scheduling, panel coordination, and building interview kits
  • Manage a high volume of scheduling across multiple open reqs, juggling moving pieces without dropping the ball
  • Own candidate experience — greeting candidates onsite, getting them set up and prepped, and making sure their visit feels great
  • Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep the interview process moving smoothly
  • Troubleshoot scheduling conflicts and last-minute changes with a calm, solutions-first attitude

What You Bring

  • Prior experience as a recruiting coordinator
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle a lot of moving pieces at once
  • A warm, polished presence — you'll often be the first person our candidates meet
  • Ability to be onsite in our Manassas, VA office
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience scheduling through Greenhouse
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Familiarity with aerospace, aviation, or hardware hiring
  • Experience supporting a lean TA team where you wear multiple hats

This range reflects the anticipated hiring range across all eligible locations; actual compensation is determined based on your relevant experience, skills, and geographic location. Total compensation includes performance bonus and comprehensive benefits.

  • Paid winter break
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting
  • Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters

title: Full Time Faculty, Mathematics
description:
NorthWest Arkansas Community College (NWACC) provides quality and affordable higher education to empower lives and strengthen communities within Northwest Arkansas and surrounding areas.

As the largest community college in Arkansas, NWACC is recognized as a leader in education. NWACC offers a full range of associate degrees, certificates and workforce training programs that prepare students for rewarding futures and careers.

NWACC employees are dedicated to fostering a diverse educational community and cultural learning environment that supports student success.

Faculty members serve multiple roles as teachers, mentors, colleagues, and scholars. Full-time faculty are expected not only to excel in classroom instruction but also to fulfill various responsibilities as active members of the college and the northwest Arkansas community.

Essential Duties:

The following list of duties applies to a full-time NWACC faculty member. Please note that this faculty position includes a combination of teaching and administrative or service duties, as noted below. (Refer to Faculty Workload Policy 5009.)

  • 15 teaching load hours as defined in the faculty workload policy
  • 10 clock hours of class preparation/evaluations
  • Some combination of the following that equals 15 clock hours
  • Class related office hours
  • General student development services
  • Three “committee” hours a week (“Committee” is defined broadly as committee work, club sponsorship, work on advisory boards, tutoring, etc. This would be considered the faculty member’s service to the college.)

Instruction:

  • Facilitate student learning, provide effective instruction, and perform evaluations of student learning for all assigned classes, using each course's standard course outline as a guide
  • The standard teaching load for full-time faculty teaching credit courses is 15 load hours per semester during the nine-month employment period
  • Furthermore, this faculty position may include a combination of teaching and administrative or service duties. On occasion, faculty may receive a reduced instructional load to complete other duties related to the function of the college. Each semester's instructional load will be assigned by the faculty member's supervisor, which will be determined by the nature of the position, the needs of the department, and workload guidelines established by college policy. (Policy 5009)
  • Develop course curriculum, course handouts, lectures, labs, and presentations
  • Participate in program level learning assessment. Participation includes helping articulate learning outcomes, choosing, and administering measures, evaluating student performance, and suggesting changes to improve student learning
  • Work with other faculty and administrators in developing program curriculum, standards, and policies, including reviewing and participating in textbook selection process where appropriate
  • Schedule, supervise, debrief, and evaluate students in clinical, internship, observation, field experience, and similar settings as appropriate for the course or program.
  • Be available to meet with students. The method of contact and hours of availability should be clearly communicated to supervisors and to students through the course syllabus each semester
  • Assign grades, maintain course/student records in accordance with FERPA regulations, and submit grades and records by established deadlines
  • Meet all classes and other scheduled responsibilities, such as office hours and meetings at the designated times. A faculty member should inform the supervisor if he or she is unable to meet a class on time
  • Teach courses by alternative delivery methods as needed. The teaching load could include teaching at other facilities in Benton or Washington County and/or during the evenings or weekends. Teaching assignments will depend on the program, the course, and the needs of the students
  • Tutor at facilities in both Benton and Washington Counties. Tutor during day, afternoon, night, and/or weekend
  • Attend departmental, divisional, and college-wide meetings

Professional Development:

The following are examples of what may be considered professional development. Some of these may be required based on the nature of the program, division, and/or college policy.

  • Participate in faculty evaluation process
  • Remain current in academic or program discipline, including attending professional conferences and maintaining licensure, certification, or continuing education requirements where appropriate
  • Receive training or stay current in technological or pedagogical advances that promote student learning
  • Participate in college professional development activities

Service to the College:

The following are examples of what may be considered service to the college. Some of these may be required based on the nature of the program, division, and/or college policy.

  • Serve on standing and ad hoc committees, programmatic advisory boards, hiring committees, or faculty senate (“Committee” is defined broadly as committee work, club sponsorship, work on advisory boards, tutoring, etc.)
  • Attend local, regional, state, or national meetings where required or necessary for the discipline
  • Mentor and/or assist in orienting new faculty either formally or informally.
  • Serve as a liaison for Early College Experience faculty
  • Attend commencement or other ceremonies appropriate to the faculty member's discipline or program
  • Perform other academically related duties as assigned by the instructor's supervisor
  • Participate in faculty business meetings and forums
  • Participate in community and other educational activities outside of the college to promote and market the college, programs, and/or students and graduates

An activity or assignment is not considered service to the college if the faculty member receives a stipend, release time, or other additional payment or benefit for their participation. However, reimbursement for, or payment of, incurred travel/business expenses, pursuant to College policy and/or Federal or State regulation, is allowed.

Rate of pay: determined by faculty scale placement (education and years of experience)

Completed applications received by 9/25/2026 will be assured full consideration. Late Applications will be reviewed as necessary to fill the position.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree or higher in mathematics
  • Master’s degree or higher in a related area and possessing a minimum of 18 graduate credit hours in mathematics courses that could be applied to Master’s of Science degree in mathematics

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of the organization and administration of various higher education academic and social programs
  • Knowledge of campus and community resources
  • Knowledge of state, federal, and campus rules, regulations, and requirements related to campus academic and social programs
  • Ability to coordinate the activities of campus academic and/or social programs
  • Ability to evaluate collected information and formulate into recommendations
  • Ability to compile information into report form

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

The following physical activities described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and expectations.
While performing the functions of this job, the employee is:
Frequently:
• Manipulate items with fingers, including keyboarding
• Sitting
• Standing
• Walking
Constantly:
• Hearing
• Repetitive motion
• Talking

The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading; and/or visual inspection at distances close to the eyes.

Environmental Conditions:

The following work environment characteristics are representative of those encountered by employees while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

The work environment typically consists of a professional office setting with a moderate noise level, including sounds from conversations, office equipment, and occasional movement of staff. Lighting is standard for office spaces, and the temperature is controlled to remain within a comfortable range. Employees may occasionally need to visit other areas, such as storage rooms, conference spaces, or outdoor locations, where environmental conditions may vary. Infrequently, exposure to louder noise levels or physical activities, such as moving lightweight materials, might be required.

title: Senior Supply Chain Specialist
description:
About Electra

At Electra, we’re building the EL9 — a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology unlocks thousands of new operating locations and enables what we call Direct Aviation: quiet, point-to-point regional travel that gets people from where they are to where they want to go, without the congestion of major airports or the noise of conventional aviation.

A global company, headquartered in Manassas, VA, Electra is backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell, and Safran, has filed for FAA Part 23 type certification, and carries 2,000+ intent to purchase from operators worldwide. We’re a team of ~100 people moving fast toward first EL9 test flights in 2027 and certification by late 2029 or 2030. Every hire matters at this stage — and this role is no exception.

The Role

Electra.aero, a next-gen aerospace technology company, seeks a Supply Chain Analyst to develop and implement supply chain strategies and networks in support of programs, new business opportunities, and proposals. This role uses analytical and quantitative methods to understand, predict, and enhance supply chain processes - assembling data, analyzing performance, identifying problems, and developing recommendations that support program planning and operations.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and implement supply chain strategies and networks in support of programs, new business opportunities, and proposals
  • Use analytical and quantitative methods to understand, predict, and enhance supply chain processes
  • Assemble data, analyze performance, identify problems, and develop recommendations that support program planning and operations
  • Monitor key performance indicators and analyze cost-to-serve performance data
  • Coordinate cross-functional work teams to increase the effectiveness of supply chain initiatives
  • Analyze production planning, material procurement, inventory control, rate setting, outsourcing, vendor selection and retention, expediting, and distribution
  • Monitor contract compliance for logistics service providers and other suppliers
  • Develop analytical reports and analyses to support negotiations with suppliers of goods and services
  • Report on operational performance measurements and purchase price variance (PPV) analysis
  • Support negotiations with third-party providers as needed
  • Coordinate with other departments, as well as with distributors, transporters, storage facilities, and suppliers
  • Other duties as assigned
  • Conduct low to medium complexity sourcing processes

What You Bring

  • BS/BA degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field
  • 8+ years of experience in supply chain analysis, procurement, or logistics, preferably within aerospace or another regulated manufacturing environment
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with experience developing performance metrics and cost-to-serve models
  • Experience with production planning, inventory control, and vendor selection/retention
  • Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS procurement requirements
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP/supply chain planning tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • US Person (Citizen or Permanent Resident) required

Bonus Points

  • APICS certification (CPIM/CSCP).
  • Experience with Unanet or other aerospace ERP systems
  • AS9100D/ISO9001 audit experience
  • Experience negotiating with third-party logistics providers
  • Experience in a startup or fast-growing aerospace/manufacturing environment
  • Experience in the Aerospace market

This range reflects the anticipated hiring range across all eligible locations; actual compensation is determined based on your relevant experience, skills, and geographic location. Total compensation includes performance bonus and comprehensive benefits.

Compensation Range
$110,000—$130,000 USD

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance; STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Generous PTO, sick leave, and company holidays
  • Paid winter break
  • 401(k) with immediate vesting
  • Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters
  • Free on-site parking

Electra is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This position may be subject to ITAR requirements.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you’ll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
  • Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
  • Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
  • Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.
  • Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.
  • Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.
  • Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
  • Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
  • Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment — not a single product or team's slice of it.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.
  • Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.
  • Strong AWS cloud services background.
  • Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.
  • Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.
  • Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.
  • Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.
  • Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$165,200—$295,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Executive Recruitment Lead
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The ideal Executive Recruitment Lead is highly organized, service-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced executive environment. They are known for anticipating needs before they arise, creating exceptional experiences for candidates and stakeholders, and executing every detail with precision, professionalism, and discretion. In addition, you will have the opportunity to take initiative on a variety of projects that optimize team operations and service delivery.
Please note, this is an on-site position out of Newark, CA.
You Will:
  • Build and manage complex interview schedules across senior executives, executive assistants, multiple time zones, and office locations, proactively resolving conflicts and communicating changes with urgency and clarity.
  • Create and execute detailed executive interview itineraries, coordinating meeting rooms, interview hosts, security access, catering, technology, transportation, and candidate transitions throughout the day.
  • Coordinate all candidate travel logistics, including air, hotel, ground transportation, and special accommodations, while serving as a resource for last-minute changes or disruptions.
  • Guide candidates through travel and reimbursement processes, ensuring timely collection and tracking of receipts, approvals, invoices, and expense submissions through completion.
  • Serve as a trusted, responsive point of contact for executive candidates, delivering proactive communication, timely updates, and a high-touch, white-glove experience throughout the search process.
  • Partner closely with Executive Recruiters, C-suite leaders, Executive Assistants, Human Resources, Finance, Travel, Workplace Services, and external search firms to ensure seamless execution of executive searches.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential records, search trackers, interview materials, candidate documentation, and follow-up actions throughout the recruiting lifecycle.
  • Safeguard highly sensitive information and exercise sound judgment when handling confidential executive searches, candidate data, and business discussions.
  • Anticipate operational needs, identify process improvement opportunities, and implement solutions that enhance efficiency, candidate experience, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Ensure flawless execution of all executive recruiting activities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail, professionalism, and discretion.
You Bring:
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 4+ years of recruiting, executive recruiting operations, or complex scheduling/coordinator experience supporting multiple time zones and locations.
  • Passion for delivering an exceptional candidate experience and maintaining a high-touch, white-glove approach throughout the recruiting process.
  • Proven ability to handle confidential and highly sensitive information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong sense of urgency and responsiveness; comfortable interacting with stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing projects, adapt quickly to changing business needs, and execute effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with HR and recruiting technologies, including Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), CRM platforms, background check systems, HRIS, onboarding tools, and other recruiting technologies.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with a track record of delivering high-quality, accurate work within established deadlines.
  • Strong time management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously.
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility and trust across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Self-starter with strong problem-solving abilities, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a commitment to quality, accuracy, and operational excellence.
  • Positive, professional presence with a customer-service mindset and executive-level professionalism.
  • Working knowledge of employment and data privacy regulations, including EEOC, GDPR, and other applicable compliance requirements.

Preferred Characteristics

  • Experience supporting executive or C-suite recruiting teams.
  • Experience coordinating complex executive interviews, travel logistics, and high-profile candidate experiences.
  • Ability to anticipate needs, operate independently, and maintain composure under pressure while managing sensitive and rapidly changing situations.
  • Strong commitment to delivering seamless experiences for candidates, recruiters, executives, and business stakeholders.

title: Network Administrator (Full Time)
description:
Are We The Right Fit For You?

Are you passionate about helping others?

Do you enjoy making a difference in people’s lives?

Do you get excited about being part of a team that believes in lifelong learning and continuous improvement?

We certainly do.

We believe that work should be a place where you can have fun while doing something meaningful.

We’re currently looking for like-minded team members to join our movement, which is to provide the very best care and service to our clients.

We’ve been redefining ourselves and working towards this ideal for over 40 years. And, as times change, we change with them. We don’t claim to be perfect, but we do want to be the best place to work in Prince Edward Island. We try very hard to be there for our clients when they need us and to guide them through the changes in their lives.

But we can’t do it alone. As healthcare becomes more complex, we continually need new ideas and expertise to best serve our team and clients.

If this sounds like you, you may be a great fit for our team!

Why Join Us?

There are lots of great employers out there, and we believe that there is a right place for everyone.

We believe in lifelong learning. We’ve been out in front of and welcomed the major evolutions in the profession over the past 40 years. And we are excited about what’s next.

We understand that your time at work is an important part of your life’s journey, so we believe in providing ongoing training and opportunities for you to advance with us and within your profession.

Finally, we believe in partnering and supporting other locally owned businesses to build stronger communities, so we’ve made arrangements with a few of them to provide you with discounts on things like home heating oil, restaurants and goods and services at local retailers.

How You’ll Spend Your Time…

Like any role, there are, of course, some precise duties that will need to be performed and we’ll tell you all about them.

But there are a few simple things that will determine your success on our team, and your enjoyment in your role.

Quite simply, treat your fellow team members as you would like to be treated.

Our most successful team members will always aim to do what is right, while keeping things simple and predictable. Our team members continuously look for opportunities to improve the clients’ experience. It’s what we believe in.

What You Will Bring To The Team

Our team is client-focused and believes in a high level of attention to detail, professionalism and discretion. We also believe in lifelong learning and the ability to work under pressure. We value diverse backgrounds and what that brings to our team and we want to hear more about what makes you unique.

In addition to what makes you unique, there are a few basics that we require for this role:

· Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Administration, or a related field.

· Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in network administration, network infrastructure, or a related technical role.

· Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise network infrastructure, including firewalls, switches, wireless access points, routers, VPNs, VLANs, and internet connectivity.

· Experience with Fortinet or similar network security platforms, including firewall policy management, SD-WAN, VPN, firmware updates, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

· Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, wireless networking, network segmentation, and secure remote access.

· Demonstrated ability to lead network infrastructure projects and successfully implement technical solutions in operational environments.

· Strong understanding of IT operations, cybersecurity principles, documentation standards, change management, and infrastructure best practices.

· Excellent critical thinking, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.

· Self-directed and dependable, with the ability to manage priorities, work independently, and adapt to changing operational needs.

· Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively and meet deadlines.

· Physically capable of lifting, installing, and moving network equipment weighing approximately 25–50 lbs.

· Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to sites and work on-site as required.

· Availability to support scheduled after-hours maintenance, upgrades, incident response, and on-call requirements when needed.

· This position is physically located in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, and is an onsite role. Occasional remote work is possible.

Additional Assets:

The following certifications or equivalent experience would be considered strong assets:

· Fortinet certifications such as NSE 4, FCP Network Security, or equivalent experience

· Cisco certifications such as CCNA or equivalent network administration experience

· Microsoft Azure networking experience or certifications such as AZ-900, AZ-104, or AZ-700

· ITIL certification

      Your Role

      As a Network Administrator, you will be responsible for the setup, deployment, maintenance, patching, monitoring, documentation, and lifecycle refresh of all network infrastructure across 35+ sites. This role is accountable for ensuring secure, reliable, resilient, and high-performing connectivity across the organization’s sites and business operations. You will play a key role in supporting mission-critical network services across Murphy’s Pharmacies, Andrews Senior Care, and Atlantic Medical Centres, helping to deliver secure and dependable technology services across PEI, NL, NB, and ON.

      Key Responsibilities:

      · Administer, configure, maintain, and continuously improve all network infrastructure, including firewalls, switches, wireless access points, routers, internet connections, VPNs, VLANs, and related network services.

      · Setup, deploy, replace, patch, monitor, and refresh network infrastructure to ensure secure, stable, and reliable operations across all supported sites.

      · Own network reliability, availability, performance, and security by implementing operational standards, maintenance plans, lifecycle planning, and best practices.

As the Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, develop, integrate, and field secure software applications that support targeting and mission-planning operations. This role requires full software development lifecycle expertise, including requirements analysis, architecture, testing, deployment, and sustainment in classified environments.

What You’ll Do in Your New Role

  • Design, build, and field secure, mission-ready software supporting USPACOM J32 joint targeting and fires-planning workflows.
  • Develop operator-facing applications for Target-Effect Pairing (TEP), including ranked recommendations, alternative pairings, constraint-driven tradeoffs, and explanations.
  • Build backend services for workflow orchestration, recommendation processing, review and adjudication, approval routing, deconfliction, and draft force-assignment support.
  • Translate Joint Fires and Targeting SME input into intuitive workflows supporting Phase 3 Capabilities Analysis and Phase 4 Commander’s Decision and Force Assignment.
  • Implement human-machine teaming controls that allow authorized users to accept, reject, modify, and route recommendations while preserving human authority over inherently governmental decisions.
  • Create traceable and auditable software that records source data, model or ruleset versions, recommendation history, user actions, timestamps, and approval rationale.
  • Integrate with Government-designated systems—including Maven Smart System (MSS), object-management systems, simulation services, and command-and-control interfaces—through secure APIs and event-driven patterns.
  • Build interfaces that clearly communicate inventory constraints, timing and availability limitations, assumptions, confidence indicators, infeasible conditions, and recommended next steps.
  • Develop resilient services capable of supporting single-target, multi-target, and constrained-resource planning scenarios in connected and degraded operating conditions.
  • Implement role-based and attribute-based access controls, classification-aware data handling, secure service communication, and tamper-evident audit capabilities.
  • Create automated unit, integration, regression, performance, and security tests suitable for Government acceptance and independent test and evaluation.
  • Partner directly with J32 operators, Joint Fires and Targeting SMEs, weaponeering experts, data engineers, security teams, and Government system owners.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, operator demonstrations, technical reviews, and fielding activities in Government-designated environments.
  • Produce maintainable code, API documentation, architecture decision records, release notes, runbooks, and transition materials supporting Government operation and sustainment.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including delivery of complex, data-intensive applications.
  • Strong experience with modern front-end frameworks, backend services, RESTful APIs, event-driven architectures, relational or document databases, and automated testing.
  • Experience building workflow, mission-planning, decision-support, command-and-control, or operational intelligence applications.
  • Ability to transform complex operational and doctrinal processes into usable, explainable software.
  • Experience with data provenance, audit logging, workflow state management, access controls, and configuration or model versioning.
  • Familiarity with containerized deployments, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, observability, and secure cloud or on-premises environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with operational users and deliver incrementally through frequent demonstrations and feedback.
  • Understanding of human-centered design for high-consequence workflows where recommendations must remain transparent, reviewable, and reversible.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to operational and Government stakeholders.
  • Eligibility for TS/SCI; active clearance strongly preferred.
  • Ability to support on-site engagement with USPACOM J32 operators as mission needs require.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with joint targeting, Joint Fires, weaponeering, target-effect pairing, force assignment, or course-of-action analysis.
  • Experience working in DoD classified environments, disconnected or restricted networks, and security-compliance-driven settings.
  • Experience integrating with Maven Smart System, operational data repositories, simulation engines, or government interfaces of record.
  • Experience developing optimization or recommendation systems that present alternatives, constraints, and explainable rationale.

title: Functional Lead
description:
Overview

DecisionPoint Corporation is seeking a Principal Functional Lead to join our US Transportation Command – Global Freight Management team. The Functional Lead plays a crucial role in bridging the gap between customers and developers, ensuring that software systems meet user requirements and function as expected. They are responsible for gathering and analyzing requirements, troubleshooting issues, and assisting in the development of solutions. The role includes coordinating internal and functional testing, preparing documentation, and presenting potential solutions to customers through demonstrations and slide presentations. The Mid Business Analyst also actively participates in Agile practices such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and Joint Advisory Design (JAD) sessions. This position requires strong problem-solving skills, proficiency in Jira, Confluence, and automated testing tools, along with excellent communication skills to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

This position is remote.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

This position is responsible for the overall configuration and operation of the existing implementation and continued operations, as well as the continuous improvement of the Salesforce tools for all user groups.   • Support new and existing user base with questions and issues.

  • Design and document technical solutions aligned to business objectives; review functional designs for soundness before implementation

  • Manage and troubleshoot integrations across our ecosystem: Okta, DocuSign, Nintex DocGen, Swoogo, Zuora, HubSpot, and Slack

  • Lead or contribute to major platform initiatives (e.g., automation of support workflows, case routing/swarming)
  • Document configuration changes and decisions per WealthCounsel's internal documentation standards
  • Perform related duties as required or assigned.


Essential Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience, including Enterprise Edition / Lightning
  • Deep working knowledge of flows, validation rules, permission sets, role hierarchies, and data model design
  • Experience managing or troubleshooting third-party integrations (identity management, e-signature, document generation, or billing platforms a plus)
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication — this role requires heavy stakeholder interaction and requirements gathering across departments
  • Ability to work independently under pressure and take initiative on ambiguous or complex problems
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator II
  • Self-motivated and independent team player who takes initiative and thrives with minimal day-to-day oversight

Nice to Have:

  • Basic Apex or Lightning Web Components familiarity (occasional light customization — this is not a development-heavy role)
  • Advanced Salesforce certifications (Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist, Salesforce Certified Business Analyst)

This is a virtual, full-time position. You will work remotely from your home office, and occasional travel may be required for meetings, trade shows, and training.

Home internet and gym membership reimbursement

Many opportunities to connect with others from your home office and have fun while you work

We have an exciting opportunity for a Live-In Superintendent to join The Liberty in Pompton Lakes, NJ. The Liberty features 64 affordable one-bedroom apartments designed for seniors and veterans. The Superintendent ensures regulatory compliance with NFPA, OSHA, NJHFMA, HUD, and Fair Housing standards as applicable, and leads strategic planning for long-term infrastructure improvements. Technical expertise in HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical systems is essential.   • Ability to troubleshoot and maintain HVAC equipment.

  • Coordinates the repair of equipment or recommends the replacement of, additions to, equipment or physical plant as necessary.
  • Makes repairs on systems across all trade disciplines (i.e., tearing down boilers, pumps).

  • Monitors its applications to assure maximum effectiveness and provides appropriate documentation of the same.
  • Conducts rounds to detect safety and mechanical issues/concerns (i.e., walking or driving).

  • Supports preparation and organization of documentation for inspections conducted by Pompton Lakes, Passaic County, the State of New Jersey, NJ Housing Mortgage and Finance Agency, Department of Community Affairs, or other regulatory agencies, and actively participates in the inspection process.

  • Accurately estimates and orders materials.
  • Provides leadership to complete projects utilizing a project team.
  • Participates in the development and application of standards of quality and productivity for the Maintenance Department.
  • Supervises The Liberty Maintenance and EVS.
  • Maintains inventory of repair and replacement parts.
  • Creates and closes work orders in Yardi.
  • Demonstrates strong knowledge of all Physical Plant systems in all buildings.
  • Demonstrates proficiency with technology and software systems, including Yardi and email platforms; writes and responds to emails clearly and professionally, showing strong reading comprehension and communication skills.
  • Reports safety deficiencies to the Director of Plant Operation Managers.
  • Understands and practices wiring methods as per N.F.P.A 70.
  • Familiar with N.F.P.A. article 700 Emergency Systems.
  • Familiar with OSHA Regulations.
  • Understands and applies proper grounding of equipment.
  • Keeps abreast of current federal and state regulations, as well as professional standards, and makes recommendations on changes in programming/services and related policies and procedures.
  • Works on snow removal operations.
  • Remains available for after-hours emergency calls, responding promptly to urgent facility issues to ensure resident safety and minimize disruption.
  • Maintain professional and respectful relationships with all residents at all times.
  • Maintenance staff are strictly prohibited from performing personal favors, giving preferential treatment, or completing work that has not been issued through the official work order system.
  • Employees may not perform any maintenance, repairs, or tasks for residents on their own time, whether paid or unpaid. All work must be authorized by our policies and documented properly.
  • Tipping, payment, or gifts of any kind are not permitted. Maintenance employees may not solicit, accept, or agree to accept cash, checks, gift cards, food, goods, or any form of compensation or gratuity from residents, their families, or guests, regardless of the amount or intent. Accepting or requesting a tip, gift, or personal favor is considered a serious violation of company policy and may result in immediate disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

  • Any resident requests received after hours must be directed to the community’s emergency maintenance procedure.
