The Senior Data Scientist is responsible for developing, validating, deploying, and monitoring advanced predictive analytics solutions that drive risk, marketing, and business decision-making across the bank. This role combines deep expertise in traditional statistical modeling and machine learning with the ability to apply emerging AI technologies to solve complex business challenges.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader within the Data Science & Modeling organization, partnering with business stakeholders, technology teams, and senior leadership to deliver robust analytical solutions. Experience with modern machine learning techniques is required. Exposure to deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and generative AI technologies is highly desirable.

  • Develops, validates, and maintains predictive models supporting Credit Risk, Marketing, Balance/Revenue forecasting, Direct Mail Response, and account-level valuation domains.
  • Provides end-to-end ownership of the model development lifecycle, including problem framing, conceptual design, data analysis, model construction, validation, documentation, deployment, and user enablement.
  • Applies traditional statistical techniques, including logistic regression, generalized linear models, clustering, and forecasting methods.
  • Designs and implements machine learning solutions using techniques such as gradient boosting, random forests, ensemble methods, and other advanced analytical approaches.
  • Develops model monitoring frameworks to ensure ongoing model performance, stability, fairness, and regulatory compliance. Investigate performance issues, identify root causes, and recommend appropriate corrective actions when models do not perform as expected.
  • Performs complex data analysis and communicate insights, recommendations, and model performance to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Supports model governance, validation, compliance reviews, and regulatory examinations through comprehensive documentation and transparent methodologies.
  • Researches, assesses, and prototypes emerging AI technologies, including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and generative AI applications.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in quantitative fields (e.g. Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Economics, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field) is required.
  • PhD in a quantitative field is preferred.
  • At least one (1) year of hands-on experience building predictive models, machine learning solutions, or advanced analytics applications in financial services or other highly regulated industries.

Knowledge, Skills and Capabilities:

  • Experience developing and deploying production-ready analytical solutions.
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling methodologies, including logistic regression, linear models, segmentation, forecasting, and model validation techniques.
  • Strong expertise in machine learning algorithms and model development workflows.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python, R, and SQL.
  • Experience working with large and complex data sets.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to business stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

With more opportunity than ever to innovate and create new, authentic experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and immersion to fans everywhere, we invite you to join us as we pioneer the future of football with EA SPORTS FC, and welcome everyone to the club!

Reporting to a Lead Producer, the FC Live Content Producer works closely with the production, product management, art, and quality verification teams to create compelling live content for EA SPORTS FC.

The FC Live Content Producer will have a rare mix of strategic knowledge, creative instinct that can translate data and ideas into relevant plans that benefit our players. You will also need a good eye for product quality and consumer usability. You have great attention to detail, and you will have taken into account every possibility within your creation.

If you enjoy working on a production team, developing content for millions of fans, while evaluating existing ideas/processes and coming up with new ones, this is the role for you!


Responsibilities:

The FC Live Content Producer will work with others on the team to build live content designs, using complex spreadsheets, design documents and internal tools.

  • Translate real-world football events into live content ideas/plans on short notice, which may sometimes require flexible work hours to mirror real-world football events.
  • Develop live content plans and strategies to implement with the goal of retaining and engaging players, based on data you have collected from dashboards, peers or through other research.
  • Work directly in custom tools to create, verify, and publish live content to our players.
  • Work with the quality verification team to ensure all content is at the expected quality standards.
  • Work with other Producers to meet deadlines, targets and priority changes.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and art teams to coordinate deliverables and ensure the highest quality and success.
  • Become an expert on the game and our community, drawing from our large, varied player base and our past games to make and defend intelligent design choices going forward.
  • Be resourceful and solve problems using the tools and time/scope available to create unique and fun experiences for players.
  • Have an eye for establishing and improving processes to make life easier for the Content Production team.
  • Help establish best practices for the team and lead by example.


Your Skills & Experience:

  • 2-4 years experience working on a live service product, with relevant experience in production, product management, quality verification or game design being a plus.
  • High levels of attention to detail, with a proven track record of being able to spot defects or issues that may not be apparent at first glance.
  • Good eye for game quality and advocate for the end-user experience.
  • You are a football (soccer) fan and you are familiar with players, teams and leagues from the men’s and women’s game.
  • Experience with game production tools and Project Management software are a plus.
  • Experience working with a remote team through all phases of the live product cycle.
  • An understanding of the core mechanics of Ultimate Team and other core game modes within FC.
  • Ability to think outside the box to solve complex time sensitive problems.
  • Knowledge and proficiency in improving team efficiencies and processes.
  • A/B testing knowledge.
  • Knowledge of in-game economy management and power curve balancing.

title: Real Estate Showing Agent
description:
Showami is a service that licensed real estate agents use to earn money by assisting with buyer and rental showings, light inspection reports, Open Houses and other real estate tasks. We are seeking licensed real estate agents in Tuckerman and surrounding areas to assist with various real estate tasks.

Requirements:

You must be a currently licensed real estate agent ( We can help you get licensed )

You must have access to the MLS

You must have experience showing homes in the Tuckerman area.

You must be able to show homes using an electronic lockbox

Agents will be paid an average of $34 or more per task with the opportunity to receive a tip for a job well done. Often times there are several homes shown to a single client. You will be paid for each home shown.

Showami is not a real estate brokerage. Licensed agents will stay with their current brokerage. We are a service that connects agents and have been called "The Uber of Real Estate". We provide Showing Agents and Showing Assistants in West Virginia.

To participate you must have full MLS access and the ability to schedule and show homes. In many markets that requires the ability to use an electronic lockbox.

If you are unlicensed, Showami can help. We have access to discount real estate licensing classes and can help refer you to brokerages in your area once licensed.

title: Compliance Counsel
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Help safeguard Everpure’s integrity and foster a culture of ethical excellence as our Associate Compliance Counsel (IC2). In this impactful role, you will apply your developing legal expertise to solve a variety of compliance and ethics challenges, playing a key part in mitigating legal risk across our global business. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams—including Legal, HR, Finance, and Operations—to maintain robust internal controls, evaluate partner risk, and build engaging compliance programs. If you are eager to protect our brand, champion high standards, and grow your career within a fast-paced technology leader, this role provides the ideal platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Strengthen Ethics and Compliance Education: Design, launch, and refine creative global training programs and company-wide events, such as Everpure’s annual Compliance Week, to drive active employee engagement and build policy awareness across international teams.

  • Assess and Mitigate Risk: Conduct risk-based due diligence and evaluations for prospective third-party vendors and channel partners, safeguarding Everpure’s supply chain and go-to-market channels from bribery, corruption, and regulatory exposures.

  • Guide Policy & Exception Management: Review day-to-day business requests, evaluate policy exceptions, and administer policy acknowledgment tracking to ensure consistent operational compliance with domestic and international regulations.

  • Support Internal Investigations & Reporting: Participate directly in internal compliance reviews and investigations by assisting with witness interviews, evidence analysis, document reviews, and drafting summary reports for senior legal leadership.

  • Monitor Regulatory Trends: Track emerging global regulatory, legislative, and industry developments—particularly in areas such as anti-bribery/anti-corruption, privacy, and export controls—to help update internal procedures proactively.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Core Legal Qualifications: Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and active bar admission (or pending application) in at least one jurisdiction.

  • Compliance & Legal Expertise: Broad understanding of global regulatory standards and risk areas—including anti-bribery/anti-corruption, privacy, trade compliance, or competition law—gained through law firm practice, in-house legal departments, or government/regulatory agency work.

  • Analytical & Investigative Skills: Proven ability to evaluate varied facts, exercise sound legal judgment within defined policies, conduct thorough legal research, and assist with structured witness interviews or internal reviews.

  • Collaborative Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with a track record of building productive cross-functional relationships and explaining legal concepts clearly to non-legal business partners.

  • Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


INCLUDE FOR POSTING LOCATION IDENTIFICATION

#LI-ONSITE

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

$126,000—$189,000 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

title: Associate Director of Residential Management
description:
The Associate Director of Residential Management provides strategic financial oversight, market intelligence, and performance accountability for an assigned portfolio of residential communities, working in close partnership with the Director of Residential Management. This role strengthens the connection between financial analysis, market intelligence, and operational execution through the review and approval of budgets and expenditures within designated authority, evaluation of portfolio performance, and assessment of vendor and capital opportunities that support long-term property value. The Associate Director partners closely with the Director of Residential Management, Regional Managers, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to translate financial and market data into actionable recommendations and support execution of Company priorities. For assigned communities, the role also leads property-level business planning and strategic evaluation, partnering with Finance and operations to identify opportunities that strengthen performance, competitive positioning, and long-term value.

NOTE: As the business needs of each location may vary, so do the specific tasks. This is intended to be a generalized description.
Regional Manager Accountability & Team Leadership
  • Partner with the Director of Residential Management on succession planning, leadership development, and team performance matters.
  • Reinforce a culture of accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement across the Regional Manager team.
  • Support onboarding, development, and performance management of Regional Managers as appropriate.
Financial Analysis & Budget Oversight
  • Review detailed financial variances, reclassifications, and accruals for accuracy and completeness prior to Director review.
  • Approve budgets prepared by Regional Managers prior to Director review, ensuring alignment with Company financial expectations.
  • Approve operational expenditures within designated authority limits, pending the Company's ability to adjust approval thresholds within Yardi.
  • Analyze financial statements, budget performance, and key operational metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities across the portfolio.
  • Support the development of financial models, reporting tools, and performance benchmarks that strengthen portfolio-level decision-making.
  • Help ensure financial decisions support both current performance and long-term asset value.
Portfolio Strategy & Business Planning
  • Work in collaboration with multiple teams, including Regional Manager, to develop and maintain a written annual business plan for each assigned community in conjunction with the annual budget process, including measurable financial, operational, leasing, and capital objectives.
  • Review community performance against approved business plans throughout the year and recommend adjustments when market conditions, operating results, or property needs change.
  • Evaluate and recommend property-level strategies to improve performance and long-term value, including value-add opportunities, repositioning initiatives, capital prioritization, and other strategic interventions.
  • Assess market fundamentals, competitive properties, new supply and development pipeline, rent positioning, and other external factors that may affect community strategy or future performance.
Market Intelligence & Performance Measurement
  • Participating in Revenue Management calls, making pricing recommendations based on current market conditions, and collaborating with the Revenue Manager to establish bi-weekly goals.
  • Review revenue management performance and pricing recommendations for assigned communities; participate in recurring pricing calls and challenge or support strategy based on occupancy, leasing velocity, exposure, competitive positioning, and market conditions.
  • Maintain current awareness of market comparables, concessions, occupancy trends, new deliveries, and development pipeline to support pricing and broader property strategy.
  • Develop and maintain performance measurement tools that track portfolio results against Company goals and market benchmarks.
  • Translate financial and market data into clear, actionable insight for Regional Managers and Company leadership.
  • Identify performance gaps across the portfolio and partner with Regional Managers on targeted, well-supported improvement plans.
  • Support the Director of Residential Management in preparing performance reporting for executive leadership and ownership.
Capital, Vendor & Operational Oversight
  • Support the residential renovation program in partnership with Regional Managers and the Capital/Project Management Team, including participation in recurring renovation meetings and follow up on scope, pace, budget, premium achievement, and execution.
  • Monitor and maintain the renovation tracker ensuring unit status, scope, costs, completion dates, achieved premiums, and other key data are accurate, current.
  • Resolve escalated resident issues that require additional authority, discretion, or cross-functional coordination.
  • Support Regional Managers in resolving significant operational issues and escalated matters as needed.
  • Monitor operational consistency across communities and help ensure Company standards, policies, and procedures are reinforced.
Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Partnership
  • Serve as a key connector between the Director of Residential Management and the Regional Manager team.
  • Partner with corporate departments, including Accounting, Human Resources, and the Capital/Project Management Team, to support alignment and execution across the residential portfolio.
  • Work closely with Portfolio Management to connect property-level operating strategy with financial analysis, forecasting, business plan assumptions, and performance reporting.
  • Communicate performance expectations, financial priorities, and accountability standards clearly to Regional Managers.
  • Support productive relationships with ownership groups, vendors, and other internal or external stakeholders as needed.
Reporting & Administrative Leadership
  • Prepare and review reports, audits, and financial summaries to support informed decision-making by the Director of Residential Management and executive leadership.
  • Maintain organized, accurate documentation of budget approvals, expenditure decisions, and performance reviews.
  • Participate in leadership meetings, planning discussions, training, and professional development opportunities.
  • Help ensure follow-through on major financial and operational priorities across the residential portfolio.
  • Provide the Director of Residential Management with clear recommendations on community strategy, performance risks, value-creation opportunities, repositioning considerations, and potential disposition timing for assigned communities.
Skills/Abilities and Knowledge
  • Exceptionally strong financial and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret financial statements, budgets, and performance metrics in detail
  • Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and performance improvement across a team
  • Knowledge of real estate principles and multifamily property operations
  • Strong leadership abilities with a focus on team development
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage diverse teams and stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently while exercising discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment
  • Ability to analyze market data, competitive positioning, and portfolio performance trends
  • Ability to develop and manage written community business plans that translate financial and market analysis into clear operating priorities and measurable outcomes
  • Ability to evaluate value-add, repositioning, revenue growth, and disposition considerations and present well-supported strategic recommendations to senior leadership
  • High attention to detail and accuracy, with strong numerical aptitude
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
  • Ability to quickly learn and effectively use property management and financial systems
  • Familiarity with leasing platforms and market analytics tools
  • Understanding of operational policies, procedures, safety standards, and compliance requirements
  • Knowledge of accounting principles, capital budgeting, and financial reporting practices
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and analytical skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated reliability with a commitment to consistent attendance and dependability
  • Ability to respond appropriately to emergency situations
  • Driving is an essential function of the position
  • Ability to communicate in English when working with clients or coworkers; additional languages may be used if preferred by all parties
Education (level and type)
  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
Required Work Experience
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in multifamily property management
  • At least 2–3 years in a senior leadership, regional oversight, or asset management portfolio strategy or investment performance capacity
Certifications and/or Licenses

Weekend Inpatient Psychiatrist

This role is responsible for the diagnosis and treatment of mental illnesses through a combination of personal counseling (psychotherapy), psychoanalysis, hospitalization and/or medication.

Pacific Grove Hospital is a 68-bed acute psychiatric and chemical dependency hospital. The one-story building is situated on 4.5 acres in the heart of Riverside, California. Our Comprehensive Treatment Network

~23,500 Employees · ~11,400 Beds · 258 Locations · 38 States · 1 Network

title: Director of Innovation
description:
Company Overview

Why Choose Us?

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

Our Sustainability Commitment

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Job Description

Position Summary

The Director of Innovation leads new product development and innovation programs supporting Novolex's Distribution, International Industrial, and Beverage businesses. This role translates customer needs, market insights, technology opportunities, and business priorities into a focused innovation pipeline and drives programs from concept through commercialization. The position is designed for a high-impact innovation leader with the capability and potential to progress into a Senior Director role with broader portfolio, organizational, and strategic leadership responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the innovation and new product development portfolio across assigned business units, aligning priorities with growth strategies, customer needs, and commercial opportunities.
  • Own complex NPD programs from opportunity identification and business case through development, validation, scale-up, launch, and post-launch review.
  • Drive disciplined project and program management, including scope, milestones, resources, risks, financial targets, and executive-level portfolio reporting.
  • Partner across Product Management, Sales, R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Procurement, Sustainability, and suppliers to accelerate commercialization, acting as a connector across departments to surface innovative thinking and enable execution.
  • Translate voice of customer, competitive intelligence, market trends, sustainability requirements, and emerging technologies into actionable product and technology roadmaps.
  • Provide technical leadership in flexible and food packaging, materials, converting processes, product performance, and design for manufacturability.
  • Engage directly with customers and commercial teams to identify unmet needs, facilitate innovation sessions, and develop differentiated solutions and value propositions.
  • Drive awareness and adoption of innovation programs across the organization.
  • Define KPIs, track impact, and report on outcomes of innovation initiatives.
  • Build organizational capability by improving innovation processes, mentoring cross-functional teams, and establishing scalable practices that support future portfolio growth.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Packaging Science/Engineering, Materials or Polymer Science, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, or related technical discipline required; Master's degree strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive packaging, product development, engineering, innovation, or related manufacturing experience, with demonstrated leadership of complex commercialization programs.
  • Strong project and program management experience; PMP or formal program management training is a plus.
  • Experience in flexible packaging and food packaging strongly preferred; beverage, industrial, distribution, or international market experience is a plus.
  • Strong manufacturing orientation with experience translating product concepts into scalable, commercially viable production solutions.
  • Experience using market insights, customer research, competitive intelligence, and industry trends to shape innovation strategy is highly desirable.
  • Strong executive communication, cross-functional influence, analytical thinking, business acumen, and ability to lead across multiple priorities without direct authority.

Leadership & Career Path

This role is positioned as a key feeder for broader Senior Director leadership. Success requires more than project execution: the Director will be expected to shape portfolio strategy, influence business-unit growth priorities, develop organizational capability, and demonstrate the ability to lead increasingly complex, cross-business innovation programs.

Measures of Success

  • Strength and strategic value of the innovation pipeline and product roadmaps.
  • Speed, predictability, and quality of NPD execution and commercialization.
  • Revenue, margin, customer adoption, and value creation from new products.
  • Cross-functional leadership, manufacturing readiness, and organizational innovation capability.

Position Overview

The Business Analyst, Risk Management is responsible for delivering data-driven insights that support portfolio risk monitoring, management reporting, and strategic decision-making. This role develops and maintains reporting solutions, dashboards, and portfolio analytics to identify emerging risks, measure portfolio performance, and support risk mitigation initiatives. The analyst partners with business stakeholders to enhance reporting capabilities, monitor key risk indicators, and provide actionable analysis that strengthens portfolio oversight and risk management practices.

Summary of Primary Duties and Responsibilities

The Business Analyst is an LA-based position on a hybrid schedule with at least three (3) days in-office. This position will report to the Director, Risk Management. While not an exhaustive list, the Business Analyst will be responsible for:

  • Produce management reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses for senior leadership and risk management teams.
  • Develop and maintain portfolio analytics to support risk assessment and business decision-making.
  • Manage Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting and exception reporting processes.
  • Analyze trends and provide insights on portfolio performance, risk exposure, and operational metrics.
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting platforms.
  • Monitor watchlist migration activity and asset performance trends.
  • Identify and analyze concentration risks across geography, property type, sponsor, industry, and other portfolio segments.
  • Support portfolio surveillance initiatives through ongoing risk monitoring and reporting.
  • Track workout activity, reperforming rates, and portfolio remediation efforts.
  • Escalate emerging portfolio risks and provide recommendations to support proactive risk management.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Real Estate, or related field.

  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and software such as Excel, SQL, and data visualization platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Expert troubleshooting skills to investigate resolve and escalate problems.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Salesforce certifications are a plus

Compensation

This position is exempt full-time, with salary range: $75,000 - 95,000 depending on experience level, plus discretionary bonus potential.

Benefits

This position is eligible for the following benefits:

  • Annual discretionary bonus program.
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance.
  • 401K with Safe Harbor contribution.
  • Two weeks (ten days) paid time away excluding sick time.
  • Six sick days.
  • Ten paid holidays
  • One floating holiday.

title: Program Director (Mental Health Services)
description:
Overview

The ACCS Program Director oversees the clinical, financial and administrative operation of a GLE/SIE program that is designed to promote independence, community integration and full functioning of adults receiving mental health services. Based out of a Group Living Environment (GLE) or Supported Independent Environment (SIE), the ACCS Program Director will create a helping environment in the residence in which all are welcome, respected and valued by upholding Vinfen and DMH policies, supervising staff and coordinating clinical services within the program.

Keywords: mental health, behavioral health, developmental disabilities, intellectual disabilities, ABI, acquired brain injury, care worker, care giver, social services, counseling, social work, group home, DSP, DDS, DMH, Direct Care, psychology, mental health, disability, rehabilitative, outreach services, human services, nonprofit, autism, crisis, trauma, advocacy, recovery

Responsibilities

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

The essential job duties/responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to the information listed below:

• Promote the engagement, housing permanency, community tenure, achievement of greater self-sufficiency and successful completion of tenure at the residence for all PS at the site.• Manage a GLE or SIE residential site’s systems and procedures, including planning and implementing regulations and requirements, quality improvement initiatives, and intakes and discharges from residence.• Collaborate with Team’s Housing Coordinator to facilitate successful and timely transitions to and from the group residential site.• Create a helping environment in the residence in which family, friends, and others important in the lives of PS are welcome, respected and valued.• Promote teamwork between Team and GLE/SIE staff to provide all Treatment Plan interventions in and out of residence as needed.• At the direction of the LPHA Clinician, ensure that the non-clinical support interventions of each resident’s Treatment Plan are completed as outlined.• Implement Safety Plans and Crisis Prevention and Response Plans as developed by Team for residents.• Assist the LPHA Clinician in managing the quality and timeliness of residential staffs’ Treatment Plan documentation and Medicaid Rehab Option standards adherence.• Monitor the staffs’ use of evidence-based practice techniques, request additional training from Team staff as needed.• Support the provision of evidence-based practices and best practices to PS, including Motivational Interviewing; Harm Reduction; Housing First; Stages of Change; Wellness Recovery Action Plans(WRAP); Seeking Safety and Cognitive Behavioral interventions.

• Manage the site’s DMH licensing adherence.• Maintain the residence’s adherence to Medication Administration Program policies and procedures.• Manage residential sites’ collection and use of resources including food stamps, program fees, representative payee accounts and Client Funds. Monitor expenses and residence’s budget. Submit information for billing procedures.• Manage adverse events, including Incident Reporting; ensure corrective actions are implemented.• Oversee Human Rights policies and procedures for residence.• Ensure the maintenance, repair and safety of the residence.• Maintain “good neighbor” relationships with residence’s neighbors.• Maintain strong working alliances with other service providers of the PS in the residence, including Care Coordination entities.• Hire, orient, provide day-to-day supervision of, and evaluate residence’s staff. Offer consistent and direct performance feedback. Conduct corrective action procedures for residential staff if needed.• Manage relief and overtime resources to maintain operational excellence.• Implement retention, recognition and awards initiatives for residence staff; provide career development guidance and broadcast promotion opportunities.• Ensure required residential Performance Measures are maintained.• Support staff training in, and use of trauma informed, recovery-oriented, person-centered, culturally competent and strengths-based approaches and skills training techniques in their work.• Provide thorough and thoughtful documentation of PS needs and services.• Promote healthcare, employment and education services access for PS.• Participate as member of regional GLE/SIE Program Director Community of Practice Workgroup for continuous professional role competency development, mentoring and learning.• Provides on-call coverage as assigned.• Perform other related duties, as assigned.

Our services and advocacy promote the recovery, resiliency, habilitation, and self-determination of the people we serve. Vinfen's 3,500 dedicated employees are experienced, highly-trained professionals who provide a full range of supportive living, health, educational, and clinical services in over 550 sites throughout Massachusetts and Connecticut. For more information about Vinfen, please visit www.vinfen.org/careers.

title: Director Data, AI & Enterprise Business Systems
description:
Job Title: Director Data, AI & Enterprise Business Systems

Location: Richmond, Indiana
Work Schedule: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

Position Overview:

We Are seeking a strategic and technically experienced Director of Data, AI & Enterprise Business Systems to lead the people, platforms, and practices supporting data, analytics, automation, AI governance, and enterprise business systems.

The Director will oversee a multidisciplinary portfolio spanning data and AI governance, data engineering and architecture, enterprise analytics including Epic Cogito, application integration, robotic process automation, test automation, and the Workday ERP platform.

The role is approximately 70% strategic leadership and 30% hands-on technical depth, working closely with clinical, operational, financial, HR, IT, Information Security, and executive stakeholders to improve decision-making, strengthen governance, reduce manual effort, and increase trust in enterprise data and systems.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop and communicate the strategic roadmap, annual goals, and objectives for data, AI, automation, analytics, and enterprise systems.
  • Build and champion an Analytics & Insights Center of Excellence.
  • Lead cross-functional prioritization across business, clinical, and IT stakeholders.
  • Establish and manage enterprise data governance, including data definitions, ownership, stewardship, retention, and data classification.
  • Govern the intake, review, documentation, monitoring, and retirement of AI and machine learning models used for clinical and operational decisions.
  • Partner with Information Security on access controls, minimum-necessary requirements, and third-party data sharing.
  • Direct data engineering, data platforms, data architecture, enterprise data warehousing, and data archiving.
  • Own data pipeline reliability, load schedules, source-system inventories, data flows, and downstream dependencies.
  • Lead clinical and business analytics, including reporting, dashboards, self-service analytics, advanced analytics, and data science.
  • Own the Epic Cogito environment, including Caboodle and Clarity, report certification, and analyst enablement.
  • Ensure consistent and accurate reporting across Finance, Quality, Operations, and other business functions.
  • Support regulatory, quality, and value-based care reporting requirements.
  • Lead application integration and interface operations, including new builds, upgrades, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish integration standards covering HL7, FHIR, and APIs.
  • Develop and manage the organization's RPA program, including process intake, development, deployment, and production support.
  • Lead automated testing and regression testing for enterprise applications, including Epic and Workday release cycles.
  • Own the Workday ERP platform roadmap, release adoption, configuration governance, security model, reporting, Prism content, and data feeds.
  • Partner with Finance, Human Resources, and Supply Chain on Workday-related business processes.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring, and strategic direction to managers and individual contributors.
  • Build cross-training and succession plans to ensure operational continuity across enterprise platforms.
  • Lead cross-functional projects from initiation through delivery and maintain quality throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex production issues and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Oversee change management and release governance across the portfolio.
  • Manage budgets, vendors, contracts, licensing, renewals, and technology investments across data, analytics, AI, RPA, and Workday.


Requirements

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in data, analytics, enterprise applications, IT, or healthcare.
  • Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing cross-functional teams, including managers or team leads.
  • Strong hands-on background in data warehousing, analytics, and visualization.
  • Experience with data architecture and scalable self-service data and reporting solutions.
  • Experience owning at least one enterprise platform through its full lifecycle, from selection or upgrade through steady-state support.
  • Strong strategic leadership, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with executive, clinical, operational, financial, and technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, mathematics, statistics, computer science, health informatics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Master's degree in a related field is preferred.

    Technical Requirements:
  • Epic Cogito
  • Epic Caboodle
  • Epic Clarity
  • Enterprise data architecture and data warehousing
  • Business intelligence and enterprise analytics
  • Data governance and data management
  • Workday ERP
  • Workday Prism
  • HL7 / FHIR / APIs
  • Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
  • Automated and regression testing
  • AI/ML governance and monitoring
  • Cloud data platforms and consumption-based services
  • Data classification, retention, and enterprise data governance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Provider-side healthcare experience with Epic, Cogito, Caboodle, and Clarity.
  • Workday ERP ownership across Finance, HCM, or Supply Chain.
  • Interface engine and healthcare integration experience, including HL7 and FHIR.
  • Experience building or managing an RPA program.
  • Experience with AI or machine learning models in production, including monitoring and governance.
  • Familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or comparable AI risk frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms and consumption-based cloud services.
  • Epic Cogito certification.
  • Workday certification.
  • CHDA, CPHIMS, or cloud data platform certification.

Leadership & Engagement Expectations:

  • Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams across data, analytics, AI, integration, RPA, testing, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish clear priorities and accountability across multiple technology functions.
  • Partner with clinical, operational, Finance, HR, Information Security, and executive leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement, automation, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain strong data confidentiality and comply with healthcare privacy and governance requirements.
  • Participate in change management, release governance, and enterprise technology planning.
  • Travel between office, hospital, and other Reid Health locations may be required.

Success Measures:

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Business leaders being able to access trusted information without unnecessary reporting requests.
  • Consistent and reconciled measures across Finance, Quality, and Operations.
  • AI and predictive models having documented ownership, use cases, and monitoring.
  • Interface failures being identified through proactive monitoring.
  • RPA solutions delivering measurable efficiency and error reduction.
  • Workday releases being implemented on schedule with regression testing completed.
  • Effective budget, vendor, and technology management.
  • Strong team retention, development, and internal promotion.

Work Environment:

  • Hybrid work arrangement.
  • Expected onsite presence 2–3 days per week, or more frequently based on business needs.
  • No regular weekend or holiday work.
  • No regular different-shift requirement.
  • Travel may be required between Reid Health locations.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively with physicians, clinicians, regulatory agencies, and Reid Health personnel.
  • Ability to walk throughout hospital and ambulatory locations for meetings.
  • Ability to lift up to 20 pounds occasionally.

title: Grading Operator
description:
Voor onze fabriek in Bergen op Zoom zijn wij op zoek naar een:

Grading operator

Grading heeft betrekking op het ontvangen, lossen, schonen (scheiden aardappelen van loof, stenen, klei, verwijderen defects), sorteren (lengte/diameter) en tenslotte bunkeren van aardappelen. Het integrale proces vindt plaats met behulp van diverse installaties/machines en is volledig geautomatiseerd. Op basis van kwaliteit van partijen aardappelen adviseer jij als grading operator over de samenstelling (blend) van te verwerken partijen aardappelen om de gewenste kwaliteit voor de te produceren producten te realiseren. Je rapporteert aan de Supervisor. De functie wordt in 5-ploegendienst uitgevoerd, waarbij ook in de weekenden wordt gewerkt.

Hoe ziet je werk er uit?

  • Je stemt de lopende zaken en bijzonderheden af voor een soepele overdracht bij ploegenwisseling;
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het afstemmen van de te verwerken partijen aardappelen;
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de installaties op de juiste manier zijn opgebouwd en ingesteld en dat ze hygiënisch op orde zijn;
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het regelen en onder controle houden van het proces op jouw afdeling;
  • Je voert kwaliteitscontroles uit en op basis daarvan stuur je bij waar nodig is;
  • Samen met je collega’s, ook van andere afdelingen, streef je naar optimale resultaten;
  • Je ziet waar zaken beter kunnen en neemt hiertoe dan ook initiatief;
  • Je verricht schoonmaakwerkzaamheden en je zorgt ervoor dat jouw afdeling er altijd netjes bij ligt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent enthousiast, leergierig en je ben niet vies van hard werken;
  • Je bent in het bezit van een afgeronde (operator) opleiding op MBO niveau 3 of 4 of je bent bereid om deze te gaan volgen;
  • Je bent in staat zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken, sociaal vaardig, flexibel en je weet van aanpakken.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een groeiende organisatie waar veel geïnvesteerd wordt in nieuwe technieken;
  • Veel mogelijkheden om door te groeien en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;
  • Een ploegentoeslag van 30,8%;
  • Een prima pakket arbeidsvoorwaarden met naast je basissalaris o.a.: 8,33% vakantietoeslag, 4% einde boekjaar uitkering, de pensioen premie betaald door de werkgever en 22 vakantiedagen;
  • We hebben tweewekelijks productenverkoop met flinke korting voor onze medewerkers.

We bieden jou een uitdagende baan in een dynamische en groeiende organisatie in de food branche. We dagen je uit

om te groeien op dezelfde manier als onze organisatie, waarbij ontwikkeling essentieel is. We zijn op ons best als we gezamenlijke waarde creëren door samen te werken, integer te handelen en afspraak is afspraak te hanteren. Alleen zo kunnen wij de beste win-win situatie creëren. En dat in, ambitieuze, hard werkende en toegewijde teams. Voor het harde werken word je ook goed beloond, we kennen een mooi pakket arbeidsvoorwaarden met een prima salaris.

title: Staff AI Product Engineer
location: Houston; New York; San Francisco; Seattle
description:
About Nscale

Nscale is taking on the hyperscalers by building a vertically integrated GenAI cloud platform. We own the data centers, software, and applications that power today's AI stack using sustainable technology solutions. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As a Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Collaboration is key, and we work together swiftly and respectfully, embracing adaptability and resilience in all we do.

About the Role

Nscale is looking for a Staff AI Engineer (Specialized) to set technical direction for the inference and reinforcement learning systems at the core of our AI services platform — and for the APIs through which other engineers consume them.

This role owns the architecture of how models are served on Nscale’s GPU cloud, how RL and post-training workloads run on it, and how both are exposed to customers and internal teams as clean, reliable, high-performance interfaces. You’ll work across 2–4 teams spanning serving, post-training, and platform, defining how these systems are built and establishing the standards that create engineering leverage across the organization.

As a Staff engineer, you are the technical authority for this area of the AI stack. Your decisions determine the latency, throughput, and cost profile of every token Nscale serves, and the correctness and efficiency of every RL run on our platform. You resolve ambiguous architectural questions where the answer space is genuinely open — disaggregated versus co-located serving, on-policy versus off-policy RL infrastructure, where the API boundary should sit — and your solutions become the standards others build on.

Responsibilities

Inference

  • Set technical direction for Nscale’s inference serving architecture: request routing, scheduling, continuous batching, KV cache management, prefix caching, and speculative decoding
  • Drive the strategy for model efficiency in production — quantization (FP8, INT8/4), sparsity, pruning, distillation, and MoE serving — and the trade-offs between cost, latency, throughput, and model quality
  • Lead the resolution of systemic performance and reliability challenges across the serving stack, from kernel-level bottlenecks to fleet-level capacity and multi-tenant isolation

Reinforcement learning & post-training

  • Own the architecture of Nscale’s RL and post-training systems: RLHF, DPO/GRPO-style methods, reward modelling, and agentic RL with tool calling, off-policy training, and decoupled sampling and policy updates
  • Define how inference and training share infrastructure in RL loops — rollout generation, sample buffering, weight synchronization, and the serving engine’s role inside the training system
  • Establish standards for fine-tuning services (LoRA, QLoRA, adapters, full fine-tuning) and the data curation and processing workflows that feed them

Developer APIs & platform

  • Set the design standards for Nscale’s developer-facing APIs, SDKs, and tooling — OpenAI-compatible and native interfaces, OpenAPI 3.x specifications, versioning, and rate limiting — so that inference and RL capabilities are consumable by engineers who never see the underlying systems
  • Create reusable frameworks and tooling that multiply the effectiveness of other AI engineers across Nscale

Leadership & direction

  • Coach and grow more junior engineers across teams; raise technical capability and engineering quality broadly
  • Collaborate with research, product, and infrastructure leadership to align inference and RL platform strategy with customer demand and business direction
  • Evaluate emerging serving engines, RL frameworks, and accelerator technologies; make decisive build/adopt/contribute recommendations
  • Represent the inference and RL domain in cross-organizational architecture reviews and strategic planning

Requirements

  • 8–12 years of engineering experience, with significant depth in production AI systems at scale (AI labs, hyperscalers, or leading ML infrastructure companies)
  • Demonstrated ability to set technical direction for an AI systems domain at scale
  • Deep expertise in production LLM inference: serving architectures, KV cache and memory management, batching and scheduling strategies, speculative decoding, and low-precision inference
  • Strong hands-on expertise in RL for LLMs — RLHF, DPO and related preference-optimization methods, reward modelling, or agentic/multi-turn RL — including the systems that make them run efficiently on GPU clusters
  • Proven ability to design developer-facing APIs and SDKs that are clean, versioned, and adopted by other engineers and external customers
  • Strong cross-team influence: track record of creating standards and practices adopted by multiple teams
  • Experience designing AI infrastructure with clear control plane / data plane separation and cell-based architecture patterns for scale-out and blast-radius isolation
  • Experience with large-scale GPU/accelerator workloads: CUDA or ROCm, memory bandwidth optimization, and distributed compute paradigms (data/model/tensor parallelism, sharding, scheduling)
  • Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with a track record of building maintainable, well-tested, production-grade ML systems
  • Deep understanding of transformer and LLM architectures and their behavior under production load
  • Ability to design architecture that is both technically excellent and practically adoptable across a diverse engineering organization

Preferred

  • Contributions to widely-used open-source inference or RL frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, verl, OpenRLHF, TRL, DeepSpeed, etc.)
  • Experience at an AI lab (OpenAI, DeepMind, Anthropic, Meta AI, etc.), hyperscaler AI team, or leading ML infrastructure company
  • Published research or technical writing on inference systems or RL infrastructure (MLSys, NeurIPS, ICLR systems tracks, blog posts)
  • Experience with hardware-software co-design for AI accelerators (custom CUDA kernels, Triton, etc.)
  • Experience operating inference platforms in containerized, distributed environments (Kubernetes, large-scale clusters)
  • Experience building evaluation and benchmarking systems for model quality, safety, and system performance

title: SE Archive & Oral History Intern
description:
Job Description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Archive & Oral History Intern will work directly with the private art collection of Mentor-in-Residence Dr. Betty Neal Crutcher and former UR President Ronald Crutcher, with two primary objectives: inventory the collection and produce an oral history with Dr. Betty Neal Crutcher about the collection. This work includes researching and documenting information about each artwork, as well as developing questions for, recording, and transcribing one or more interviews with Dr. Crutcher.

Reporting to Dr. Crutcher and the Executive Director of the Harnett Museum of Art, this position is open to all majors and is well suited for a student with strong research skills and an interest in art, archival work, and oral history.

The Intern will primarily work at the Crutchers’ private residence near downtown Richmond and must have access to reliable transportation.

SPECIFIC DUTIES:

  • Create an inventory document for the private art collection of Drs. Betty Neal and Ronald Crutcher.
  • Produce an oral history with Dr. Crutcher about her art collection. Prepare questions for, record, and transcribe the interview(s).
  • Research artists in the collection to develop a source list.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Access to reliable transportation to downtown Richmond.
  • Excellent writing, research, and oral communication skills.
  • Highly independent and organized.
  • Familiarity with and/or interest in the visual arts and art history preferred.
  • Interviewing experience preferred.

SP Student 4, starting at $14.80

Answer customer questions and complaints in a professional manner and assure all customers receive fast, friendly service. Perform the duties of a grocery clerk, cashier and/or freight stocker in addition to assisting assigned employees in the performance of their tasks as appropriate, including notifying them of their breaks and lunches.   • Conducting visual inspections, reading reports, computer printouts, register and computer screens, etc.

  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately with honesty and integrity.
  • In Montana and Oregon the minimum age is 18 years old. All other states the minimum age is 21 years old.

Ability to:

  • Consistently provide world class customer service to internal and external customers.
  • Work varied shifts in a 24/7 operation; including night, weekends and holidays.
  • Perform all duties described in the appropriate department specific job description (grocery clerk, cashier and/or freight stocker).
  • Understand overall company practices through previous experience in designated department (grocery or freight) or equivalent.
  • Properly use cleaning chemicals in accordance with manufacture’s guidelines and instructions.
  • Properly handle food products per State and County laws, and WinCo standards.
  • Reach, lift and maneuver objects of varying dimensions and weights up to 50 lbs. frequently.
  • Stand for long periods of time, walk and move rapidly, bend, stoop, twist and turn frequently.
  • Perform duties with mental alertness involving potential hazards with respect to related procedures, machines, equipment and work aides.
  • Understand state & federal regulations if certification is needed.
  • Perform primary duties efficiently and accurately.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must meet age requirements listed above.
  • Food Handlers Certification (Per State Laws)

Machines and Equipment Operated:

  • Refer to appropriate department specific job description (grocery clerk, cashier and/or freight stocker) for complete list.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by the employees assigned to this job. All employees must comply with Company policies and applicable laws. The responsibilities, duties and qualifications required of personnel may vary.

EEO/Inclusivity

As the WinCo Foods community continues to grow, our variety of perspectives and wide range of experiences are essential to our strategy and success. We are committed cultivating and celebrating an inclusive environment in which all employees are valued and respected.

description:

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to define and accelerate how we leverage agentic AI to transform machine learning models and modeling workflows. This high-impact role focuses directly on modeling leverage—enhancing model quality and velocity—rather than building general infrastructure. As a senior staff engineer, you will operate as a technical leader across the entire modeling loop, utilizing modern AI-assisted development systems (such as Claude, Cursor, and comparable tools) to make model development faster, more rigorous, and significantly more effective across the organization.

Why Join Us? This role offers a domain-flexible platform to redefine how ML engineering is done. If you are passionate about combining deep ML fundamentals with the vanguard of agentic AI to multiply team impact, we’d love to talk to you.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop advanced ML models and the agentic workflows that help teams design, train, evaluate, and improve them.
  • Use tools such as Claude, Cursor, and comparable AI-assisted development systems to investigate model behavior, generate and test hypotheses, automate repetitive analysis, and improve code and experiments.
  • Build reliable loops for data and label analysis, feature and embedding development, architecture comparison, hyperparameter optimization, error analysis, and experiment readouts.
  • Design evaluation harnesses that measure both model outcomes and agent/workflow quality, including correctness, reproducibility, regressions, cost, and latency.
  • Partner with product, data science, ML infrastructure, and engineering teams to connect modeling improvements to user and business outcomes.
  • Set technical direction across teams, mentor engineers, and raise the bar for modeling rigor and AI-assisted engineering.

title: Lead Data Technician
description:
Overview

As a Lead Data Technician, you will serve as a hands-on field leader responsible for performing and overseeing the installation, termination, testing, and troubleshooting of structured cabling and low-voltage systems on commercial construction projects.

This position is designed for an experienced technician who is ready to take greater ownership of jobsite production and crew performance. The Lead Data Technician will work closely with the Foreman and Project Manager to coordinate daily activities, provide technical direction to other technicians, maintain quality and safety standards, and help ensure projects are completed efficiently and on schedule.

The ideal candidate is a strong low-voltage technician who leads by example, communicates effectively, takes ownership of their work, and is comfortable providing direction and training to less-experienced technicians.

Responsibilities

A Lead Data Technician will:

  • Lead and provide day-to-day direction to small crews of Data Technicians on active commercial construction sites.
  • Assist the Foreman with coordinating daily work assignments, manpower, installation priorities, and project workflow.
  • Pull, route, dress, terminate, test, troubleshoot, and label CAT5e, CAT6, CAT6A, and fiber-optic cabling.
  • Install and maintain cable support systems, pathways, J-hooks, ladder rack, sleeves, and other structured cabling infrastructure.
  • Install low-voltage devices and equipment including WAPs, speakers, projectors, displays, card readers, access-control devices, electric strikes, locks, crash bars, transmitters, receivers, and DAS equipment.
  • Read and interpret construction drawings, floor plans, reflected ceiling plans, riser diagrams, specifications, and installation details.
  • Lay out work for technicians and ensure installations are performed according to drawings, specifications, customer requirements, and FSG standards.
  • Monitor crew productivity and proactively identify issues that could impact schedule, quality, or project completion.
  • Perform quality-control inspections of cabling, terminations, labeling, pathways, device installations, and completed work.
  • Verify testing results and assist with troubleshooting failed cables, connectivity issues, damaged infrastructure, or installation deficiencies.
  • Train, mentor, and develop junior technicians while reinforcing proper installation methods and industry best practices.
  • Serve as a technical resource for technicians who need assistance troubleshooting installations or interpreting project requirements.
  • Lead by example in productivity, professionalism, workmanship, attendance, and jobsite conduct.
  • Coordinate field activities with the Foreman, Project Manager, General Contractor, other trades, and customer representatives as required.
  • Help identify material, equipment, and tool requirements before they impact field production.
  • Assist with receiving, staging, organizing, tracking, and maintaining project materials and equipment.
  • Maintain accurate cable identification, labeling, testing documentation, punch lists, and project closeout information.
  • Identify field conflicts and communicate potential problems to project leadership before they affect schedule or installation quality.
  • Participate in project walkthroughs, inspections, punch-list completion, testing, commissioning, and turnover activities.
  • Attend required safety meetings and actively enforce FSG and customer safety policies among assigned crew members.
  • Ensure technicians are using appropriate PPE, tools, ladders, lifts, and equipment safely and correctly.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, professional, and safe work environment.
  • Assist other crews or project teams as necessary to meet overall project schedules and customer commitments.
  • Perform hands-on installation work alongside the crew while maintaining responsibility for the quality and productivity of assigned work.
  • Communicate daily progress, manpower needs, material shortages, installation challenges, and potential schedule impacts to field leadership.
  • Perform additional project-related duties and leadership responsibilities as assigned by the Foreman, Superintendent, or Project Manager.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will meet the following requirements:

  • 4+ years of commercial structured cabling or low-voltage installation experience required
  • Previous experience serving as a Lead Technician, Crew Lead, senior technician, or informal field leader strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, train, and provide direction to other technicians.
  • Strong working knowledge of CAT5e, CAT6, CAT6A, and fiber-optic cabling systems.
  • Experience terminating, testing, labeling, troubleshooting, and documenting structured cabling installations.
  • Experience with commercial low-voltage systems such as voice/data, wireless networks, A/V, access control, security, and DAS preferred.
  • Ability to read and understand blueprints, floor plans, riser diagrams, specifications, and construction documents.
  • Working knowledge of commercial construction environments and coordination with other trades.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively organize work, prioritize tasks, and keep a crew productive.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with coworkers, field leadership, customers, General Contractors, and other trades.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working with limited supervision.
  • Familiarity with industry standards and structured cabling best practices; BICSI knowledge or certification is a plus.
  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Reliable transportation to and from project locations.
  • Ability to pass required background screening and drug testing.
  • Ability to work day shifts, nights, weekends, or overtime when project schedules require.
  • Ability to safely operate ladders, lifts, hand tools, power tools, testing equipment, and other equipment commonly used in low-voltage construction.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and perform the physical duties associated with commercial construction work.

Benefits

As a full-time FSG employee, you'll have access to a strong benefits package designed to support you both on and off the job, including:

  • 22 days of paid time off (PTO) with the ability to cash out unused PTO
  • Medical insurance, including an employee-only option with the premium covered by FSG
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Additional voluntary benefit options
  • Opportunities for training, development, and advancement within FSG
  • Stable, full-time employment with an established and growing company

Pay Range

USD $27.00 - USD $32.00 /Hr.

title: Project Manager II
description:
Company Overview

Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, heat exchangers, process systems, turboexpanders, services, and solutions for the liquefied natural gas (LNG), liquefied hydrogen (LH2), and industrial gases industries. Applications include fueling stations, marine engines, peak shaving, power generation, virtual pipelines, carbon capture, geothermal power and well stimulation. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with $1.5 B USD in annual revenue, 8000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Nikkiso ACD is an engineering and manufacturing company specializing in machinery designed to operate at cryogenic temperatures as low as – 420 degrees Fahrenheit, the boiling point of Liquid hydrogen. For over 50 years, Nikkiso ACD has specialized in centrifugal and reciprocating pumps as well as turbines for air separation. Nikkiso ACD has the most diversified product line in the industry covering nearly every application requiring pumps or turboexpanders.

The Project Manager is responsible for full life cycle project management for a variety of customers. This position is based at Nikkiso ACD located in Santa Ana, CA.

  • Implements and tracks project budgets and schedules

  • Effectively applies methodology and enforces project standards
  • Creates and executes project work plans
  • Communicates with customers and internal team, revising work plans to meet changing needs and/or requirements

  • Must possess exceptional communication and presentation skills
  • Advanced knowledge of project management standards and best practices

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Experience with performance management and ability to evaluate situations quickly and accurately

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Data Platform Engineer to support the administration, automation, governance, security, and optimization of our enterprise Databricks Lakehouse platform on AWS.

This is a hands-on technical role responsible for maintaining and enhancing the Databricks platform, implementing infrastructure automation, enforcing compute and security standards, supporting cost-governance initiatives, and enabling reliable Data Engineering and Data Science workloads.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Databricks platform administration, AWS cloud services, Terraform-based infrastructure automation, and DevOps practices. The individual will evaluate emerging Databricks capabilities through proof-of-concept implementations and contribute to reusable platform patterns and standards.

This role will collaborate closely with Data Engineering, Data Science, Cloud Platform, Security, and Governance teams to ensure the Databricks environment remains secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Key Responsibilities

Databricks Platform Administration

  • Support and maintain enterprise Databricks workspace architecture, including networking, security, and compute governance.
  • Implement and maintain cluster policies, job policies, compute guardrails, and platform governance standards.
  • Manage and optimize Databricks compute environments including job clusters, interactive clusters, and serverless compute.
  • Implement Unity Catalog for centralized data governance and access management.
  • Manage workspace configurations, platform integrations, and operational reliability.

AWS Cloud Architecture for Databricks

Design and maintain secure and scalable Databricks infrastructure leveraging AWS services including:

  • IAM roles and cross-account access architecture
  • VPC networking, subnets, and secure connectivity
  • PrivateLink and secure endpoint configuration
  • S3 data lake architecture
  • AWS KMS encryption and key management
  • CloudWatch monitoring and logging integration

Ensure the platform aligns with enterprise security, compliance, and networking standards.

Infrastructure as Code & DevOps Automation

  • Build and maintain Databricks infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code frameworks for workspace provisioning, cluster policies, and platform configurations.
  • Develop automation using:
    • Databricks CLI
    • Databricks REST APIs
    • Python and shell scripting
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Databricks workloads and platform infrastructure.
  • Integrate deployments with Git-based development workflows (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
  • Enable standardized environment promotion frameworks across Dev, Test, and Production environments.

Platform Cost Governance & Optimization

  • Monitor and analyze DBU consumption and compute utilization across workloads.
  • Provide recommendations on cost optimizations
  • Implement guardrails such as:
    • Cluster policies
    • Budget alerts
    • Resource tagging
    • Usage monitoring dashboards
  • Identify and implement cost optimization strategies across:
    • Compute configurations
    • Job scheduling patterns
    • Serverless vs classic compute usage
    • Storage lifecycle management
  • Build dashboards for cost transparency.

Data Platform Enablement

Provide technical guidance and platform best practices for data engineering and data science workloads, including:

Data Engineering

  • Delta Lake architecture and performance optimization
  • Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
  • Batch and streaming data ingestion
  • Large-scale Spark workloads

Data Science & AI

  • MLflow experimentation and model lifecycle management
  • Feature Store usage
  • Machine learning pipelines and model deployment frameworks.

Innovation & Proof of Concept Development

Evaluate and operationalize new Databricks capabilities by building Proof of Concepts (POCs) and evaluate POCs and support adoption into platform standards.

Areas of focus include:

  • Databricks Serverless Compute
  • Delta Live Tables
  • Auto Loader
  • Lakehouse AI capabilities
  • Databricks Feature Store
  • Vector Search and LLM integrations
  • Lakehouse monitoring and observability frameworks

Support and maintain reference architectures and reusable design patterns based on POC outcomes.

Required Technical Skills

Databricks Platform

  • Databricks workspace administration
  • Cluster and job policy design
  • Unity Catalog governance
  • Delta Lake architecture
  • Databricks REST APIs and CLI automation
  • Performance optimization and troubleshooting

AWS Cloud Platform

Strong hands-on experience with:

  • AWS IAM
  • VPC networking and security
  • S3 data lake architecture
  • AWS KMS encryption
  • CloudWatch monitoring
  • PrivateLink connectivity
  • Cross-account access architecture
  • Enterprise cloud security practices

Infrastructure & Automation

  • Terraform for Databricks and AWS infrastructure
  • Infrastructure as Code design patterns
  • Databricks CLI and API automation
  • Python / Bash scripting
  • Platform automation frameworks

DevOps & DataOps

  • CI/CD pipeline development
  • Git-based version control workflows
  • Automated deployment and release processes
  • Monitoring, logging, and observability frameworks
  • Incident management and root cause analysis

Data Engineering & Analytics Skills

  • Apache Spark / PySpark
  • SQL optimization
  • Delta Lake performance tuning
  • Streaming frameworks
  • Data pipeline orchestration
  • Data modeling and ETL best practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Databricks Platform Architect
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
  • Experience designing enterprise-scale Lakehouse platforms
  • Experience supporting large-scale ML workloads
  • Experience implementing data governance frameworks

Your experience should include…

Experience supporting enterprise customers in an operations environment, with clear verbal and written communication and a track record of conducting effective training.

Familiarity with ITSM concepts such as ITIL 4 and Agile methodologies, rack and power optimization, and hardware lifecycle management.
  • Available for afternoon shifts, an on-call rotation, and travel between data center sites when needed. Ability to move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds throughout the shift.
