  • Provide first level support for all people managers concerning HR policies and programs. This may include support with processing transactions over the phone.
  • Provide second level support for employee inquiries concerning HR policies and programs, leveraging Ministry Unit and Centre of Expertise specific knowledge and expertise. On occasion, this role may receive overflow employee calls during peak call volume.

This may include HR Operations a Centre of Expertise, or a HR Business Partner. Use remote tools and diagnostic utilities to aid in troubleshooting.

  • Identify common issues and appropriate solutions based on personal experience and collaboration with others, then develop help sheets and (FAQ) resources for end users. This is done in partnership with the Quality Assurance (QA) Service Manager.

  • Post-secondary certificate or diploma in social sciences, human resources, or related field of three academic years.

  • Demonstrate a commitment to and understanding of the mission and values of The Salvation Army and their application within a Human Resources service environment.
  • Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive employee and organizational information.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service, ensuring a positive, responsive, and solutions-focused experience for managers and employees.
  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally to diverse audiences.
  • Apply strong organizational and time-management skills to manage competing priorities and meet service expectations.
  • Manage multiple tasks and inquiries simultaneously in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and efficiency.
  • Exhibit a high level of attention to detail when processing information, documenting cases, and resolving inquiries.
  • Demonstrate empathy, active listening, and sound judgment when addressing employee and manager concerns.
  • Build positive working relationships with stakeholders through a collaborative, professional, and service-oriented approach.

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

#shambaugh #LI-DF #LI-Onsite

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Adelaide
description:
About Quartex

Quartex delivers the indispensable tools our customers need to move and house their workforce, protect people and places from harm, and reduce their risks of operation.

We help large and growing companies in asset-intensive industries move and manage their people safely while protecting their licence to operate. From flight scheduling and accommodation, to permitting, disclosures and resource governance, our customers have everything they need to Run Every Site Right.

We are proud to be the preferred choice of energy and resources sector majors at home and across North America, South America, Africa and beyond.

Here’s What You Can Look Forward To

  • Work your way – enjoy flexible hours, hybrid working, floating holidays and location flexibility.
  • Family support – with parental leave and flexibility, we support our people balance career growth with family life.
  • Perks that matter – corporate benefits and exclusive savings with popular brands.
  • A values-led culture- where team contributions are recognised, and your career growth is championed.

What You’ll Do

You’ll help shape how AI fits into our delivery workflow, the systems, guardrails, and practices that let AI take on more of the work without dropping quality. This is central to the role, not a side project.

You’ll own significant features end-to-end across the stack, and set the direction on our frontend, a hybrid AngularJS/Angular codebase being progressively modernised.

Support production alongside the team, monitoring, incidents, and live workloads. There’s no ops team; we own what we ship.

You’ll make architectural and technical decisions, not just implement them, and contribute to engineering standards. The frontend is where you’ll have the most room to lead. The backend is in good shape, with engineers already operating at the level you’ll bring.

Who We’re Looking For

  • You’ve shipped and operated production software for years, not just written code, but owned systems through incidents, deployments gone wrong, the slow accumulation of technical debt, and the lessons that come with all of it. You can talk about a system you’ve kept running for years, and you have opinions about what made it durable.
  • You have strong frontend depth, Angular and TypeScript in production, not just tutorials, and you’re comfortable working in a hybrid codebase where some of the code is old and some of it isn’t, and where modernisation has to happen alongside delivery.
  • You’re equally comfortable on the backend. You’ve shipped production Java (or a close equivalent, Kotlin, C#, Go), you understand relational data modelling, and you can reason about API and service design.
  • You think in failure modes. You can defend why a particular test exists, and you can equally, defend why a different test shouldn’t. You understand the difference between tests that protect production and tests that exist for the sake of coverage numbers, and you’re not precious about either.
  • You’re comfortable in ambiguity. You can figure out what good looks like in spaces where it hasn’t been defined yet, rather than waiting for someone to tell you.
  • You think practically about AI in software delivery. You don’t need to be at the cutting edge, but you should already be thinking about where AI is reliable, where it isn’t, what guardrails matter, where humans add judgment AI can’t, and how to iterate workflows as the capability improves.

Our stack

  • Backend: Java, Spring, Hibernate, REST APIs, microservices
  • Frontend: TypeScript, Angular (with AngularJS legacy being migrated)
  • AWS: ECS, ECR, Lambda, S3, EC2, RDS
  • Data: MySQL/Aurora, Redis
  • Infrastructure: Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Docker
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions and Workflows
  • Testing: JUnit and Spring Test (backend); Jest, Jasmine and Karma (frontend); plus integration and e2e where they earn their keep
  • Mobile: React Native / Expo (occasional touchpoints)

On AI at Quartex

We’re going all in on AI as part of our software delivery process. We don’t mean using AI to type faster, we mean building toward a workflow where well-structured Jira tickets can be picked up by AI systems that build features, verify their own work, run testing and review, and prepare changes for production, with humans involved at the right gates and not the wrong ones.

This is the direction we’re heading. You’ll help shape how we get there, alongside the rest of the team, contributions to the workflow are expected from everyone, not delegated to a single specialist.

Nice to have

  • Experience embedding AI tools into actual production workflows (beyond code completion)
  • Mobile development with React Native / Expo
  • Background in workforce management, scheduling, or operational systems

What To Expect

This is feature delivery work. AI workflow improvements emerge from the friction you hit while building, that’s where the best ideas come from, and that’s where we expect them to come from here.

We’re a small, senior team scaling up: a handful of established engineers, hiring more. We expect you to bring opinions and shape what good looks like as much as you implement against it.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Quartex, we know even minor issues can lead to major problems in the industries we serve. That’s why we’re driven to help our customers get better insights, take smarter actions, and see stronger results.

You’ll Join a Team That

  • Focuses on our customer, tailoring solutions for real impact.
  • Builds to be useful & useable, with practical, reliable software.
  • Collaborates to innovate, working alongside customers to refine and enhance our products.
  • Stays grounded, with a deep understanding of the sectors we serve.

title: Senior Software Integration Engineer (Payloads & Integrations)
description:
Who We Are


At Firestorm, we are building the future of expeditionary defense manufacturing and autonomous systems. Modern conflict has exposed a fundamental problem: the systems needed most by operators are often too expensive, too slow to produce, and too difficult to sustain at scale. Firestorm exists to change that.

We develop mission-adaptable aerial systems and deployable manufacturing infrastructure designed to put capability directly into the hands of the warfighter. From modular unmanned aircraft to xCell — our deployable microfactory — our goal is to make defense systems rapidly deployable, adaptable, and producible at the point of need.

We are looking for builders, operators, and problem-solvers who want to work on meaningful technology with real-world impact.

About the Role


Firestorm is seeking a Senior Software Integration Engineer to join our Payloads & Integrations team. This role exists to accelerate the integration of new mission payloads and capabilities into Firestorm's autonomous systems.

You will operate at the intersection of software, hardware, and mission systems – developing the interfaces, tooling, and integrations required to rapidly deploy new payload capabilities. This includes integrating cameras, radios, sensors, and other mission equipment through SDKs, APIs, and custom software workflows. You will work closely with Firestorm's core software organization, which owns the mainline software stack. Your role will be to rapidly develop and validate payload integrations through an out-of-cycle (branched) development process, then collaborate with the broader software organization to upstream production-ready capabilities into future releases.

This is a hands-on IC engineering role for someone who enjoys moving quickly across software layers, debugging complex systems, and solving ambiguous integration problems.

What You'll Do


  • Build and maintain software interfaces between payload hardware, mission applications, and autonomy systems
  • Integrate SDKs and APIs for cameras, gimbals, radios, sensors, and other mission equipment
  • Develop tools and applications supporting payload configuration, monitoring, and control
  • Customize or extend mission applications such as QGroundControl, TAK-based applications, and related operator interfaces
  • Debug complex systems spanning Linux, networking, hardware interfaces, and distributed software components
  • Build Docker-based deployment workflows for fielded software capabilities
  • Work within a side-branch development process and collaborate with the core software team to make upstream production-ready changes
  • Participate in field testing, demonstrations, and integration activities

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to ITAR regulations.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong programming ability in one or more modern languages (C++, Python, Rust, Go, Java, TypeScript, or similar).
  • Demonstrated history of holding yourself and your teammates to a high standard, even when it creates discomfort.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience across multiple layers of the stack
  • Strong Linux experience including command-line workflows, debugging, and system administration tasks
  • Experience with networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, UDP, routing, and network troubleshooting
  • Experience integrating software with external systems through APIs, SDKs, or communication protocols
  • Ability to quickly understand and modify large existing codebases
  • Experience developing reliable production software in fast-moving environments
  • Experience with Git including branching and upstream contributions

Preferred Qualifications


  • Background that includes both startup and scale-stage product engineering.
  • Experience with autonomous systems, UAVs, robotics, or defense technology
  • Experience with QGroundControl, MAVLink, PX4, ArduPilot, or similar platforms
  • Experience with TAK ecosystems or tactical mission applications
  • Experience integrating cameras, gimbals, radios, or other payload hardware
  • Experience with embedded systems or edge computing environments
  • Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
  • Experience contributing changes back into shared production software repositories
  • Experience supporting field deployments and troubleshooting operational systems

Work Environment


Based at our Headquarters in San Diego, CA. We welcome candidates who are local or open to relocating; relocation assistance is available and may be included in the offer package where appropriate

This role includes occasional domestic travel (approximately 10%) for field testing, payload integration, demonstrations, and operational support.

Compensation


US Salary Range: $140,000 - $155,000 USD

The posted salary range reflects an estimate based on a variety of compensation factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, education, certifications, specialized skills, geographic location, and business needs. Actual compensation may vary, and this range is subject to change as our compensation structure or market conditions evolve.

Benefits & Perks

Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation:

  • We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and visions plans
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan to invest in your long-term retirement goals
  • Equity grants for new hires
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Extremely generous company holiday calendar, including a holiday hiatus in November, & December
  • Generous Parental Leave
  • Lifestyle Spending Account
  • FSA
  • DCFSA
  • HSA
  • Hospital Indemnity insurance
  • Critical Illness insurance
  • Accident insurance
  • Basic Life/AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, 100% covered by Firestorm. Plus, the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your family
  • Mental Health Resources: We provide free mental health resources 24/7 including therapy and more. Additional work-life services, such as free legal and financial support, are available to you as well

Export Control Compliance

To conform to U.S. government export control regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Firestorm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and upholding equitable hiring practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic under federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process.
Firestorm is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require accommodations or assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at careers@launchfirestorm.com so we can provide the support you need.

title: Senior Mission Integration Engineer
description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Senior Mission Integration Engineer to join our team in Patuxent River, MD. This work could be performed in either PAX River. MD or Virginia Beach, VA. This is an onsite position.

In this role, you will serve as a primary technical advisor, bridging the gap between high-level joint warfighting concepts and complex system-of-systems engineering requirements. You will lead cross-functional teams in decomposing complex naval and joint task lists into functional mission threads, defining kinetic and non-kinetic configurations, and driving the development of the Navy's integrated capability technical baselines.

Responsibilities include and are not limited to:

  • Lead technical and operational analysis supporting the PMA-298 Naval Capabilities-Based Integration Process (NCIP) Integrated Product Team (IPT)

  • Oversee and direct the breakdown of Universal Joint Task Lists (UJTL) and Universal Naval Task Lists (UNTL) into granular, executable mission threads, kill chains, and target-pairing configurations

  • Lead and facilitate national-level technical meetings, working groups, and collaborative conversations integrating warfighter, acquisition, budget, and intelligence community Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)

  • Spearhead the development of Naval Concepts of Employment (CONEMPs), kill chain/kill web wholeness assessments, capability gap assessments, and Design Reference Missions (DRMs) to directly influence NAVAIR acquisition and investment decisions

  • Partner closely with senior OPNAV and NAVAIR pillar program representatives to synthesize and compile comprehensive mission technical baselines across multiple future time epochs

  • Direct the capture of mission architectures and system-of-systems relationships using Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) frameworks, guiding team members in utilizing digital modeling environments

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, mathematics, operations research, physics, computer science, or a related scientific discipline

  • Must be a graduate of a military warfare center of excellence Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) curriculum (e.g., TOPGUN, MAWTS-1, EAWS, CAEWWS, AWS, or Joint equivalent)

  • 15+ years of professional experience directly related to the analysis of Naval Aviation/Naval mission areas, CONEMPs, and associated kill chains

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven track record as a senior-level Operations Officer, Training Officer, or Joint Planner (e.g., former O-5/O-6 or senior civilian equivalent) with extensive experience aligning joint task lists to operational readiness frameworks

  • Broad operational background spanning Joint Operations, Surface Warfare, Information Warfare, and/or Air-to-Surface mission spaces, offering a holistic view of the "kill web" beyond standard aviation tactics

  • Advanced experience with (or strong structural understanding of) Cameo Systems Modeler, Cameo Enterprise Architecture, or MagicDraw to effectively supervise or develop system-of-systems digital roadmaps

  • Thorough understanding of the DoD 5000 series lifecycle, capability gap assessment processes, and the execution of Analysis-of-Alternatives (AoA)

Clearance Requirements:

  • Must have a current and active Top Secret clearance and be willing and able to obtain SCI

Physical Requirements:

  • The person in this position must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time. Occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, or to communicate with co-workers, management, and customers, via email, phone, and or virtual communication, which may involve delivering presentations.

title: All Source Analyst
description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented All-Source Analyst to join our team in Springfield, VA.

In this role, you will leverage your analytical expertise to research, evaluate, and integrate complex intelligence to protect vital assets and inform strategic decision-makers.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Produce comprehensive counterintelligence (CI) assessments by researching, reviewing, editing, planning, and integrating all-source intelligence and open-source information, focusing on global threats to customer and mission partners.

  • Generate foundational intelligence and original written analysis on foreign intelligence entity networks to identify and warn of intelligence, terrorism, and espionage threats impacting national security.

  • Employ analytical and GEOINT methodologies to identify, monitor, and assess foreign intelligence efforts targeting key assets and support CI investigations and collection activities.

  • Apply expertise in foreign intelligence entities to research and produce CI estimates and develop CI studies, plans, network charts, and briefings for leadership, adhering to IC analytic tradecraft standards.

  • Collaborate with access-controlled programs and Intelligence Community (IC) entities to leverage full capabilities against sensitive threats and create joint analytical products.

  • Identify trends within assigned subject matter, provide analytical assessments and briefings to decision-makers and CI officers, and propose new projects based on emerging developments.

  • Describe adversarial threats, capabilities, and intentions related to defense vulnerabilities, and assist in drafting collection requirements to inform decision-makers of foreign threats.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in all-source intelligence analysis.

  • Military Occupational Specialty: 35, 35F, 35X (Army); 0202, 0205, 0231, 0291 (USMC); 1N0X1, 1N4X1, 14NX (Air Force); IS with all-source focus (Navy & Coast Guard); OR GS-0132 job code with all-source analytic training (PACE, DISAP, CDASA, or equivalent).

  • Experience with DataXplorer, Proton, Voltron, Palantir, RMT, TAC, ArcGIS, QLIX, CHROME, FADE, MIST, and other intelligence and network analysis tools.

  • Experience navigating and assimilating information from OSINT, SIGINT, HUMINT, and GEOINT databases to present a clear, cogent intelligence picture.

  • Experience in CI analysis or familiarity with DoD CI policy, plans, and operations, with an understanding of how to effectively inject all-source analysis.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience preferred (a degree in a relevant field may count for up to 4 years of experience).

  • Exceptional communication, decision-making, and interpersonal skills to craft written assessments, brief senior leadership, and foster collaboration with external IC partners.

  • Experience in a Joint Duty Assignment such as J2, Joint-Intelligence Operations Centers, COCOMs, or IC-billets.

  • Prior experience supporting DoD or Federal CI elements.

  • Completion of Counterterrorism Analysis Course, DIA/JMITC, Identity Intelligence Analytical Applications (I2A2) Course, Fundamentals of HUMINT Targeting Course, or equivalent specialized training.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Must possess an active TS/SCI security clearance with the ability to obtain/maintain a Polygraph clearance.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, or communicate with co-workers, management, and customers via email, phone, or virtual communication, which may involve delivering presentations.

description:

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience in big data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or related data solutions, with demonstrated depth in large-scale data environments.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of leadership experience, including responsibility for leading teams, matrixed resources, enterprise-level analytics, BI, or data engineering initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience building and owning final-mile semantic data layers — the layer that connects curated and gold data products to business-ready metrics, dashboards, and downstream consumption.
  • Strong, hands-on technical expertise in cloud and big data platforms, including Databricks and Snowflake, along with SQL, Python, and modern ETL/ELT frameworks.

  • Experience delivering enterprise BI, analytics engineering, or data platform capabilities within fintech, banking, or another major financial services organization.
  • Strong knowledge of BI and semantic architecture, including semantic layers, semantic tables/models, data marts, reporting data structures, and curated datasets that support enterprise analytics.
  • Experience partnering with Data Engineering, Platform, Governance, and business leadership to align semantic and BI solutions with enterprise data strategy and data quality expectations.
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI, including dashboard design and stakeholder adoption.
  • Ability to lead enterprise roadmaps for semantic layers, analytics engineering, and BI, balancing technical scalability with business priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a senior or AVP-level leadership role within a major fintech, bank, or financial services data organization.
  • Experience designing AI-enabled semantic layers, natural language analytics, or AI insight agents on top of governed data products.
  • Experience with modern data engineering frameworks (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Spark) in addition to Databricks and Snowflake.

title: Data Center Technician
description:
Overview

Edgewater Federal Solutions is seeking a Data Center Technician to support a major national laboratory.

Responsibilities

Provide comprehensive support across all dimensions of the Data Center environment. In this role, you will deliver Level I and/or Level II technical support to server technicians, network administrators, and support personnel for various systems, including cabling, power management, space planning, and cooling management in a large and complex Data Center setting.

  • Troubleshoot complex problems that span multiple subsystems and systems, requiring in-depth knowledge of the sophisticated Data Center environment.
  • Have a strong background in IT and High-Performance Computing (HPC) infrastructure, with a solid understanding of cooling, heat transfer, fluid mechanics, and chemical analysis for both open and closed-loop water systems.
  • Collaborative on data center consolidation efforts, engaging with customers to evaluate, design, and plan consolidation activities as needed.
  • Develop innovative solutions to significant and unusual problems, applying new principles, concepts, and practices to address complex or strategic issues.
  • Be a resource to executive management providing analysis of information, trends, and goals at a corporate level, contributing to the overall success and efficiency of the Data Center operations.

Qualifications

  • Requires AS in relevant discipline plus a minimum of 2 years, or more, of directly related experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform the duties.
  • Related experience may be substituted for relevant education and vice versa.
  • Ability to obtain & maintain a U.S. Dept. of Energy Clearance
  • U.S. Citizenship is required.

Required Skills:

  • Experience working in mission‑critical production environments with change control, incident response, and structured troubleshooting.
  • Ability to work safely and effectively in live data center spaces (DCFIT coordination, raised floor environments, cabling standards).
  • Strong understanding of L2/L3 networking fundamentals: VLANs, STP, LACP, static routing, OSPF, BGP, ACLs, QoS.
  • Experience configuring and supporting major network vendors (any of): Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Mellanox/NVIDIA Networking.
  • Familiarity with multipath topologies, spine‑leaf architectures, and high‑bandwidth fabrics.
  • Understanding of basic firewall and segmentation concepts (paths, zones, NAT, routing symmetry).
  • Familiarity with enterprise cabling best practices: fiber types (LR/SR/ER), transceiver selection, rack elevation awareness.
  • Working knowledge of monitoring and telemetry: CloudVision, Netropy/Apposite tools, Nagios/Prometheus/Grafana, or similar.
  • Ability to follow SOPs/MOPs, support planned change windows, and adhere to structured rollback/validation procedures.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, with a demonstrated ability to drive issues to resolution during outages.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to participate in on‑call rotations and support after‑hours change windows if needed.

Desired Skills:

  • Advanced Network Expertise
  • Hands‑on experience with Arista EOS, Cisco NX‑OS, Juniper JunOS, or Mellanox/NVIDIA platforms supporting 40/100/400Gbps networks.
  • Experience with BGP tuning, traffic‑engineering policies, ECMP management, asymmetric‑routing detection, and complex route‑map design.
  • Familiarity with EVPN/VXLAN, modern DC underlays, and high‑availability routing gateway designs (HA router pairs, blue/green cutovers).
  • Experience troubleshooting firewall pathing issues, zone interactions, NAT64/NAT policy behavior, and segmentation used for HPC.
  • Exposure to HPC networks and interconnects:
  • RDMA, RoCE, basic InfiniBand concepts (subnet managers, fabric behavior).
  • Understanding of congestion behaviors common in HPC (parallel I/O bursts, GPU‑node communication patterns).
  • Familiarity moving or supporting HPC data flows across multi‑site infrastructures (tri‑lab WAN, DisCom, IHPC routing).
  • Understanding of distributed HPC storage systems (Lustre, BeeGFS, Isilon, Spectrum Scale) and the routing or MTU constraints around them.
  • Ability to work with HPC teams during large cluster deployments (rack placement coordination, switch firmware updates, cabling checks).
  • Hands‑on experience with automation or configuration management tools (Ansible, Python, Terraform).
  • Ability to build or maintain dashboards and telemetry for HPC network utilization (CloudVision pipelines, Netropy test data).
  • Familiarity with gNMI/gRPC or streaming telemetry for performance analysis and anomaly detection.
  • Understanding of high‑availability designs, reduced failure domains, and deterministic failover patterns in HPC networks.
  • Experience monitoring and optimizing latency, packet loss, MTU mismatches, and congestion across crypto tunnels or 100Gbps transport.
  • Ability to assist with capacity planning for rapidly growing HPC systems (rack density, port utilization, fiber paths, WAN circuit expansions).

About Us:

Edgewater Federal Solutions is a privately held government contracting firm located in Frederick, MD. The company was founded in 2002 with the vision of being highly recognized and admired for supporting customer missions through employee empowerment, exceptional services and timely delivery. description:

Overview

The Job in a Nutshell:

The Maintenance Repairs Technician position is responsible for developing and performing preventative and corrective maintenance on bulk bagging production equipment at the Natural Grocers Distribution Center. This position is also responsible for timely repairs to equipment during processing; and, general warehouse repairs and maintenance. This position is scheduled Monday through Friday and may include some holidays.

Responsibilities

Main Ingredients:

  • Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on production equipment, including augers and vibrating scale equipment
  • Maintain preventive maintenance program for all production equipment, to be in compliance with Food Safety guidelines and Good Manufacturing practices
  • Perform preventive maintenance on warehouse equipment as needed
  • Recommend spare parts to support production and warehouse equipment; maintain parts inventory to meet production needs
  • Inspect mechanical systems, equipment and components to identify and correct any hazards or defects
  • Participate in dismantling, relocating and re-assembly of equipment as necessary to accommodate business growth
  • Test equipment and machinery to verify repairs and ensure safe and efficient operation
  • Repair and maintain all conveyor belt systems
  • Perform pneumatic and hydraulic systems installation and repairs
  • Maintain filters and belts on all RTU’s and air compressors
  • Provide training and guidance to machine operators as needed
  • Manage on-site maintenance vendors that work at the DC
  • Carry out minor repairs in DC including changing light fixtures, changing bulbs, patching drywall, mounting racks on walls, changing out plumbing fixtures, etc.
  • Fabricate minor parts for production or warehouse, such as machine guards
  • Provide timely repair service to production operations to keep equipment running
  • Create clear, accurate, complete and timely documentation of work orders
  • Maintain a work environment that is clean and safe
  • Work closely with vendors to ensure projects are completed efficiently and accurately, including repairs, machining, welding, fabrication, rebuilds, etc.

Although this is a general outline of job responsibilities all employees are expected to be “hands on” and do whatever it takes to get the job done and make the company thrive.

Qualifications

Recipe for Success:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as repairs/maintenance technician in an automated industrial production facility, conducting preventive maintenance and repairs. Experience with auger and vibrating scale systems preferred.
  • Must have Forklift/ Powered Pallet Jack Operator certification which must be kept current for this position
  • Experience in a food manufacturing environment with an understanding of GMP’s, HACCP and Food Safety preferred
  • Ability to understand and work on DC voltage required
  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot maintenance issues required
  • Possesses basic carpentry, plumbing, electrical and fabrication knowledge
  • Ability to provide installation and repair techniques for piping systems (water, air)
  • Possess industrial safety, machine safety and safeguarding techniques
  • Knowledge of PLC systems a plus
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision and take the initiative to get assigned work done efficiently and effectively and in a timely manner
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and communicate with management on progress
  • Strong attention to details and getting the work done right the first time
  • Ability to work with a diverse group and provide leadership in the maintenance area
  • Must have valid CO driver’s license
  • Must be a non-smoker; NGVC is a health food company with a non-smoking policy

title: Towing Lot Attendant
description:
The Tow Lot Attendant provides customer service and associated data entry for the intake and release of towed vehicles.


Lot Attendant Responsibilities:

Document, identify, and verify vehicle information to ensure that the record contains correct data for inventory and quality control.

Obtain or verify vehicle ownership, lien holder, or other information for notification purposes.

Evaluate vehicles for value, damage, make, model, and other information.

Determine future dispositions based on applicable state statutes and vehicle market value.

Use and create database queries to locate vehicles, establish/create dispositions, identify entry errors or questionable dispositions, and evaluate data to determine ownership or inconsistencies in ownership or vehicle data.

Coordinate vehicle releases to ensure that all customers are served in a timely and orderly manner.

Assess and document the condition of all vehicles at time of release.

Ensure that the correct vehicle is released to the authorized agent or is recycled or sold based on legal timeframes.

Complete Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) and other vehicle forms using spreadsheets and databases.

Utilize technology, including hand-held devices and printers, in order to inventory vehicles and produce vehicle identification labels.

Lot Maintenance

Perform Tow Lot maintenance, including snow removal by truck, shovel or snow blower; salting; and cleaning, such as sweeping and loading car parts into a truck bed.

Use tow truck, skid steer loader and end loader for various operations within the Tow Lot.

Maintain existing equipment and supply inventory.

Customer Service

Answer inquiries from customers, tow drivers, MPD, and others regarding vehicle status.

Respond to electronic or written information requests.


Lot Attendant Requirements:

Ability to drive various types of passenger vehicles, including both automatic and manual transmission.

Forklift Experience HIGHLY preferred

Ability to use hand tools, such as screw drivers, plyers, wrenches, lock out kit and/or hammers, in order to remove license plates, open car doors, and perform vehicle adjustment to enable the vehicles to be driven off the lot.

Must be available to work any shift and to rotate shifts when needed.

Must be able to work outdoors in all kinds of weather conditions.

Ability to lift and move objects weighing 50 pounds or more occasionally, up to 20 pounds frequently, and up to 10 pounds consistently.

Valid driver's license at the time of appointment and throughout employment.

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-09-29 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role


CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Continuous AI Risk Management Expert, to design, build and lead the enterprise-wide governance, security and continuous risk management program for artificial intelligence (covering both traditional AI and generative AI) across the Corporation.

In this role, you will design and deploy an enterprise AI risk assessment framework and conduct continuous evaluations of AI systems throughout the AI life cycle (from design to production). You will collaborate closely with data protection analysts, as well as the legal, compliance and enterprise architecture teams, to identify, measure and mitigate cybersecurity risks associated with AI technologies.

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

What’s in It for You

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

As Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Design and deploy the AI risk assessment framework: Develop, formalize and implement a standardized risk assessment methodology tailored to AI systems, including ethical impact matrices, model criticality criteria, bias analysis, algorithmic vulnerability assessments and data exposure risks.
  • Support enterprise AI governance architecture: Collaborate closely with architecture teams and governance committees to design, integrate and evolve the security foundation for AI technologies across the Corporation.
  • Maintain the AI inventory and classification: Build and manage a centralized registry of all AI systems, models (internal, SaaS, open-source) and AI agents deployed across the organization, classified by risk level.
  • Conduct continuous model risk assessments: Perform technical risk evaluations on new AI use cases, analyzing training data security, prompt/query confidentiality, algorithmic bias and intellectual property risks.
  • Perform AI security testing: Define and execute specialized security and adversarial testing for AI and large language models (LLMs).
  • Assess third-party AI and SaaS solutions: Partner with the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Analyst to evaluate the security posture, privacy controls and model-training policies of external vendors. Provide specialized AI expertise to analyze contractual data-use terms (e.g., ensuring corporate data is not used for model training), evaluate SaaS API security and verify privacy guarantees in third-party environments.
  • Manage the AI risk register: Document, maintain and map AI-specific model vulnerabilities, technical debt and approved exceptions in the risk register.
  • Assess program maturity: Conduct periodic evaluations of AI governance maturity, developing dashboards and tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) for executive and governance committees.
  • Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

What You Bring

  • University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
  • Minimum five years' applied experience in IT security, data governance or technology risk management.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing or implementing risk assessment methodologies and evaluating AI models.
  • Proven ability to translate complex AI concepts into structured risk frameworks for project teams, with a deep understanding of AI architectures and AI-specific attack vectors.
  • Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
  • Technical expertise across key domains:
    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
    • Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
    • Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
    • Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.
  • Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
  • Bilingualism (English and French) essential.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:

title: Director, Electrical Engineering
description:

Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience.

STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK.

THE POSITION:

At STACK, the Director, Electrical OFCI Engineering & Technical Delivery will lead the technical strategy, procurement support, integration, and execution of Owner Furnished Contractor Installed (OFCI) electrical infrastructure across STACK’s rapidly expanding hyperscale and colocation data center portfolio.

This role requires a highly experienced mission critical electrical engineering leader with extensive hands-on knowledge of all major data center electrical equipment and infrastructure systems, including utility interconnection, medium-voltage distribution, generators, UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, PDUs, EPMS/SCADA integration, grounding systems, and critical power distribution architectures.

The Director will serve as STACK’s senior technical authority for electrical OFCI systems and will be responsible for driving technical excellence, design standardization, constructability, speed-to-market execution, and operational resiliency across multiple fast-paced concurrent developments.

The ideal candidate possesses 15+ years of mission critical data center experience, thrives in high-growth and accelerated delivery environments, can make rapid technical decisions with confidence, and has proven success managing large-scale hyperscale or colocation projects from concept through commissioning. Responsibilities are as follows:

Lead all technical aspects of OFCI electrical equipment strategy, specification development, procurement support, factory testing, integration, and deployment across multiple concurrent data center projects. Serve as STACK’s subject matter expert for mission critical electrical infrastructure systems including:

  • Medium-voltage utility distribution systems

  • Diesel standby generator systems

  • UPS systems and battery technologies

  • Switchgear and switchboards

  • Transformers and busway systems

  • Static transfer switches (STS)

  • Power monitoring and EPMS/SCADA systems

  • Grounding and bonding systems

  • Concurrently maintainable and fault-tolerant electrical topologies

Provide hands-on technical leadership throughout planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, energization, and operational turnover phases.

Lead technical review, validation, and approval of engineering deliverables produced by EORs, vendors, manufacturers, and consultants to ensure compliance with STACK standards, operational reliability, scalability, and constructability requirements.

Drive rapid technical decision-making and issue resolution in support of fast-track hyperscale development schedules and aggressive project milestones.

Manage technical coordination between Development, Construction, Operations, Procurement, Commissioning, and external engineering partners to ensure seamless project execution.

Lead technical evaluation and selection of OFCI electrical equipment vendors and manufacturers, including:

  • Factory witness testing (FWT)

  • Long-lead equipment procurement strategy

Review and resolve RFIs, field issues, design clarifications, commissioning findings, and technical risks in real time to minimize schedule impacts.

Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Basis of Design (BOD) standards, electrical design standards, procurement specifications, and technical governance processes.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on:

  • Speed-to-market execution

  • Reliability and resiliency

  • Constructability

  • Scalability

  • Operational maintainability

  • Energy efficiency

  • Cost optimization

Provide technical oversight for electrical infrastructure integration and energization activities during construction and commissioning.

Support operational teams with troubleshooting, root cause analysis, infrastructure upgrades, and reliability improvement initiatives across existing facilities.

Evaluate emerging electrical technologies and infrastructure solutions for applicability within hyperscale and colocation environments.

Lead and mentor internal engineering personnel while promoting accountability, technical rigor, and execution excellence.

Support portfolio-wide capital planning and long-term electrical infrastructure strategy development.

Travel to project sites, vendor factories, and operational facilities as required to support project execution and technical oversight.

Who You Are:

• Strategic technology leader with expertise in enterprise infrastructure and networking.

• Results-oriented problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced, 24/7 operational environment.

• Strong communicator who can translate technical concepts into business outcomes.

• Collaborative leader who develops high-performing teams and fosters accountability.

What You Will Do:

• Lead and develop the IT Infrastructure team supporting 24x7x365 resort operations across multiple locations.

• Develop and execute infrastructure strategies that support business objectives, growth, and operational excellence.

• Oversee enterprise networking, telecommunications, wireless technologies, data center operations, virtualization platforms, storage environments, and server infrastructure.

• Manage the lifecycle, inventory, and refresh strategy for more than $20 million in technology assets.

• Oversee Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, virtualization platforms, Nutanix storage infrastructure, and associated enterprise technologies.

• Partner with Loews Hotels Home Office on enterprise projects, infrastructure initiatives, and cybersecurity programs.

• Manage vendor relationships, technology contracts, and service providers to maximize performance and value.

• Support the development and management of operational and capital technology budgets.

• Travel throughout the campus and resort properties to support projects, technology deployments, and operational needs.

• Maintain regular and reliable attendance in alignment with company standards and operational needs.

• Embrace flexibility by performing other duties as assigned to support team and organizational goals.

Your Experience Includes:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field is required.

• Ten or more years of progressive experience leading enterprise infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, or data center operations is required.

• Experience managing technical teams in a large-scale, multi-site environment is required.

• Experience with Cisco Nexus data center networking and VXLAN technologies is required.

• Experience with fiber and copper network infrastructure testing and troubleshooting is required.

• Experience supporting Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops and application delivery technologies is required.

• Cisco CCNA, CCNP, Network+, or equivalent certification is preferred.

• VMware Certified Professional (VCP) certification or equivalent experience is preferred.

• ITIL, project management, cloud infrastructure, or cybersecurity certifications are preferred.

Plans, conceives, organizes, and/or develops the production and realization of a program segment, program, or series. Nevertheless, there is wide latitude for initiative, independent judgment and creativity. There is a regular and ongoing requirement to co-ordinate the work of others.

  • Conceives and develops program ideas and concepts. Participates in the preparation of program objectives.

  • Plans, organizes and co-ordinates the program or the components and/or segments of a program, or programs.

During program preparation, production and post-production, is responsible and accountable for exercising budget authority.

  • Select, re-write and/or edit copy or text written by others.

  • Ensure, in collaboration with Copyright Clearance Officers or others, the proper and accurate clearance of all material used in the program.

  • Determine the order and importance of various elements of a program.

  • Assign, co-ordinate and supervise the work of personnel who contribute to the program or segment for which the Producer is responsible.

  • Identify, develop and maintain contacts appropriate to the area of assignment.

  • Oversee internet site design and structure and organize and co-ordinate on-line content.

  • Oversee the shooting, editing, encoding, digitizing and packaging of digital audio and video for the internet.

  • Prepare programs for the Internet, including coding, and manipulating images and graphics.

  • Edit and mix, or direct the editing and mixing of audio and/or visual elements.

We are looking for a candidate with the following profile:

  • Extensive knowledge of international professional and amateur sports (special emphasis on Olympic sports).

title: Senior Software Engineer, Tech Foundations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. It takes a unified team committed to our core values to achieve this goal. Airbnb's various functions embody the company's innovative spirit and our fast-moving team is committed to leading as a 21st century company.

The Client and Identity Engineering team is accountable for establishing the user identity and endpoint security infrastructure in Airbnb's corporate environment. Client and Identity Engineering encompass corporate zero trust deployments. Our systems enable all Airbnb employees and partners to have secure access to the data they need at the right time and in the right context. We provide Airbnb employees and partners with the best-in-class experience, enabling them to effectively build our platform.

The Difference You Will Make

The team works on systems which have higher reliability and security requirements than most backend systems or services. Our products are critical services, downtime across these services can result in downtime for Airbnb employees and partners. In addition, the team collaborates closely with our security engineering teams to design new features and evolve the platforms to meet the engineering challenges as business needs present themselves.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build and maintain robust, scalable, and secure systems that underpin the entire Airbnb Zero Trust ecosystem. You will play a pivotal role in the execution for these critical platforms. This is an opportunity to be a part of impactful work, and contribute to the safety and trust of the Airbnb community.

A Typical Day

  • Work with open source products to build the next generation client platform for all Airbnb corporate endpoints.
  • Build on our zero trust back end suite, supporting security services, network paths, and user and device signaling, with a mind for enabling value for the business for their best work.
  • Support executive level Airbnb staff with endpoint and identity solutions.
  • Work with product and engineering teams to optimize endpoints and identity flows for Airbnb employees and partners.

Your Expertise

  • Bachelor's and/or Master/PhD's degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in test driven software development.
  • Extensive experience with Go, Python, or Java (Go strongly preferred).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure as code deployments.
  • Experience developing and deploying services in a Kubernetes environment.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work well within engineering organization and cross functions
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Experience leading technical projects and mentoring junior engineers.
  • Show motivation for personal growth and learning new technologies to support the team's needs.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with microservices architecture.
  • Familiarity with Apple MDM spec and its implementation in modern MDM deployments.
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization principles and technologies, such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID, SAML, ABAC, and related Zero Trust security protocols.

Your Location:

This position is based in California - ideally San Francisco. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

$196,000—$227,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ or @ email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Lead Board Certified Behavior Analyst
description:
You already know what a BCBA job looks like. What's harder to learn from a posting is what happens when you're ready to have a bigger impact — on your clients, your team, and the center around you.

The Lead BCBA role is for someone who wants to stay deeply connected to clinical work while taking on more leadership, mentorship, and ownership. You'll continue managing your own clients and making clinical decisions, while also helping develop BCBAs and RBTs, supporting families, contributing to center growth, and using data to help your center perform at its best.

Who sets the clinical bar.
Our VP of Clinical Quality and Training, Liza Bodner, led the team that built the Gracent Care Calculator: a peer-reviewed clinical tool that recommends treatment intensity based on the child, not a default. We presented it at CASP 2026 in Las Vegas, then made it free to the entire field (). What that means for you: you don't have to advocate for good practice here. You just practice — and help the clinicians around you do the same.
As a Lead BCBA, you'll be a clinical resource for your team. You'll help newer BCBAs think through challenging cases, mentor RBTs and BCBA students, support onboarding and training, and partner with your Area Director to maintain a high clinical standard across the center.

How you'll keep growing.
This isn't a role where you trade your caseload for meetings.

You'll maintain direct clinical accountability while taking on additional responsibility for the people and the center around you. You'll conduct assessments, develop treatment plans, provide parent training, supervise RBTs/BTs, and continue doing the clinical work you enjoy.

At the same time, you'll help with hiring, mentor and onboard clinicians, support family tours and community outreach, and use data to identify opportunities to improve center performance.

For strong performers, this role can be a path toward Clinical Director. It can also open opportunities to support new center development, growing centers, high-capacity Clinical Directors, or provide leadership coverage when another center needs additional support.

At a glance

  • Caseload: 6–8 clients · 16–20% supervision built into your week · ~28 billable hours
  • Pay: $90K–$110K incl. bonuses. Plus $50/billable hour over 30, paid biweekly
  • Schedule: Full-time. A midday appointment doesn't cost you PTO
  • Time off & benefits: 25+ days off year one · 75% company-paid medical/dental/vision · 401(k) match · $500 PD stipend · free in-house CEUs (BACB ACE Provider)
  • Setting: In-person, St. Charles, IL

How it actually works, the full picture

Progress you can prove.

We don't just say a child is improving; we measure it and make it visible. Our STEP Score, family Report Cards, and other outcome tools give teams a shared view of progress so clinical decisions are backed by data and families can see meaningful movement.

You'll also use Power BI data to identify opportunities within your center — from makeups and unconverted hours to follow-ups and overall schedule performance.

One child, one plan, many minds.
BCBAs, SLPs, OTs, PTs, and mental health providers work the same cases, often co-treating, so a child's plan reflects the whole picture, not parallel services that never speak. As a Lead BCBA, you'll help model what strong interdisciplinary collaboration looks like and encourage the clinicians around you to use the full expertise of the team.

A real bridge to the classroom.
Our half-day Prep School supports children working toward a traditional classroom who still need 1:1 support. Your clinical work connects to a concrete next step in a child's life, inside a model most providers simply don't have.

Support the center beyong your caseload.
Being a Lead BCBA means thinking about more than the clients on your schedule. You'll help identify opportunities to improve center operations, support makeups and unconverted hours, participate in family tours, and represent Gracent in marketing and community outreach efforts. You'll work alongside your Area Director to make sure families have a great experience from their first interaction with the center through their child's ongoing care.

How your schedule actually works.
Full-time, part-time, or reduced schedule, built around your life. A midday appointment doesn't cost you PTO; you work around it.

What you'll do

  • Maintain direct clinical accountability by conducting assessments, developing treatment plans, providing parent training, and supervising RBTs/BTs.
  • Provide clinical mentorship and support to BCBAs and RBTs.
  • Mentor and onboard newer BCBAs and support their continued clinical development.
  • Assist with hiring and help build a strong clinical team.
  • Partner with the Area Director on clinical quality, team development, and center priorities.
  • Use Power BI data to identify opportunities around makeups, unconverted hours, follow-ups, and center performance.
  • Support marketing, community outreach, and family tours.
  • Partner with families and help ensure a positive experience throughout their child's care.
  • Collaborate with SLPs, OTs, PTs, and mental health providers to provide truly interdisciplinary care.
  • Support new center development, high-capacity centers, or other centers when additional clinical leadership is needed.

What you'll work with

  • Standardized assessments: ABLLS-R, VB-MAPP, AFLS, PEAK, Vineland
  • FBAs and BIPs built around the child
  • Skill-acquisition programming across communication, social, adaptive, and academic domains
  • The Care Calculator and our outcome-measurement tools (STEP Score, Report Cards)
  • Parent and caregiver training as a core part of every plan
  • A clinical leadership team invested in your development

What you bring

  • BCBA certification, licensed in IL and in good standing
  • Strong clinical judgment and clear, proactive communication
  • A genuine interest in mentoring and developing other clinicians
  • Minimum 2 years of applied experience as a BCBA
  • Ability to perform essential functions such as sitting, standing, bending, and occasionally lifting up to 45 lbs. Reasonable accommodations may be made.

What it pays. What it includes.

  • Competitive base, plus a $50/hour bonus for billable hours above 29/week, paid biweekly
  • Medical, dental, and vision for you and your family (75% company-paid)
  • 25+ days off in your first year, including PTO and 7 paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match
  • $500 annual Professional Development stipend and free in-house CEUs as a BACB ACE Provider

Pressure test us.

Clinical autonomy, built-in supervision time, true interdisciplinary collaboration, real mentorship. That's what you'll actually decide on. If anything here sounds too good, or doesn't match what you're hearing elsewhere, ask us in the interview. We're genuinely open to talking it through.

Apply now, or hear directly from our team at BehaviorLive (use code BCBA for free CEs): behaviorlive.com/organizations/Gracent.
North Shore Pediatric Therapy is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse clinical teams build better programs for the diverse kids and families we serve. We hire, develop, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Total compensation includes base and eligible annual bonus.

Total compensation
$90,000—$110,000 USD

Join Our Team at Rolling Hills Hospital

Rolling Hills Hospital has been providing life-changing behavioral health care for adolescents, adults, and senior adults since 1988. When you choose Rolling Hills, you benefit from our decades of experience, comprehensive age-appropriate services, and commitment to personalized care. At every step, patients receive clinically superior services delivered by dedicated professionals in an atmosphere of dignity, respect, and compassion.

We are currently seeking an experienced and dedicated Psychiatrist to join our multidisciplinary team. The Psychiatrist is responsible for the diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing management of patients with mental health disorders through a combination of psychotherapy, psychoanalysis, medication management, hospitalization, and other evidence-based treatment modalities. The Psychiatrist will collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary treatment team to evaluate patient needs, develop individualized treatment plans, and ensure the highest level of patient care and safety.

This role is critical in delivering comprehensive psychiatric services that focus on improving patient outcomes, promoting recovery, and enhancing overall well-being.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations and assessments.
  • Diagnose and treat a variety of mental health disorders in adolescent, adult, and geriatric populations.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor individualized treatment plans.
  • Prescribe and manage psychotropic medications as appropriate.
  • Provide psychotherapy and other therapeutic interventions when indicated.

title: Manufacturing Cell Trainer (Team Lead)
description:
At LiquidStack, we’re redefining what’s possible in the data center world. As a global leader in advanced liquid cooling solutions, we’re powering the future of AI, edge computing, and high-performance systems. Our team is growing, and we’re looking for skilled professionals who want to be part of something innovative and impactful.

The Cell Trainer is an experienced manufacturing professional who serves as the process and training resource for an assigned production cell. Working alongside operators, this role helps ensure work is performed safely, consistently, and efficiently while supporting daily production objectives.

The Cell Trainer owns the work within the cell—including training, process execution, workflow coordination, continuous improvement, and New Product Introduction (NPI). By providing real-time coaching and reinforcing standard work, the Cell Trainer helps build employee capability and drives operational excellence.

The Cell Trainer is not a supervisory position. Responsibility for employee performance management, attendance, discipline, scheduling decisions, and Human Resources matters remains with the Production Supervisor.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Builds confident, qualified operators through effective training and coaching.
• Creates a safe, organized, and quality-focused work environment.
• Supports consistent production performance through standard work.
• Partners with Engineering, Quality, and Operations to improve manufacturing processes.
• Identifies and implements continuous improvement opportunities.
• Models the behaviors that define the LiquidStack Way.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Process Ownership

• Coordinate daily work activities to achieve safety, quality, delivery, and productivity goals.
• Ensure compliance with work instructions, BOMs, and quality standards.
• Identify process issues and support corrective actions.
• Maintain production readiness through equipment checks, tooling verification, and 5S.

Training & Employee Development

• Train, qualify, and cross-train employees.
• Maintain training records.
• Provide respectful, real-time coaching focused on the work.

Daily Workflow Coordination

• Confirm staffing within the production cell at shift start.
• Assign operators to workstations based on production priorities and training needs.
• Communicate staffing or production concerns to the Production Supervisor.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

• Support pilot builds and new product launches.
• Validate work instructions, tooling, and production readiness.
• Provide manufacturing feedback to Engineering and Quality.
• Train operators on new products and processes.

Continuous Improvement

• Lead 5S, PDCA, Kaizen, and standard work improvements.
• Track improvements and sustain gains through updated training and documentation.

Safety & Quality Leadership

• Promote safe work practices and GMP compliance.
• Address unsafe conditions and quality concerns immediately.
• Support a culture where anyone can stop work for safety or quality.

KPI Ownership

• Monitor safety, quality, productivity, training completion, CI activity, and NPI performance.
• Use KPI trends to identify opportunities for improvement.

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive pay with opportunities for overtime
  • Consistent day-shift schedule
  • Paid time off, holidays, and great benefits
  • Be part of an industry-disrupting company with room to grow
  • Work on innovative technologies in a collaborative, supportive environment

title: BCBA Clinical Director
description:
You already know what a Clinical Director does. What's harder to learn from a posting is how much you'll actually own, who's behind you when a day goes sideways, and whether the company is doing work worth leading. So that's where we'll start.

What you'll own.
This is your center. You set the clinical standard, develop the team, and own the quality of care that goes out the door — with the authority to shape how your center actually runs, not just enforce someone else's playbook. We hire leaders, then trust them to lead.

The support behind you.
Leading a center is hard; doing it without backup is harder. Here you're not alone: scheduling, billing, authorizations, and RBT recruiting sit with dedicated teams, so your time goes to clinical leadership and your people. Our VP of Clinical Quality and Training, Liza Bodner, along with our Regional Director, Ryan Emry, and Area Director, Sandy Reeson, are a phone call away when a case or a decision is genuinely hard.

The work is worth leading.
Liza led the team that built the Gracent Care Calculator: a peer-reviewed clinical tool that recommends treatment intensity based on the child, not a default. We presented it at CASP 2026 in Las Vegas, then made it free to the entire field (). We're a BACB ACE Provider running free in-house CEUs. As a Clinical Director, you don't just apply that standard, you help carry it, and your clinicians grow because of how you lead.

At a glance

  • Scope: Clinical and operational oversight of your center along with a reduced case of roughly 60 client hours
  • Supervision: 12–20% target supervision · 2.5–5% Family Treatment Guidance (FTG)
  • Pay: $100,000 - $120,000 incl. bonuses
  • Schedule: Full-time. A midday appointment doesn't cost you PTO
  • Time off & benefits: 25+ days off year one · 75% company-paid medical/dental/vision · 401(k) match · $500 PD stipend · free in-house CEUs (BACB ACE Provider)
  • Setting: In-person, St. Charles, IL

How it actually works — the full picture

You lead the clinical bar; you don't fight for it.
Because our model individualizes treatment intensity (via the Care Calculator) and protects supervision time as real structure, you spend your energy developing clinicians and raising quality, not defending good practice to a spreadsheet.

Progress you can prove.
We measure outcomes and make them visible. Our STEP Score, family Report Cards, and OBM dashboards give you a clear, shared read on whether care is working across your center. So you lead with data, coach with specifics, and show families real movement.

One child, one plan, many minds.
Your center runs genuinely interdisciplinary care. BCBAs, SLPs, and OTs work the same cases, often co-treating, and you orchestrate that collaboration instead of refereeing parallel services.

A real bridge to the classroom.
Our half-day Prep School supports children working toward a traditional classroom who still need 1:1 support. This is another lever you lead with, and a model most providers don't have.

Real support, real autonomy.
Operational load (scheduling, billing, authorizations, RBT recruiting) sits with the teams whose job it is. You get the autonomy to run your center and the backup to do it well.

How your schedule actually works.
Full-time, built around your life. A midday appointment doesn't cost you PTO; you work around it.

What you'll do

  • Own clinical quality and day-to-day operations for your center
  • Supervise your team and actively support their development
  • Manage performance and team accountability, including interdisciplinary collaboration
  • Support hiring — help build the team you actually want to lead
  • Partner with families and lead family engagement
  • Keep the center audit- and review-ready (compliance you can stand behind)

What you'll work with

  • The Care Calculator and our outcome-measurement tools (STEP Score, Report Cards)
  • Standardized assessments: ABLLS-R, VB-MAPP, AFLS, PEAK, Vineland
  • Operational dashboards for clinical quality, supervision, and center health
  • An interdisciplinary team (SLPs, OTs, PTs, mental health) on shared cases
  • A clinical-leadership bench, including our VP of Clinical Quality & Training

What you bring

  • BCBA certification, licensed in TX and in good standing
  • Supervisory or leadership experience, and the judgment to develop other clinicians
  • Comfort owning both clinical quality and operational health — you're fluent in the data
  • Clear, proactive communication and a high clinical bar
  • Genuine commitment to children and families navigating autism and developmental needs
  • Ability to perform essential functions such as sitting, standing, bending, and occasionally lifting up to 45 lbs. Reasonable accommodations may be made.

What it pays. What it includes.

  • Competitive Clinical Director compensation — $100,000 - $120,000, incl. bonuses
  • Medical, dental, and vision for you and your family (75% company-paid)
  • 25+ days off in your first year, including PTO and 7 paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match
  • $500 annual Professional Development stipend and free in-house CEUs as a BACB ACE Provider

Pressure test us.
Real ownership, a clinical-leadership team behind you, true interdisciplinary collaboration, and the autonomy to run your center well, that's what you'll actually decide on. If anything here sounds too good, or doesn't match what you're hearing elsewhere, ask us in the interview. We're genuinely open to talking it through.

Apply now, or hear directly from our team at BehaviorLive (use code BCBA for free CEs): behaviorlive.com/organizations/Gracent.

Gracent Pediatric Therapy is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse clinical teams build better programs for the diverse kids and families we serve. We hire, develop, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Total compensation includes base and eligible annual bonus.

Total compensation

description:
Exit Factor is Expanding the Team!
