title: PATIENT SCHEDULE COORD
description:
Overview

Patient Schedule Coordinator, Administration

Full Time, 80 Hours Per Pay Period, Day Shift

Covenant Oncology Group Overview:

Covenant Health Oncology Group is part of the region’s largest cancer-fighting network, with more imaging centers, more board-certified physicians and surgeons, and more cancer and radiation centers closer to where you call home. All Covenant Oncology Group practices are committed to excellence and ongoing quality improvement.

Covenant Oncology Group is a leader in medical oncology services and provides patients access to all proven, drug-based treatments and the latest clinical trial medicines. Our team of board-certified, fellowship-trained medical oncologists and certified advanced practice providers deliver on-site care and treatment, including chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, and hormone therapy, at affiliated infusion centers throughout our region.

Position Summary:

The Oncology/Hematology Patient Schedule Coordinator (PSC) manages the receipt of referrals to Thompson Oncology Group’s physicians: Hematologist/Medical Oncologists and Gynecologic Oncologists, at seven locations via multiple channels. The PSC locates, assembles, and assesses the patient’s medical records to screen for appropriateness and urgency in conjunction with the medical staff, then completes the assigned intake processes while working with patients, our office staff teams, our partner providers, and others as necessary to coordinate and schedule the patient’s first appointment within defined timelines. The Patient Schedule Coordinator obtains reliable patient contact information, coordinates the insurance verification, and prepares the patient for the first visit then processes both outgoing and incoming new patient paperwork.

Responsibilities

  • Receives and consistently documents new patient referrals from multiple channels according to department processes.
  • Triage referrals in conjunction with the medical staff according to workflow algorithms and initiates processes to obtain medical records and all pertinent information to ensure optimal care coordination (medical records, test results, etc.).
  • Collects, organizes, and verify patient’s demographic and insurance benefits data to document accurately, including record set-up, in the registration systems (eCare, STAR, Mosaiq).
  • Effectively and appropriately communicates with referring providers, clinical staff, multidisciplinary colleagues, patients and other parties.
  • Reviews clinic schedules to fill all available appointment slots accurately and in accordance with established clinic-specific guidelines.
  • Prepares and provides patient instructions and appointment details orally and in writing as defined by department guidelines.
  • Explains and provides new patients with new patient packets per their preferred delivery method in keeping with department guidelines (MedChat, eMail, direct download from website, or mail).
  • Demonstrates effective and professional communication skills and call handling, including diffusing upset/distressed customers.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Follows policies, procedures, and safety standards. Completes required education assignments annually. Works toward achieving goals and objectives, and participates in quality improvement initiatives as requested.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Education:

None specified; will accept any combination of formal education and/or prior work experience sufficient to demonstrate possession of the knowledge, skill and ability needed to perform the essential tasks of the job, typically such as would be equivalent to a high school diploma or GED. Preference may be given to individuals possessing a Bachelor’s degree in a directly-related field from an accredited college or university.

Minimum Experience:

Experience in a medical setting or high volume customer call center.

Licensure Requirement:

None

title: Quality Control Assistant
description:
Overview

Kemin is seeking a detail-oriented Quality Assistant to join our team! In this role, you will support both Operations and external customers by performing a variety of analytical and wet chemistry activities that help ensure the quality and integrity of our products. Key responsibilities include sampling raw materials, conducting chemical analyses, maintaining and troubleshooting laboratory instrumentation, documenting and reporting project results, and supporting quality-related initiatives. You will also collaborate closely with Operations and Customer Service teams to help ensure product quality and customer satisfaction.

This position is primarily scheduled Monday through Friday during daytime hours; 6am-2:30pm, with occasional weekend work as business needs require.

Join the Kemin Team and Transform Lives!

We are a privately held, family-owned-and-operated global biotechnology company driven by curiosity and committed to transforming the quality of life for people, pets, and the planet.

We create solutions that strengthen health and wellbeing, provide nutrition and immune support for pets and production animals, safeguard the planet’s natural resources, and protect the global food supply chain for generations to come.

We supply over 500 specialty ingredients for various industries, including human and animal health and nutrition, pet food, aquaculture, nutraceutical, food technologies, crop technologies, textiles, biofuels, and animal vaccines.

We employ 3,500 global employees and operations in 90 countries, including manufacturing facilities in Belgium, Brazil, China, Egypt, India, Italy, San Marino, Singapore, South Africa, and the United States.

As a valued member of our team, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your financial, physical, and professional well-being:

  • Competitive Financial Package: Enjoy a rewarding salary, uncapped bonus opportunities, a 401k match program, and generous paid vacation and holidays.
  • Health and Wellness Support: Stay fit and healthy with our fitness reimbursement for the whole family, access to an on-site fitness center, a restaurant offering seasonal fresh food options, and free fresh fruit in break areas.
  • Career Development and Advancement: Unlock your potential with opportunities for growth and development throughout your entire career.
  • Continued Learning Opportunities: Grow your skills with our in-house learning platforms, offering thousands of training resources both live and online, and take advantage of tuition reimbursement for external post-secondary pursuits.
  • Service Opportunities: Make a positive impact with paid time off for service, partnerships with The World Food Programme and Habitat for Humanity, and local community initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Collect samples and receive raw materials and finished goods.
  • May test raw materials as applicable.
  • May perform raw material, finished goods and packaging release, with supervision, as applicable.
  • Must follow all procedures and SOPs and assist with updates.
  • Must maintain proper quality documentation.
  • Generate Certificate of Analysis.
  • Support Change Management process, as necessary.
  • Daily data entry into M3 and LIMs, as applicable.
  • Report any nonconformities by following applicable SOPs.
  • Send out supplier evaluation samples, as applicable.
  • Must follow good lab procedures, safety, etc.
  • Must work closely with cross functional teams (including Operations, R&D, and other quality groups.)

Qualifications

  • Education and Experience:
    • High School Diploma with two years of related experience OR
    • Associates Degree in a Science related field
  • Previous manufacturing, warehouse, inventory, inspection or other related experience preferred.
  • Must have and maintain an insurable driving record.
  • Good written and oral communication skills
  • Must have basic computer skills, including MS Office
  • Ability to operate, troubleshoot, perform maintenance, instruct, and perform method validation on lab equipment
  • Ability to interact well with others in a team environment
  • Must have basic math skills

title: VOIP ENGINEER - HYBRID
description:
Overview

Location: Hybrid in Pittsburgh, PA (3 days onsite, 2 days remote)

Job Type: Full Time - Contract Assignment

Work Authorization: No Sponsorship

The A.C.Coy Company has an immediate opening for a VoIP Engineer. Ideal candidates must have 5+ years of Cisco VoIP Engineer experience working in an enterprise size environment.

Responsibilities

The VoIP Engineer is responsible for daily server administration activities within the Voice-Over-IP platform. The successful candidate will be an experienced leader and technician in the space, and will have deep expertise in Cisco’s voice offerings. The VOIP Engineer will use their experience and expertise to work across teams to guide resolution of complex issues and provide subject matter input to designs.

  • This role will work closely with the network team in daily operations and is responsible for level 3 incident and problem response, ensuring that SLAs are met, change management, patching, vulnerability management and day-to-day support of our Cisco technologies
  • Serve as lead for assigned voice network development and software implementation projects; evaluate and assess client needs; identify and recommend allocation of resources including staff, equipment and materials; set task priorities
  • Troubleshooting & Optimization: Execute L2/L3 support and perform root cause analysis for voice issues, addressing packet loss, jitter, and latency

title: IP & Innovation Technical Specialist
description:
About X: X is Alphabet’s moonshot factory with a mission of inventing and launching moonshot technologies that could someday make the world a radically better place. We are a diverse group of inventors and entrepreneurs who build and launch technologies that aim to improve the lives of millions, even billions, of people. Our goal: 10x impact on the world’s most intractable problems, not just 10% improvement. We approach projects that have the aspiration and riskiness of research with the speed and ambition of a startup. As an innovation engine, X focuses on repeatedly turning breakthrough-technology ideas into the foundations for large, sustainable businesses.

About the Team: In this role, you will sit within the Legal team but embed deeply with X’s Early Pipeline teams. As the primary technical-legal liaison, you will be the connective tissue between these two world-class organizations.

The X Legal team works on the most exciting legal issues since our moonshots require creative and proactive guidance. We challenge ourselves to think big and differently in providing solutions and strategies for our clients—at X, the legal team can be audacious too! Our team aims to accelerate X while demonstrating values of respect, wellbeing, creativity, integrity, and continued development.

X’s Early Pipeline team has one goal: creating and incubating X’s next moonshots. They are a dynamic team of creative and collaborative engineers, innovative entrepreneurs, and scientists that focuses on identifying and de-risking ideas. They develop the foundations upon which groundbreaking products and businesses are built.

About the Role: X is looking for a deeply curious, technically versatile, and highly strategic IP & Innovation Technical Specialist to accelerate our earliest-stage breakthrough technologies. This role acts as the ultimate bridge between legal strategy and engineering reality. Working hand-in-hand with our Senior IP Counsel and the Early Pipeline teams, you will live at the frontier of innovation—evaluating early moonshot pitches, uncovering uncharted technological "white space," and mapping out leapfrog opportunities often before a single line of code is written or a prototype is built.

In this role, you will help create and implement unique and innovative IP strategies for X’s exciting new businesses and technologies. The IP portfolios you help develop will have a scope stemming from the innovations X produces and a value extending far beyond the immediate products and services X launches. Your contributions here will be a key part of demonstrating a return on investment for these projects. This role is distinct from standard IP roles because it focuses on “de-risking” radical technologies that don’t yet have a defined market.

This is not a traditional, back-office patent prosecution role. It is a highly collaborative, high-velocity position designed for a registered patent professional who wants to step directly into the engine room of a moonshot factory. You will use your deep technical acumen and patent expertise to de-risk radical concepts, shape the foundational boundaries of new projects, and translate raw engineering breakthroughs into robust, high-value patent pipelines that protect X’s long-term future.

How you will make 10X impact:

  • Early Pipeline De-Risking & Shape-Shifting: Partner directly with Early Pipeline teams to assess the viability of incoming moonshot pitches. Dig deep into enabling concepts during the conception and maturing phases to actively help teams define project scope and technical parameters.
  • Patent-Informed Innovation Harvesting: Lead regular brainstorming and high-touch IP harvesting sessions across early and mature project teams. Actively translate core engineering innovations into clear technical differentiators, streamlining raw ideas into a well-defined, value-add patent pipeline aligned with product roadmaps.
  • Advanced IP Landscaping & Market Signals: Lead, perform, and direct IP landscaping and white space analysis to identify strategic focus areas for moonshots using patents, non-patent literature, and public discourse. Use these findings and market signals to guide project leads and the IP Counsel on critical decisions regarding market entry or asset transfer.
  • Strategic IP Portfolio Development: Support the IP Counsel in the design and execution of a global IP strategy that aligns with the specific commercial goals of a project. Review and analyze internal and external patent assets to assess scope, perform gap-filling exercises, and help build a competitive “moat” around a project's core technologies.
  • The Legal-to-Engineering Bridge: Serve as a proactive, high-credibility liaison between engineering, product, and legal teams. Demystify the IP process by instituting regular patent roundtables and delivering technology-led IP trainings, empowering X’s technologists to capture high-quality, robust inventions early.
  • Foundational Asset Creation: Synthesize highly complex, early-stage technical concepts into formal Invention Disclosure Forms (IDFs). Manage the initial lifecycle of these disclosures, assist inventors with prioritization, and partner closely with Outside Counsel to drive high-quality external drafting and prosecution.
  • Actionable Freedom to Operate (FTO) Screening: Conduct initial technical clearings, prior art analysis, and landscape screenings to provide foundational data for FTO risk assessments in cutting-edge, often undefined or uncharted technology spaces.
  • Next-Gen IP Tooling & AI Prototyping: Collaborate with core software teams to develop and test cutting-edge, AI-led Moonshot discovery software. Build prompt repositories and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for subject-matter-expert-led white space identification to extract latent value from existing and pending IP assets.

What you should have:

  • Education: Technical undergraduate degree in a rigorous engineering or scientific discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Aerospace, Life Sciences, or Materials Science).
  • USPTO Registration: Admitted to practice before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office as a Patent Agent or Patent Attorney, with an active USPTO registration number.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in patent preparation, prosecution, and IP landscaping, ideally gained within a top-tier law firm technical specialist/patent agent program or a high-growth deep-tech corporate environment.
  • Early Portfolio Lifecycle Experience: Hands-on experience building, scaling, and managing patent portfolios for early-stage deep tech startups, university tech-transfer offices, or novel corporate R&D spin-outs.
  • Technical Chameleon: Exceptional, broad technical literacy with the ability to rapidly pivot between a wide range of technical domains and assess IP potential across diverse technological frontiers.
  • Elite Communication & Translation Skills: Demonstrated ability to go toe-to-toe with PhD-level researchers and world-class engineers, extract their core technical breakthroughs, and seamlessly translate them into actionable IP strategies while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.
  • Ambiguity Champion: Hands-on ability to make structured decisions with incomplete information and thrive with high levels of autonomy in a fast-paced, "fail-fast" scrappy start up environment.
  • AI Tech-Forward Mindset: Ability and enthusiasm to leverage cutting-edge developments in AI and generative prompting to enable smarter, more efficient work processes and white space discovery.

It would be great if you also had these:

  • Advanced Patent Analytics Expertise: Deep familiarity with modern patent analytics platforms (e.g., IPFolio, PatSnap, Anaqua, LexisNexis TotalPatent) and a strong enthusiasm for leveraging generative AI to automate white-space analysis and prompt engineering.
  • Deep Tech Specialization: A solid technical understanding of artificial intelligence, robotics, physics, clean energy, biotechnology, bioinformatics, or related deep-tech domains.
  • Startup Agility: A gritty, startup-oriented "roll up your sleeves" mindset—someone who is equally excited about defining high-level competitive landscapes as they are about digging into the fine details of a technical disclosure.
  • Executive Presence: Experience effectively presenting complex technological landscapes and IP insights to senior management, business executives, and cross-functional technical teams.

title: Junior Data Center Engineer
description:
Overview

Edgewater Federal Solutions is seeking a Junio Data Center Engineer to support a major national laboratory.

Responsibilities

  • Provide comprehensive support across all dimensions of the Data Center environment.
  • In this role, you will deliver Level I and/or Level II technical support to server technicians, network administrators, and support personnel for various systems, including cabling, power management, space planning, and cooling management in a large and complex Data Center setting.
  • Troubleshoot complex problems that span multiple subsystems and systems, requiring in-depth knowledge of the sophisticated Data Center environment.
  • Have a strong background in IT and High-Performance Computing (HPC) infrastructure, with a solid understanding of cooling, heat transfer, fluid mechanics, and chemical analysis for both open and closed-loop water systems.
  • Collaborative on data center consolidation efforts, engaging with customers to evaluate, design, and plan consolidation activities as needed.
  • Develop innovative solutions to significant and unusual problems, applying new principles, concepts, and practices to address complex or strategic issues.
  • Be a resource to executive management providing analysis of information, trends, and goals at a corporate level, contributing to the overall success and efficiency of the Data Center operations.

Qualifications

  • Requires BS in relevant discipline plus a minimum of 2 years, or more, of directly related experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform the duties.
  • Related experience may be substituted for relevant education and vice versa.
  • Ability to obtain & maintain a U.S. Dept. of Energy Clearance
  • U.S. Citizenship is required.

Required Skills:

  • Experience working in mission‑critical production environments with change control, incident response, and structured troubleshooting.
  • Ability to work safely and effectively in live data center spaces (DCFIT coordination, raised floor environments, cabling standards).
  • Strong understanding of L2/L3 networking fundamentals: VLANs, STP, LACP, static routing, OSPF, BGP, ACLs, QoS.
  • Experience configuring and supporting major network vendors (any of): Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Mellanox/NVIDIA Networking.
  • Familiarity with multipath topologies, spine‑leaf architectures, and high‑bandwidth fabrics.
  • Understanding of basic firewall and segmentation concepts (paths, zones, NAT, routing symmetry).
  • Familiarity with enterprise cabling best practices: fiber types (LR/SR/ER), transceiver selection, rack elevation awareness.
  • Working knowledge of monitoring and telemetry: CloudVision, Netropy/Apposite tools, Nagios/Prometheus/Grafana, or similar.
  • Ability to follow SOPs/MOPs, support planned change windows, and adhere to structured rollback/validation procedures.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, with a demonstrated ability to drive issues to resolution during outages.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to participate in on‑call rotations and support after‑hours change windows if needed.

Desired Skills:

  • Hands‑on experience with Arista EOS, Cisco NX‑OS, Juniper JunOS, or Mellanox/NVIDIA platforms supporting 40/100/400Gbps networks.
  • Experience with BGP tuning, traffic‑engineering policies, ECMP management, asymmetric‑routing detection, and complex route‑map design.
  • Familiarity with EVPN/VXLAN, modern DC underlays, and high‑availability routing gateway designs (HA router pairs, blue/green cutovers).
  • Experience troubleshooting firewall pathing issues, zone interactions, NAT64/NAT policy behavior, and segmentation used for HPC.
  • Exposure to HPC networks and interconnects:
  • RDMA, RoCE, basic InfiniBand concepts (subnet managers, fabric behavior).
  • Understanding of congestion behaviors common in HPC (parallel I/O bursts, GPU‑node communication patterns).
  • Familiarity moving or supporting HPC data flows across multi‑site infrastructures (tri‑lab WAN, DisCom, IHPC routing).
  • Understanding of distributed HPC storage systems (Lustre, BeeGFS, Isilon, Spectrum Scale) and the routing or MTU constraints around them.
  • Ability to work with HPC teams during large cluster deployments (rack placement coordination, switch firmware updates, cabling checks).
  • Hands‑on experience with automation or configuration management tools (Ansible, Python, Terraform).
  • Ability to build or maintain dashboards and telemetry for HPC network utilization (CloudVision pipelines, Netropy test data).
  • Familiarity with gNMI/gRPC or streaming telemetry for performance analysis and anomaly detection.
  • Understanding of high‑availability designs, reduced failure domains, and deterministic failover patterns in HPC networks.
  • Experience monitoring and optimizing latency, packet loss, MTU mismatches, and congestion across crypto tunnels or 100Gbps transport.
  • Ability to assist with capacity planning for rapidly growing HPC systems (rack density, port utilization, fiber paths, WAN circuit expansions).

About Us:

Edgewater Federal Solutions is a privately held government contracting firm located in Frederick, MD. The company was founded in 2002 with the vision of being highly recognized and admired for supporting customer missions through employee empowerment, exceptional services and timely delivery. Prior Department of State experience is not required. Prior experience with DoS HR systems is not required.

This position is well suited for an early-career HR professional who wants to develop specialized experience in HR systems and help desk support. The role provides an opportunity to build experience with enterprise HR applications, ServiceNow, federal HR processes, system access management, and structured help desk operations.

title: Expert Network Engineer
description:
Description

Markon is seeking an Expert Network Engineer to support an Intelligence Community client in Herndon, Virginia. The Network Engineer will work as part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary team providing technical subject matter expertise in network engineering, telecommunications, and communications modeling. This position will design, integrate, deploy, and support secure enterprise and field communications environments encompassing voice, video, data, LAN/WAN, RF communications, and other network technologies.

TRAVEL: The position may require up to 10% CONUS and 10% OCONUS travel, including travel to hazard areas as required. Travel requirements and duration are subject to customer mission needs.

Responsibilities

  • Provide network engineering and communications modeling subject matter expertise in support of U.S. Government missions.
  • Translate business requirements into telecommunications requirements, designs, and orders for LAN, MAN, WAN, voice, and video capabilities.
  • Develop complex network designs encompassing multiple technologies and technology layers across enterprise environments.
  • Incorporate INFOSEC and COMSEC security requirements into network architectures and engineering solutions.
  • Design and optimize network topologies and site configurations.
  • Plan installations, transitions, and cutovers of network components and capabilities.
  • Organize and direct network installations and site surveys.
  • Assess and document existing site network configurations and user requirements.
  • Evaluate emerging network technologies and provide recommendations regarding integration into existing network infrastructure.
  • Develop network designs and configurations that account for performance characteristics, network interconnect points, and optimal network performance.
  • Provide engineering and design support for the development and deployment of communications systems.
  • Research existing technologies and apply COTS/GOTS solutions to develop secure voice and data network infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and recommend COTS applications and methodologies that provide interoperable, portable, and scalable IT solutions.
  • Integrate communications system designs with network architectures to meet customer requirements.
  • Provide post-design support, including installation, configuration, and Tier III/IV operations and maintenance support for enterprise and field-deployed systems.
  • Configure, test, and maintain LAN, WAN, and system-level network infrastructure connected to enterprise architectures.
  • Create simulated network environments to test applications over low-bandwidth links.
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity and performance issues.
  • Install and configure wide-area communications links utilizing RF technologies, including satellite, cellular, and microwave communications.
  • Provide technical briefings and communicate network designs, recommendations, and results to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior government personnel.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must have an active TS/SCI with Full Scope Polygraph to be considered.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • Equivalent experience may be substituted for the educational requirement.
  • 9+ years of relevant experience, including the following knowledge areas:
    • Knowledge of Cisco routing and switching and network architecture planning.
    • Knowledge of remote administration and secure Virtual Private Networking (VPN), including IPsec and SSL.
    • Understanding of commercial encryption standards and their application within IP networking.
    • Understanding of Private Branch Exchange (PBX) telephony, including Avaya/Nortel telephone switch interfaces.
    • Understanding of RF transport mediums, including cellular, microwave, and satellite communications.
    • Understanding of wired data transport mediums, including Category 5e/6 and fiber optics.
    • Ability to design small- to medium-scale voice, video, and data networks.
    • Familiarity and experience with encryption devices and industry-standard commercial encryption methods.
    • Knowledge of WAN technologies, including ISDN, POTS, satellite voice and data circuits, and terminal device configuration.
    • Understanding and experience applying RF communications systems, including HF, VHF, UHF, microwave, and VSAT systems.
    • Thorough understanding and experience applying routing protocols, particularly TCP/IP.
    • Experience configuring and utilizing networking devices, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
    • Familiarity with wireless standards and technologies, including GSM, CDMA, 802.11, and 802.16.
    • Experience with network test and analysis equipment, including spectrum analyzers, network sniffers, LAN/WAN simulation equipment, and COTS software.
    • Knowledge of network intrusion detection.
    • Ability to convey technical designs, ideas, and results to non-technical audiences and brief senior government personnel.
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills.

Desired:

  • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) certification.
  • Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE) certification.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Server administration.
  • Knowledge of service-oriented system design.
  • Knowledge of VMware ESX Server and virtual system architecture.
  • Knowledge of Storage Area Network (SAN) technologies.

Salary Range

USD $180,000.00 - USD $200,000.00 /Yr.The Markon pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

At Markon, we don't just offer jobs – we offer opportunities for personal and professional transformation. As a perennial Washington Post Top Workplace, we prioritize the well-being and success of our team members, ensuring they can bring their best selves to work.

title: Senior Security Analyst
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£57,000 - £70,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨


At Monzo our mission is to make money work for everyone. Central to this is making sure the bank is safe and secure for our customers. We’re always keen to hear from people who believe in our mission and want to join us on this journey.

We’re looking for a proactive, curious, technically-minded and organised Senior Security Analyst to join Monzo's Security team.

Our team is Monzo’s front door to Security, helping the whole business operate securely. This means you’ll get exposure to a wide range of business context and a broad mix of information security work. One day you might be assessing the security of a new supplier; the next you could be supporting an audit or assurance review, assessing the risks of a new product or technology change, updating a policy, or helping a team turn regulatory requirements into practical action.

You’ll work closely with security specialists, engineers, product teams, third party risk, procurement, and colleagues from across Monzo to solve interesting problems and strengthen how we effectively manage security risk as we grow.

We want security to protect Monzo without creating unnecessary friction or compromising user experience. You’ll have the opportunity to make a notable impact in an environment where security is both a priority and an opportunity for innovation!

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Delivering third party security and supplier security assurance: assess new and existing suppliers, reviewing questionnaires, certifications, and other evidence to understand their security posture. Use your judgement to identify risks, translate technical findings into recommendations, and work with teams across Monzo to manage them throughout the supplier lifecycle. Help us build a more effective, scalable and industry-leading third party security capability as Monzo grows!
  • Delivering security assurance activities: lead and contribute to control testing, PCI DSS assessments, regulatory reviews, and internal and external audits. Evaluate evidence, identify gaps and work with teams across Monzo to see findings and remediation through to completion.
  • Strengthening our governance: improve security policies, procedures and controls so they’re practical, proportionate, and reflect how things work in reality.
  • Supporting our Security Front Door: work alongside our other analysts to respond to security questions and requests from across Monzo, bringing in specialists when needed and finding ways to make the experience better for other Monzonauts.
  • Taking ownership and running with it: turn loosely defined security problems into clear outcomes, work out the best way forward, and bring in the right people to make it happen.
  • Helping teams build and change safely: work with engineers, product teams and other colleagues to understand what they’re trying to achieve. Review new products and technology or business changes, identify security risks and control gaps, and turn security and regulatory expectations into requirements that work in practice.
  • Improving how we work: use data, automation and AI to make our processes simpler and more scalable, while exploring new ways technology can help us work smarter.
  • Raising the bar for security: bring fresh perspectives to real-world security challenges, keep developing your own skills and knowledge, and help less experienced analysts grow.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You understand security risk: you’re comfortable identifying and assessing security risks, and can recommend proportionate ways to manage them. Experience in third party security or supplier security assurance would be a bonus!
  • You can evaluate security evidence: you can review supplier questionnaires, security policies, penetration test reports and assurance evidence, and know when to dig deeper.
  • You have strong security fundamentals and technical curiosity: you understand core security concepts and good practice, are comfortable getting into technical detail, and ask thoughtful questions to get to the heart of a problem.
  • You think beyond the task in front of you: you look for patterns and root causes, use evidence and data to prioritise and look for ways to make things work better.
  • You’re proactive: you can make progress independently, seek out the information you need, and are comfortable challenging assumptions to move things forward.
  • You can manage competing priorities: you can juggle different pieces of work, keep people informed, and make sensible decisions about what needs attention or escalation.
  • You’re a clear communicator: you can explain security risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences in a way that works for them.
  • You enjoy collaborating: you like working with people across different disciplines, building strong relationships, and helping make security easier to do well.
  • You’re passionate about security: you’re excited by the challenges and opportunities in cyber security, keep up with an evolving industry, and are motivated to continue developing your knowledge and skills.

🙏 It would be great if…

  • You’ve worked in financial services, fintech, or another highly regulated environment.
  • You’ve supported PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or NIST-aligned assurance, regulatory reviews, or internal and external audits.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £57,000 - £70,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Intro call with the recruiter
  • 30 min call with the hiring manager
  • 2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews

This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-09-29 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role


CBC/Radio-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Vulnerability and External Attack Surface Management, to optimize the Corporation’s vulnerability management program and design, build and deploy its external attack surface management (EASM) service.

In this role, you will take strategic and operational ownership of this domain. You will establish a comprehensive map of the Corporation’s external digital footprint — including internet-exposed assets, domains, certificates, cloud accounts, public APIs and exposed data — while driving continuous improvements to internal and hybrid vulnerability management. As a recognized subject matter expert, you will serve as a technical authority for leadership, maintain the vulnerability and exposure risk register, and adjudicate security exemption requests across the organization.

This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.

What’s in It for You

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.

As Lead Analyst, you will:

  • Map the digital footprint: Identify, classify and inventory CBC/Radio-Canada’s complete external attack surface for the first time, establishing the baseline for domain names, subdomains, public IP address ranges, exposed services, public cloud environments and APIs.
  • Implement continuous detection: Develop and execute procedures to detect inadvertently exposed services, expired or vulnerable certificates and leaked credentials or source code on the public web.
  • Lead the vulnerability life cycle: Define and optimize end-to-end processes for vulnerability detection, triage, impact analysis, prioritization, remediation and verification.
  • Define the scanning strategy: Establish the scope and frequency of automated and manual vulnerability scans across the entire IT environment.
  • Assess risk in context: Evaluate discovered vulnerabilities by cross-referencing CVSS scores with business context, asset criticality, existing compensating controls and active threat intelligence (e.g., known exploits).
  • Develop remediation plans: Recommend targeted corrective measures — such as patch management, system reconfigurations, temporary workarounds or WAF/firewall rules — for internal teams.
  • Lead zero-day response: Provide technical leadership during critical zero-day vulnerabilities and incidents (e.g., Log4j, major OS/hardware flaws), co-ordinating rapid detection and mitigation.
  • Evaluate and adjudicate security exemptions: Conduct in-depth technical reviews of exemption requests when prescribed patching or remediation timelines cannot be met. Assess residual risk based on exploitability and asset criticality, requiring robust compensating controls where necessary.
  • Manage the vulnerability risk register: Document, maintain and map unpatched vulnerabilities, security technical debt and approved exceptions in the Corporation's risk register. Monitor residual risk levels, update mitigation plans and present clear status reports to governance and executive committees to inform adjudication and investment decisions.
  • Partner on compliance and regulatory frameworks: Work closely with the policy and compliance lead to align vulnerability detection and remediation processes with regulatory requirements, internal policies and industry standards.
  • Develop metrics and dashboards: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to monitor program effectiveness.
  • Drive program evolution and threat intelligence: Continually enhance security tools and processes to address emerging threats (e.g., zero-day vulnerabilities). Monitor global vulnerability trends, proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits and evolving frameworks (e.g., CVSS v4, MITRE ATT&CK).
  • Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

What You Bring

  • University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
  • Minimum five years' experience in vulnerability management, risk assessment or IT governance, including at least three years in an information security role.
  • Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical decision-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
  • Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
  • Technical expertise across key domains:
    • Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, NIST SP 800-53 / 800-161, COBIT and ITIL.
    • Cloud and Web Architecture Security: Solid understanding of web infrastructure and cloud environment security.
    • Network and Security Technologies: Thorough understanding of network architectures (LAN/WAN, routers), network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, DNS, web filtering) and cryptographic principles (encryption at rest and in transit).
    • Architecture and Data Security: Working knowledge of database architecture concepts and secure software development best practices.
    • Operational Resilience and Physical Security: Solid understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning (BCP/DRP), operational resilience and physical security controls.
  • Relevant professional security certifications a definite asset (e.g., CISSP, CRISC, CBCP, CISA, CISM or equivalent).
  • Bilingualism (English and French) essential.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

Overview

We are seeking an ambitious, highly organized, and strategic Director, New Business to drive growth for our media agency. In this mid-level leadership role, you will manage the end-to-end Request for Proposal (RFP) process, orchestrate the agency pitch pipeline, and help position our media services to prospective clients. You will sit at the crossroads of our strategy, data, and creative teams to build compelling narratives that win new business.

Core Responsibilities

  • Prospecting & Market Intelligence: Research emerging brands, track spending shifts, and identify prospective clients that align with the agency's growth goals

  • Collateral Development: Create and continuously update the agency’s marketing materials, credential decks, case studies, and proprietary tool overviews.

  • Reporting & Tracking: Maintain data cleanliness in the agency CRM, tracking win/loss metrics, pitch costs, and prospective client health.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: 5 to 7 years of experience working within an advertising or media agency, with at least 2 years focused specifically on business development or account management.

  • Project Management: Exceptional organizational skills with a proven track record of handling high-pressure deadlines and multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Communication: Masterful written and verbal communication skills, including a talent for turning complex media data into simple, persuasive pitch decks.

  • Tech Savvy: High proficiency in presentation software (Keynote, PowerPoint) and CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), alongside familiarity with media research platforms like Nielsen or Comscore.

title: Software QA Analyst
description:
About the Company

Unifin Inc is a BPO company with multiple operations in North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific Region. We are looking for an extraordinary talent who will be part of our unique and diverse team. Do you love taking challenges and making your brilliant ideas into reality?

Be one of us, and be part of our success story!

Your Role

This role is responsible for performing quality assurance testing across Unifin's internal software systems. The position will primarily execute manual testing efforts, create and maintain testing documentation, identify and validate software defects, and work directly with development teams to ensure high-quality releases. Experience with Playwright or other test automation frameworks is highly desirable but not required for the role.

About You

For you to become a successful candidate for this role:

  1. Quality Assurance (Primary Responsibility)
    1. Create, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, regression suites, and testing documentation
    2. Perform manual functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, and user acceptance testing.
    3. Identify, document, reproduce, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution.
    4. Work directly with developers to troubleshoot issues, clarify expected behavior, and validate fixes
    5. Participate in requirements and release discussions and provide QA feedback on testability, risks, and readiness
  2. Test Automation (Preferred)
    1. Develop, maintain, and execute automated test cases using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or comparable frameworks.
    2. Identify repetitive, high-value, and regression-prone scenarios that are appropriate for automation.
    3. Maintain reliable automated test suites and investigate test failures in collaboration with developers.
    4. Automation experience is a preferred qualification rather than a minimum requirement; candidates with strong manual QA fundamentals and limited automation experience may be considered at the Junior or Mid-Level range.
  3. Documentation & Process Improvement
    1. Maintain clear and accurate test cases, test results, defect records, release validation documentation, and QA artifacts.
    2. Help improve QA processes, testing standards, regression coverage, and defect-prevention practices.
    3. Contribute to continuous improvement of testing workflows, tools, and documentation

Required Qualifications

  • Education in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Practical experience in software quality assurance or software testing with strong fundamentals in manual testing.
  • Understanding of software development and QA life cycles, defect management, test cases, and regression testing.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with developers, QA team members, and business stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple testing activities and priorities

Permanent Work from Home Requirements:

  • USB headset (combined microphone and headphones) with noise-canceling feature
  • Internet Connection - Internet access via cable or fiber only (DSL, satellite, or wireless connections are not permitted) | Minimum download speed of 100 Mbps | Minimum upload speed of 100 Mbps | Must be hardwired directly to the PC or laptop (Wi-Fi/wireless not allowed)

At UNIFIN, we understand that our corporate success starts by attracting the right people, developing and mentoring those that show potential, and taking steps to retain our top performers.

When you join UNIFIN, you do more than joining a company. You become part of a talented team and self-driven individuals dedicated to bringing success to the Company and their lives.

Do you think you fit all of this? Click the apply button now!

title: Frontend UI Engineer with German
description:
Czym będziesz się zajmować?

The customer, a large infrastructure organization, invests in digital technologies and scalable solutions.

The project develops and maintains modern, responsive user interfaces based on design specifications.

Responsibilities:

  • Developing, optimizing, and maintaining responsive, accessible web pages and applications based on design specifications and mockups.
  • Transforming static designs into interactive user interfaces and building reusable, modular components aligned with design system guidelines.
  • Implementing and maintaining component-based architectures using modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Integrating frontend components with backend APIs and third-party services for dynamic data rendering.
  • Ensuring cross-browser and cross-device compatibility and resolving UI inconsistencies.
  • Ensuring compliance with WCAG and web accessibility standards.
  • Optimizing frontend performance, including load times, rendering, resource usage, and caching.
  • Managing client-side state using libraries such as Redux, Zustand, or MobX.
  • Coordinating usability testing, debugging, and resolution of UI issues with Software Engineering teams.
  • Preparing and maintaining technical documentation for UI components and workflows.


Kogo poszukujemy?

Must-haves:

  • Experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field for 2+ years.
  • Hands-on experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Experience with client-side state management using Redux, Zustand, MobX, or similar libraries.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architecture, reusable component development, and responsive web applications.
  • Level of English – from Upper-Intermediate+ and above.
  • Level of German – from Upper-Intermediate+ and above.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering.


Czego wymagamy?

Znajomości:
  • React
  • Angular
  • Vue.js
  • Redux
  • Zustand
  • MobX
Języki:
  • Angielski

Jakie warunki i benefity otrzymasz?

  • Umowa o pracę - Stałe godziny pracy (100%)
  • Praca zdalna: W całości
  • Budżet szkoleniowy, Szkolenia wewnętrzne
  • Pakiet medyczny, Ubezpieczenie, Pakiet sportowy
  • Kawa / Herbata, Zimne napoje
  • Parking, Parking rowerowy, Pokój relaksu


Kim jesteśmy?

Andersen – your global software development partner Andersen is a global software development company with over 18 years of experience supporting businesses worldwide in their digital transformation.

Headquartered in Poland, we operate development centers across Germany, the USA, the UK, Lithuania, Hungary, Kazakhstan, Georgia, Azerbaijan, Cyprus, and the UAE, enabling us to deliver high-impact solutions close to our customers. We offer end-to-end IT services — from custom software development, API integration, and system architecture to legacy modernization and long-term support. With deep technical expertise and a focus on business value, we build tailored, scalable, and secure digital products. Harnessing the power of AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Big Data, and Visual Technologies, we create intelligent, future-ready solutions that support digital transformation and solve real-world business problems.

Recognized among the world’s Top 1,000 B2B service providers, Andersen has earned the trust of industry leaders. title: Senior Digital Project Manager
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Senior Project Manager for Hex do at WPP Production?

The Senior Digital Project Manager plays a pivotal role in shaping HEX Studio’s evolution as WPP’s frontier studio built for the era of AI and advanced creative technology. The role is responsible for the coordination and delivery of AI-native workflows, CGI production, gaming (Unreal Engine/Unity), and immersive experiences (AR/VR/XR), alongside innovation workstreams like WPP Open Pilots, Production Studio demos, and proofs of concept. To learn more about the Hex Studio: .

This requires a unique ability to translate strategic ambitions into actionable delivery plans, bridging creative, technical, and operational teams to ensure that frontier technologies are deployed effectively, creatively, and responsibly. The Senior Digital Project Manager oversees a portfolio of cutting-edge projects, ensuring that all work is delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest standards of innovation, quality, and client satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • AI & Frontier Tech Delivery: Lead the end-to-end project management of AI and advanced technology initiatives—from scoping and planning to execution and delivery—specifically leveraging WPP Open to build and deploy AI-powered production, agentic workflows, CGI, and real-time gaming solutions.
  • Project Leadership: Initiate and execute highly complex creative-tech projects, including scope, budget, and schedule definition. Ensure effective management of scope changes, technical briefing, burn rates, and progress tracking.
  • Financial Control: Manage projects with at least a £250K budget, ensuring rigorous financial tracking, resource allocation, and reconciliation.
  • Technical Translation: Act as the crucial bridge between client/agency requirements and our specialist frontier teams (AI engineers, prompt engineers, CGI artists, real-time developers, and data engineers), translating complex technical concepts into clear actions and deliverables.
  • Agile Enablement: Promote agile, iterative, and rapid-prototyping delivery approaches suited to fast-evolving tech environments; coach internal teams and clients to embrace experimentation, AI-assisted workflows, and rapid learning.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Act as an internal source of expertise in the digital and creative-tech project management field, establishing best practices for managing non-traditional, AI-native creative pipelines.
  • Team Mentorship: Support and mentor more junior members of the team, training them on frontier project lifecycles and emergent workflow best practices.
  • Stakeholder Management: Represent HEX Studio to clients, brand partners, and broader WPP agencies, ensuring clear communication, education, and alignment on frontier production capabilities.
  • Closure & Documentation: Oversee project closure documentation to ensure learnings from R&D, pilot programs, and AI workflows are captured and scaled across the wider network.

Requirements

All Project Managers must demonstrate proven capability in the following areas:

  • Scope Management: The ability to control the work included in a project, ensuring that highly complex, experimental, and fluid tech scopes can be delivered within agreed parameters.
  • Time Management: The ability to ensure timely completion of projects, adapting traditional sprint and gantt structures to fast-paced AI and real-time 3D pipelines.
  • Cost Management: The ability to plan, estimate, and control costs so that projects can be completed within the approved budget; this includes resource planning for specialized talent (e.g., Unreal devs, AI specialists) and project reconciliation.
  • Quality Management: The ability to ensure that project delivery meets the exceptionally high creative and technical standards defined by HEX Studio and our global clients.
  • Resource Management: The ability to task-manage globally distributed, highly specialized technical and creative project teams.
  • Communication Management: The ability to link people, highly technical ideas, and creative visions seamlessly throughout a project life cycle.
  • Risk Management: The ability to identify, analyze, and properly respond to project risks, particularly those associated with emerging technologies, IP, and beta-phase software.
  • SCRUM/Agile: The ability to use Agile/Scrum methodologies fluidly within a creative technology and R&D environment.
  • Client Servicing: The ability to guide, educate, and manage client needs through the entire lifecycle of pioneering tech projects.
  • Technical Literacy: Strong practical understanding of AI models, their application in creative production, and familiarity with real-time 3D/gaming pipelines (Unreal Engine/Unity) and CGI.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5+ years of Digital Project Management/Production experience.
  • Creative Tech Agency Experience: Experience working in digital, innovation, or creative production agencies on large global accounts.
  • Decoupled & Collaborative Ecosystems: Experience working in a decoupled environment and collaborating effectively with other agencies, third-party developers, and tech platforms.
  • Enterprise Tech & Content Engines: Strong knowledge of Enterprise Content Management systems, DAMs, and CRM systems.
  • Experience delivering large-scale technology projects, innovation workstreams, and pioneering digital products.
  • Global Teams: Proven experience managing globally distributed, multi-disciplinary project teams.

Desirable Skills

  • Cross-office and international project management experience.
  • Knowledge of a foreign language.
  • Copywriting/Editing skills, particularly for technical documentation.
  • Test Management & Execution – Understanding of QA practices.

#LI-hybrid #LI-RS1

The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range as listed below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click here for more details.

US Pay Range
$60,000—$140,000 USD

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.

title: Budtender - Part-Time
description:
Who we are..

C3 Industries is a multi-state, vertically integrated cannabis company headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan, operating the High Profile Cannabis Shop retail network alongside several product brands, including the award-winning Cloud Cover Cannabis, Galactic Cannabis, and Habitat Cannabis. Through its High Profile locations in Connecticut, Illinois, Michigan, Missouri, Massachusetts, Kentucky, and New Jersey, the company provides customers with access to high-quality cannabis products and exceptional retail experiences.

What we're looking for...

The Sales Associate is responsible for delivering world-class customer service while driving sales through personalized product recommendations and effective upselling techniques. This role involves guiding customers through the process of understanding, selecting, and purchasing cannabis products that align with their needs and preferences. By combining deep product knowledge with a proactive sales approach, the Sales Associate helps create a positive shopping experience that maximizes both customer satisfaction and store performance.

Dispensary Address: 185 Spencer St, Manchester, CT 06040

Operating Hours: 8am-10pm M-Sat, 8am-6pm Sun

Rate of Pay: 17.00/hr

In this role you will….

  • Provide the highest level of service to customers by making their experience the top priority.
  • Meet or exceed individual sales targets and conversion rate goals as defined by store leadership upon hire, using effective sales techniques and a deep understanding of customer needs to drive performance and contribute to overall store success.
  • Greet customers upon entry and perform initial check-in verification of required identification (ID).
  • Assist new customers with questions on state required forms; updating customer information in system as needed.
  • Ensure the waiting room is well maintained and the sales floor is properly stocked during downtime.
  • Educate customers on cannabis properties and selection of proper genetics according to their desired effect, ailments, or requests.
  • Fill online orders in a quick and efficient manner, keeping customer experience at the forefront.
  • Handle customer complaints in a professional manner; escalating to management when needed.
  • Maintain product, brand, and strain knowledge and keep up on current cannabis trends.
  • Accurately use and maintain point of sale (POS) system.
  • Comply with company cash handling policies and perform daily cash management responsibilities and compliance reporting.
  • Assist with intake of product, inventory counts, and additional audits on a regular basis.
  • Work closely with the management team to increase sales and foot traffic.
  • Support daily compliance with dispensary policies, including but not limited to the following: state/local regulation compliance, security protocols, access protocols, inventory tracking, dress codes, and work schedules.

    Skills and experience you have...

    • 1+ years’ customer service experience.
    • High school diploma or GED.
    • Experience with POS systems and cash handling practices.
    • Commitment to reaching Key Performance Indicators on a regular basis.
    • Effective multi-tasker with demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks.
    • Ability to work independently with little or no direct supervision.
    • Demonstrate strong oral and written communication skills; ability to correspond in a professional and businesslike manner.
    • Knowledge of state and local regulations is preferred.
    • Ability to pass a background check and is 21 years of age or older.
    • Willingness to work nights, weekends, and some holidays.
    • Must be able to obtain and maintain required state licenses based on work location.

      Our mission is to share our love of cannabis with the world. If you’re interested in being part of our journey, we’d love to hear from you!

      Benefits

      • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance for full-time staff
      • Life Insurance
      • Short-term & Long-term Disability Insurance
      • 401k
      • Company Paid Holidays
      • Company Swag
      • Employee Discount

      PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS

      The physical demands and work environment characteristics described below are representative of those that may be encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

      Ability to remain in a stationary position, move about the work area, and operate standard office, retail, or production equipment, as applicable to the position.
      Ability to communicate effectively, including exchanging information through speaking, hearing, and other means as necessary.
      May occasionally be required to bend, stoop, reach, crouch, or perform repetitive motions associated with the duties of the position.
      May occasionally be required to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds; frequent lifting and movement of up to 25 pounds may be required.
      Depending on the work location and position, employees may be exposed to varying temperatures, noise levels, equipment, facility environments, or retail settings.
      Prolonged periods of standing, walking, or sitting may be required based on the nature of the role.

title: CRM Analyst
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website ().

Descrição da vaga

Olá,

Estamos felizes com o seu interesse em se juntar ao time de CRM da Monks! :)
A posição de CRM Analyst é um dos pilares de excelência operacional da empresa, responsável por transformar dados, competências e informações em ações concretas que impulsionem os resultados do negócio. A pessoa Analista será responsável pela implementação técnica e operacional das iniciativas de CRM, atuando na construção, configuração, testes, publicação e acompanhamento de campanhas, jornadas, automações, segmentações e demais configurações das plataformas, de acordo com os requisitos de negócio e as especificações técnicas de cada projeto. Trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe e outras áreas, com atenção aos detalhes, organização e foco na execução, garantindo que as entregas sejam realizadas dentro dos prazos e padrões de qualidade esperados e estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos dos clientes.

Espera-se também uma postura de aprendizado contínuo, com interesse em aprofundar conhecimentos em CRM, dados, programação e plataformas de automação de marketing, desenvolvendo novas habilidades que agreguem valor à sua carreira, à equipe e à organização.

Se você gosta dessa área de trabalho, essa vaga pode ser sua!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

No seu dia a dia de trabalho você será responsável por:

  • Execução e Operação: Executar as demandas operacionais e técnicas de CRM, garantindo qualidade, precisão e cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Implementação de Campanhas e Jornadas: Construir, configurar, testar e publicar campanhas, jornadas, réguas de relacionamento, automações e demais iniciativas de CRM.
  • Análise e Tomada de Decisão: Analisar dados e informações para identificar tendências, oportunidades e problemas, propondo soluções e otimizações para campanhas e processos.
  • Análise de Resultados: Acompanhar e interpretar KPIs de CRM, como taxas de entrega, abertura, cliques, conversão, bounce e descadastro, identificando possíveis causas para os resultados e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Comunicação e Colaboração: Trabalhar de forma integrada com a equipe e demais áreas envolvidas nos projetos, garantindo uma comunicação clara e eficiente e apoiando o alcance das metas.
  • Qualidade das Entregas: Garantir que campanhas, segmentações, códigos, jornadas e demais configurações sejam devidamente revisados e testados antes de sua publicação.
  • Aprendizagem e Desenvolvimento: Buscar continuamente o desenvolvimento das competências técnicas e comportamentais necessárias para a função, aprofundando conhecimentos nas plataformas e tecnologias utilizadas.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos, fluxos de trabalho, campanhas e automações, contribuindo para maior eficiência operacional e evolução da estratégia de CRM.

Requisitos e qualificações

Trabalhando na área, é esperado que você tenha:

  • Plataformas de CRM: Operar plataformas de CRM e automação de marketing, com conhecimento em Adobe Campaign e Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC). Espera-se capacidade para operar as principais funcionalidades relacionadas à execução de CRM, incluindo:
    • Criação, configuração e publicação de campanhas;
    • Construção de jornadas e réguas de comunicação;
    • Configuração de automações;
    • Criação e manutenção de segmentações;
    • Configuração de públicos e critérios de elegibilidade;
    • Configuração de disparos e agendamentos;
    • Construção e manutenção de templates;
    • Criação de Landing Pages simples;
    • Testes e publicação de campanhas;
    • Monitoramento das execuções e identificação de possíveis erros.
  • Programação e desenvolvimento: Trabalhar com HTML e CSS para criação e manutenção de templates de e-mail, considerando boas práticas de responsividade, compatibilidade entre clientes de e-mail e dark mode.
    Dependendo da plataforma e do projeto, poderá trabalhar também com:
    • SQL;
    • AMPscript;
    • XML;
    • JavaScript e outras linguagens ou recursos específicos das plataformas de CRM, todas em nível básico.
    • Deverá compreender lógica de segmentação e utilização de operadores lógicos, principalmente “E” e “OU”, para construção e validação de públicos.
  • Adobe Campaign: Atuar na operação e configuração de iniciativas de CRM dentro do Adobe Campaign e Salesforce Marketing Cloud, incluindo, conforme o escopo do projeto:
    • Construção e configuração de campanhas;
    • Configuração de deliveries;
    • Construção e manutenção de workflows;
    • Segmentação e tratamento de públicos;
    • Configuração de regras e critérios de campanha;
    • Testes e validação das comunicações;
    • Agendamento e publicação de campanhas;
    • Monitoramento das execuções e identificação de erros;
    • Análise dos resultados das campanhas.
  • Estratégia de CRM: Apoiar a construção e evolução das estratégias de CRM dos projetos, contribuindo com iniciativas como:
    • Campanhas pontuais;
    • Estratégias de segmentação;
    • Priorização e cadência de disparos;
    • Estratégias de engajamento e reengajamento;
    • Aquecimento de IPs;
    • Identificação de oportunidades de automação e persona.

Informações adicionais

LGPD Monks

Nós da Monks colocamos a política de LGPD nos nossos processos seletivos para trazer segurança e transparência sobre as pessoas que estão se candidatando nas vagas para fazer parte da nossa equipe.

Ficou dúvida ou tem interesse em saber mais, basta ler as nossas políticas de privacidade.

🚨 Alerta de golpe! - Vagas falsas

Fomos informados que estão utilizando o nome da Monks para divulgar vagas falsas pelo WhatsApp e/ou Telegram. Reforçamos que todas as nossas comunicações realizadas via WhatsApp serão formalizadas via e-mail através da plataforma Greenhouse, com os dias e horários que entraremos em contato.
