title: Administratief medewerker planning & operations
description:
Welcome at LGI Group - we stand for innovative strength, transparent communication and short decision-making processes. To drive our company forward, we are looking for people who can see things from a different perspective and thus develop exciting ideas. Because that's the only way we can make a difference! Do you want to make a difference with us?

Administratief Medewerker Planning & Operations

Fulltime / 40 uur – locatie Ruurlo

LGI Technical Logistics is gespecialiseerd in logistieke dienstverlening tot op gebruikerslocatie van kwetsbare apparatuur in Europa. Wij bieden onze opdrachtgevers een totaalconcept: van pré-installatie en warehousing tot (retouren)logistiek, installatie on site en gebruikersinstructie.

In verband met de verdere groei van onze organisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een Administratief Medewerker Planning & Operations.

Een functie voor iemand die energie krijgt van structuur, cijfers, administratie en het verbeteren van processen, maar die zich tegelijkertijd thuis voelt binnen een dynamische logistieke planningsomgeving.

Je wordt onderdeel van het team Planning en werkt nauw samen met onze planners, coördinatoren, chauffeurs, Customer Service, Finance en andere interne afdelingen. Jouw belangrijkste focus ligt op de administratieve ondersteuning en verwerking rondom de planning, waaronder urenverwerking, controle en voorbereiding van facturatie en het bewaken van de administratieve kwaliteit.

Daarnaast krijg je een belangrijke rol in het verder professionaliseren van de planningsadministratie. Je kijkt kritisch naar de huidige werkwijze, signaleert waar informatie ontbreekt of dubbel wordt verwerkt en denkt actief mee over hoe processen slimmer, overzichtelijker en efficiënter kunnen worden ingericht.

De functie

Als Administratief Medewerker Planning & Operations ben je een belangrijke schakel binnen het planningsteam. Je zorgt ervoor dat de administratieve processen rondom de dagelijkse operatie correct, volledig en tijdig worden uitgevoerd.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw werkzaamheden is de urenverwerking. Je controleert geregistreerde uren, ritten en werkzaamheden, signaleert afwijkingen en stemt deze waar nodig af met planners, chauffeurs en andere betrokkenen.

Ook ondersteun je bij de facturatievoorbereiding. Je zorgt ervoor dat de juiste informatie beschikbaar is, controleert gegevens en signaleert eventuele afwijkingen voordat deze richting facturatie gaan.

Daarnaast wordt van jou verwacht dat je verder kijkt dan alleen het verwerken van administratie. Je krijgt nadrukkelijk de ruimte om de administratieve organisatie binnen Planning naar een hoger niveau te brengen.

Denk hierbij aan:

  • het verbeteren en standaardiseren van administratieve werkprocessen;

  • het inzichtelijk maken van verantwoordelijkheden binnen de planning;

  • het verminderen van handmatige en dubbele administratieve handelingen;

  • het verbeteren van de volledigheid en betrouwbaarheid van gegevens;

  • het bewaken van deadlines rondom urenverwerking en facturatie;

  • het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van overzichten, controles en rapportages;

  • het signaleren van afwijkingen en structurele knelpunten;

  • het verbeteren van de informatieoverdracht tussen Planning, Customer Service en Finance;

  • het meedenken over verdere digitalisering en automatisering;

  • het creëren van meer structuur en uniformiteit in de planningsadministratie.

Je bent daarmee niet alleen bezig met “de administratie bijhouden”, maar hebt juist een actieve rol in het verbeteren van de administratie en processen rondom Planning.

Je werkt nauw samen met de planners en coördinator Planning. Je begrijpt wat er operationeel speelt en weet dit te vertalen naar een correcte en overzichtelijke administratie.

Dit ga je doen

  • Verwerken, controleren en bewaken van urenregistraties;

  • Controleren van ritten, werkzaamheden en administratieve gegevens;

  • Signaleren en corrigeren van afwijkingen in uren en ritgegevens;

  • Voorbereiden en controleren van gegevens ten behoeve van de facturatie;

  • Controleren of opdrachten administratief volledig zijn afgerond;

  • Ondersteunen van planners bij administratieve werkzaamheden;

  • Beheren en structureren van administratieve gegevens binnen de planning;

  • Opstellen en bijhouden van diverse overzichten en rapportages;

  • Bewaken van administratieve deadlines;

  • Verzorgen van een correcte en tijdige overdracht van informatie naar Finance en andere afdelingen;

  • Ondersteunen bij de administratieve verwerking van projecten en opdrachten;

  • Signaleren van knelpunten en ontbrekende informatie binnen administratieve processen;

  • Meedenken over en implementeren van verbeteringen binnen de planningsadministratie;

  • Standaardiseren en verder professionaliseren van administratieve werkwijzen;

  • Meedenken over digitalisering, automatisering en het slimmer inrichten van systemen;

  • Ondersteunen bij KPI-rapportages en managementinformatie;

  • Fungeren als administratieve vraagbaak binnen het planningsteam.

De uitdaging: Planning administratief naar een hoger niveau

Binnen LGI groeit de operatie en daarmee ook de hoeveelheid informatie die rondom transporten, projecten, uren en facturatie wordt verwerkt.

Daarom zoeken we iemand die niet alleen goed is in administratie, maar ook ziet waar dingen beter kunnen.

Je krijgt binnen deze functie de mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan een verdere professionalisering van de administratieve processen binnen Planning. Je onderzoekt hoe we informatie slimmer kunnen vastleggen, controleren en delen.

Je kunt bijvoorbeeld denken aan het ontwikkelen van een duidelijke structuur voor urencontrole, het verbeteren van controles vóór facturatie, het standaardiseren van werkwijzen tussen planners en locaties of het ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages.

Ook kijk je kritisch naar de vraag: kunnen we dit slimmer, eenvoudiger of automatisch laten verlopen?

Daarbij werk je samen met Planning, Finance, Customer Service en waar nodig IT. Je krijgt dus de ruimte om verbeteringen daadwerkelijk aan te dragen en – in overleg – te implementeren.

Je hebt kennis van

  • Administratieve processen binnen een operationele omgeving;

  • Urenregistratie en controleprocessen;

  • Facturatieprocessen of facturatievoorbereiding;

  • Excel en bij voorkeur andere administratieve/planningssystemen;

  • Het werken met gegevens, rapportages en controles;

  • Procesverbetering en het structureren van administratieve werkzaamheden;

  • Bij voorkeur enige kennis van transport, logistiek of planning.

Dit ben jij

  • MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met administratieve werkzaamheden;

  • Ervaring binnen transport, logistiek, planning, service of een vergelijkbare operationele omgeving is een pré;

  • Je bent sterk in cijfers, gegevens en controles;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd;

  • Je ziet snel wanneer informatie niet klopt of ontbreekt;

  • Je bent analytisch en vindt het leuk om zaken uit te zoeken;

  • Je kunt goed overweg met Excel en digitale systemen;

  • Je bent IT-minded en nieuwsgierig naar mogelijkheden voor digitalisering en automatisering;

  • Je hebt een goed gevoel voor processen en ziet waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega's;

  • Je bent communicatief vaardig en durft collega's aan te spreken wanneer informatie ontbreekt of niet klopt;

  • Je kunt goed prioriteiten stellen in een dynamische omgeving;

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed in woord en geschrift;

  • Basiskennis van de Engelse taal is gewenst;

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 5 dagen per week.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent iemand die graag orde schept in informatie. Je vindt het prettig wanneer gegevens kloppen en processen goed zijn ingericht.

Je wacht niet af totdat iemand vertelt wat er moet gebeuren, maar ziet zelf waar zaken blijven liggen of beter kunnen.

Je bent:

  • Nauwkeurig en administratief sterk;

  • Gestructureerd en resultaatgericht;

  • Analytisch en kritisch;

  • Proactief en zelfstandig;

  • Goed met cijfers en systemen;

  • Sterk in het bewaken van afspraken en deadlines;

  • Oplossingsgericht;

  • Communicatief vaardig;

  • Niet bang om vragen te stellen of door te vragen;

  • Geïnteresseerd in procesverbetering en automatisering;

  • Flexibel en stressbestendig;

  • Bereid om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen;

  • Leergierig en enthousiast om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Last but not least… je brengt positiviteit, energie en humor mee naar het team!

Dit krijg je van ons

  • Een fulltime baan van 40 uur per week;

  • Een goed salaris op basis van opleiding en ervaring, conform CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding conform CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer;

  • Vakantiedagen conform CAO;

  • Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief;

  • De mogelijkheid om daadwerkelijk verbeteringen binnen de organisatie door te voeren;

  • Een afwisselende functie binnen een groeiende logistieke organisatie;

  • Goede koffie en fruit op het werk;

  • Deelname aan het Bene(FIT)s@LGI-programma;

  • Een fijne werksfeer en een prettige werkomgeving.

Word jij onze nieuwe administratieve kracht binnen Planning?

Ben jij iemand die graag structuur aanbrengt, cijfers en administratie goed op orde heeft én het leuk vindt om processen slimmer en beter te maken?

Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Bij LGI krijg je niet alleen een administratieve functie, maar de kans om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere professionalisering van onze planning en operationele organisatie.

Dit zijn wij

LGI Netherlands BV is een internationale logistieke dienstverlener en onderdeel van de Elanders Group uit Zweden. Wij zijn gespecialiseerd in supply chain-oplossingen binnen onder andere Electronics, Healthcare en Lifestyle.

Met een combinatie van wereldwijde slagkracht en persoonlijke betrokkenheid werken wij dagelijks aan slimme logistieke oplossingen voor onze klanten.

Sollicitatieprocedure

Ben jij enthousiast geworden over deze functie en zie jij jezelf werken binnen een informele, professionele en inspirerende werkomgeving? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Solliciteren kan uitsluitend via onderstaande link:

  • LINK IN TE VOEGEN

Let op: alleen sollicitaties die volledig en zorgvuldig via bovenstaande link zijn ingediend, worden in behandeling genomen. Zorg er daarom voor dat alle gegevens correct en compleet zijn ingevuld en voeg zowel je cv als motivatie toe.

Hoe ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit?

1. Jouw sollicitatie

Na ontvangst van jouw sollicitatie beoordelen wij zorgvuldig of jouw profiel aansluit bij de functie. We streven er naar om je uiterlijk binnen 5 werkdagen een terugkoppeling te geven.

2. Eerste gesprek – Kennismaking

Locatie: op kantoor of digitaal via Teams
Duur: circa 30 minuten

Tijdens dit gesprek maken we graag persoonlijk kennis met jou. We bespreken jouw motivatie, werkervaring, ambities en natuurlijk de inhoud van de functie. Ook krijg jij alle ruimte om vragen te stellen en meer te ontdekken over onze organisatie.

3. Tweede gesprek – Verdieping

Locatie: op locatie
Duur: ongeveer 1 tot 1,5 uur

In deze ronde gaan we dieper in op jouw ervaring, competenties en de manier waarop jij binnen het team en de organisatie past.

4. Meeloopmoment – Ervaar de werksfeer

Tijdens het meeloopmoment krijg je de kans om de organisatie, werkzaamheden en toekomstige collega's beter te leren kennen. Zo krijg je een realistisch beeld van de functie én de sfeer binnen het team.

5. Aanbod & start

Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan stellen wij een passend contract voor je op en kijken we uit naar een mooie en succesvolle samenwerking samen.

title: Enterprise Epic Architect
description:
Enterprise Epic Architect

Data Analytics / Information Technology

Position Summary

The Enterprise Epic Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for the strategic design, governance, and optimization of the enterprise Epic analytics ecosystem, with a primary focus on the Epic Cogito analytics stack (Clarity, Caboodle, Cogito Cloud, SlicerDicer, Reporting Workbench, Radar, and Business Objects), Epic Cosmos, and Epic Agent Factory. This role serves as the enterprise authority on Epic data architecture, predictive modeling enablement, and analytics governance, ensuring infrastructure is scalable, secure, well governed, and aligned with organizational strategy across clinical, operational, and financial domains.

The Enterprise Epic Architect partners closely with Epic application teams, enterprise data analytics, IT infrastructure, compliance, and executive leadership to build a unified, trusted, and high performing analytics foundation. This role also leads analytics maturity efforts under Epic's Gold Stars and Honor Roll recognition programs, driving enterprise wide adoption of Epic reporting and analytics best practices to achieve and maintain industry recognized analytics excellence.

Reports To: Director Data Analytics, AI and Business Systems

FLSA Status: Exempt
Department: Data Analytics and Insights

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture and Data Strategy

  • Design and maintain the enterprise architecture for Epic's Cogito analytics suite, including Clarity, Caboodle, Cogito Cloud, and associated reporting and analytics tools.
  • Define data architecture standards, governance policies, and best practices for extraction, transformation, and consumption of Epic clinical and operational data.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority on Epic data models, schema design, and downstream data integration strategy.
  • Develop and maintain the enterprise roadmap for Epic analytics capabilities, including migration and optimization strategy for Cogito Cloud, in alignment with organizational priorities.

Epic Cogito Stack Ownership

  • Architect and optimize Clarity, Caboodle, and Cogito Cloud data warehouse structures to support enterprise reporting, self-service analytics, and advanced data science initiatives.
  • Provide architectural oversight for Reporting Workbench, Radar dashboards, SlicerDicer, and Business Objects universes to ensure consistency, performance, and scalability.
  • Lead technical evaluation and adoption of new Epic analytics capabilities, including Epic Cosmos and Epic Agent Factory.
  • Ensure Epic analytics environments are properly tuned, monitored, and maintained for performance and reliability.

Epic Cosmos and Agent Factory Enablement

  • Lead enterprise strategy for leveraging Epic Cosmos multi-organization data to support benchmarking, research, and predictive analytics initiatives.
  • Architect and govern the deployment of Epic Agent Factory based AI agents and automation solutions across clinical and operational workflows.
  • Partner with clinical, operational, and data science stakeholders to identify high value use cases for Cosmos data and Agent Factory automation.
  • Ensure appropriate governance, validation, and monitoring frameworks are in place for AI agents and Cosmos derived insights.

Predictive Modeling and Advanced Analytics

  • Architect the data foundation required to support predictive modeling initiatives, including feature engineering pipelines sourced from Clarity, Caboodle, and Cosmos.
  • Partner with data science and clinical informatics teams to operationalize predictive models within Epic workflows (e.g., risk scores, care gap alerts, deterioration indices).
  • Ensure predictive model outputs are properly integrated, validated, and monitored within Epic and downstream reporting environments.
  • Guide model governance practices including performance monitoring, drift detection, and revalidation cadence in partnership with data science teams.

Epic Gold Stars and Honor Roll Analytics

  • Analyze current state reporting and analytics utilization against Gold Stars and Honor Roll benchmarks to identify capability gaps and prioritize remediation.
  • Partner with analytics team members and report developers to optimize dashboard design, self-service adoption, and reporting standardization in support of program criteria.
  • Track, document, and present analytics maturity progress and program metrics to executive leadership and Epic program representatives.
  • Use Gold Stars and Honor Roll participation as a benchmark to continuously elevate enterprise analytics quality, governance, and adoption standards.

Data Governance and Security

  • Establish and enforce data governance standards for Epic sourced data across the enterprise, ensuring compliance with HIPAA and organizational security policies.
  • Partner with compliance, privacy, and security teams to ensure appropriate access controls, auditing, and data stewardship practices are in place.
  • Define and maintain data lineage, metadata management, and documentation standards for enterprise Epic data assets, including Cosmos and Agent Factory outputs.

Cross-Platform Integration

  • Architect integration strategies connecting Epic Cogito data, Cosmos, and Agent Factory outputs with enterprise platforms including Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure, and other enterprise data warehouse or lakehouse environments.
  • Collaborate with enterprise data teams to ensure Epic data is efficiently and securely made available for downstream reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases.
  • Support integration of Epic data with emerging AI and automation initiatives, including data agents, AI Foundry, and Cosmos based solutions.

Technical Leadership and Governance

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and mentor for Epic analytics developers, BI developers, and analytics engineers.
  • Lead architectural design reviews and provide technical guidance on enterprise reporting, analytics, and predictive modeling projects.
  • Partner with Epic application teams (Clinical, Revenue Cycle, Ambulatory, etc.) to ensure architectural alignment across the enterprise Epic ecosystem.
  • Represent Data Analytics in enterprise architecture review boards, IT governance committees, and Epic upgrade planning sessions.

Strategic Partnership

  • Act as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on the capabilities, limitations, and opportunities within the Epic Cogito analytics platform, Cosmos, and Agent Factory.
  • Partner with vendor relationships (Epic, Microsoft, and other analytics platform partners) to stay ahead of platform capabilities and roadmap changes.
  • Support organizational AI and analytics strategy by ensuring the Epic data foundation is architected to support current and future advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI initiatives.


Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree preferred.

Experience

title: Associate Director, Environmental Health and Safety
description:
Our mission is to make biology easier to engineer. Ginkgo is constructing, editing, and redesigning the living world in order to answer the globe’s growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more. Our bioengineers make use of an in-house automated foundry for designing and building new organisms.

Grow with Ginkgo

Our mission is to make biology easier to engineer. We move fast across multiple business units, and right now we're building the world's first autonomous lab right here in Boston. Our team is ambitious, hands-on, and energized by hard problems - think tech-company pace and curiosity, applied to biology.

Job Description

Ginkgo isn't slowing down, and neither should you. As we push into new territory - including building the world's first autonomous lab - keeping our team safe and our infrastructure compliant is mission-critical work. The Associate Director, EH&S will lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive Environmental Health and Safety programs across Ginkgo sites. This role requires a resourceful, hands-on leader who can build practical, scalable EH&S programs with the lean resources of a company our size while maintaining site-specific operational excellence. The ideal candidate will have previous experience in chemical hygiene as well as working within regulated environments such as CLIA or FDA. You will work cross-functionally to drive efforts to optimize laboratory safety and infrastructure to enhance efficiency and quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Regulatory Compliance: Manage all applicable EH&S permits (Local, State, Federal) including County AQMD, EPA, OSHA, USDA, and Fire Departments. Ensure compliance with regulated processes, including CLIA standards.
  • Management Systems: Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the EH&S Management System, including event reporting, CAPA management, bio-risk management, and chemical hygiene programs.
  • Program Leadership: Lead the authoring and maintenance of EH&S programs for the organization with a view toward building scalable corporate programs.
  • Operational Oversight: Support site leaders to progress EH&S programs and actively measure performance through compliance metrics.
  • Training & Development: Develop and improve training materials, managing both in-person and online training via the Learning Management System.
  • Committee Management: Direct site EH&S Committees, chairing meetings and working collaboratively to deploy global safety standards.
  • Expansion Support: Transition existing EH&S programs into new facilities, creating site-specific manuals and coordinating contractor or site-level support as needed, working within a lean team structure.
  • Audit & Inspection: Develop internal inspection and audit programs for lab safety, flammable inventory checks, and controlled substance reconciliation.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Facilities, Shipping and Receiving, and Technical Management to ensure regulatory compliance.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Four-year degree (BS/BA) in Science, Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Science, or a related applicable degree.
  • Experience: 4+ years of management and EH&S experience specifically in a laboratory or manufacturing setting. Demonstrated knowledge of managing Chemical Hygiene programs.
  • Program Execution: Demonstrated ability to create and execute EH&S programs that engage employees and enable a safe work culture.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of systems under applicable regulatory controls at the local, state, and federal levels.
  • Communication: Advanced interpersonal and communication skills, with a focus on collaboration, innovation, and inclusion.

Preferred Capabilities

  • Advanced Degree: Master's degree in a scientific discipline or engineering field.
  • CLIA Familiarity: Working knowledge of CLIA lab requirements, with the ability to take on ongoing CLIA compliance ownership if needed.
  • Systems & Process Improvement: Comfortable identifying and adopting modern tools, including AI-assisted approaches, to improve program efficiency and reduce manual overhead.
  • Strategic Alignment: Ability to quantitatively capture initiative deliverables and link outcomes to corporate strategy and vision.

DEI is in Our DNA

There is a serious lack of diversity in our industry, and we are committed to driving change. Our culture promotes inclusion and embraces the value of working with people from all walks of life. We care about how our biological engineering platform is used, and having a diverse team gives us the best chance to build something we are proud of.

It is the policy of Ginkgo Bioworks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants.

The base salary range for this role is $127,000k- $190,000k. Actual pay within this range will depend on a candidate's skills, expertise, and experience. We also offer company stock awards, a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental & vision coverage, health spending accounts, voluntary benefits, leave of absence policies, 401(k) program with employer contribution, 8 paid holidays in addition to a full-week winter shutdown and unlimited Paid Time Off policy.

Ginkgo has implemented a return to office policy effective October 1, 2025 with required in-office days 5 days per week. This policy applies to all employees who live within 50 miles of Ginkgo’s offices in Boston, MA, Emeryville, CA and West Sacramento, CA.

It is the policy of Ginkgo Bioworks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees, employment applicants, and EOE disability/vet.

description:
About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We are a diverse group of technology, legal, and operational professionals who develop new approaches to solving classic problems using cutting edge tools and processes.

The Role: Head of Consumer and Lending Compliance

In this role, you will lead the compliance program for Gemini’s deposit and lending products, including the first-in-class crypto rewards credit card and business credit card. You will be responsible for creating a comprehensive strategy to scale the program and support the business in delivering product features in a compliant and consumer-friendly way. The ideal candidate will have a deep knowledge of consumer finance regulations, be solutions-oriented, and have experience operating in a fast-moving environment. Superior communication skills are essential, as this individual will be required to communicate effectively with various stakeholders, including product, technology, legal, risk, as well as banking partners and regulators. This role reports directly to Gemini’s Global Chief Compliance Officer and has a direct line of communication to the Board.

  • Provide regular reporting to the Board of Managers and other governance committees
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Gemini and its sponsor bank partner
  • Respond to internal and external audits, examinations, and regulatory inquiries related to credit card card operations
  • Oversee risk assessments for consumer banking products, identifying potential areas of risk and working cross-functionally to manage such risks
  • Serve as the Fair Lending Officer overseeing the company’s fair lending program
  • Ensure proper oversight of vendors and other third parties that present potential compliance or regulatory risk
  • Oversee remediation plans for high priority issues to ensure timely remediation and remedy of any compliance-related issues
  • Remain up-to-date on regulatory changes and landscapes, best practices and developments in the industry and ensure our implementation is both compliant and forward thinking

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree. CRCM or Juris Doctor preferred

title: Intermediate Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Intermediate Business Intelligence Analyst

We are seeking a Intermediate Business Intelligence Analyst to support a public sector organization's data strategy and modernization initiatives. This role is fundamental to designing and developing analytical data products and services that enable the organization to leverage its data assets effectively. The successful analyst will translate complex data into actionable business insights that support strategic decision-making across departments and with external stakeholders, working within a collaborative team environment to deliver high-quality analysis, data modeling, visualizations, and evidence-based recommendations.

This position requires someone who can deliver business intelligence capabilities and develop data products based on various datasets to support internal and external client needs. The role encompasses data analysis, data modeling, statistical analysis, data quality audits, data mining, and the creation of dashboards and custom reporting from multiple data sources. Responsibilities include gathering and documenting client requirements, designing and developing data products, capturing business and technical metadata, performing trend analysis and forecasting, developing baseline metrics and key results, integrating quantitative and qualitative data to create insights, and escalating issues and risks as appropriate. This role will work within a multi-vendor and multi-staff environment to support strategic business planning and facilitate evidence-based decision-making across the organization.

  • 5+ years - direct hands-on experience designing, developing, and optimizing advanced Power BI solutions that transform regulated and complex datasets into actionable insights for policy, operations and executive reporting
  • 5+ years - direct hands-on experience with a comprehensive set of visualization techniques and features demonstrating technical depth and storytelling skill using Power BI
  • 5+ years - direct hands-on experience analyzing large complex datasets to perform trend analysis, predictive analytics, and forecasting using Power BI and Azure analytics tools
  • 5+ years - experience presenting and storytelling to effectively communicate data-driven insights to executives and business users within a government organization
  • 5+ years - experience understanding and developing requirements for analytical projects
  • Bachelor degree in Computer Science or related field of study, or equivalent qualifications

Nice to Have

  • 5+ years - direct hands-on experience translating business requirements into analytical solutions and communicating findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver end-to-end BI solutions
  • 5+ years - experience combining raw data from a variety of data sources within and across domains
  • 5+ years - experience dealing with clients and explaining complex data principles in a thoughtful manner
  • 5+ years - experience developing complex measures, calculated columns, and advanced time intelligence using DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) in Power BI
  • 3+ years - direct hands-on experience in SQL for data transformations, querying, and analytical processing in large scale environments
  • 5+ years - experience preparing visualizations, dashboards, and analytical models
  • 3+ years - experience working with large government datasets

title: Senior Security Software Engineer, Sandbox Platforms
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

About the role

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

You Will:

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.
  • Define and lock down every communication path in and out of the sandbox: syscalls, IPC, shared memory, file descriptors, sockets, brokers, and minimize what each one exposes.
  • Enumerate and reduce attack surface: kernel syscall surface, broker interfaces, device access, and side channels. Assume the code inside is hostile.
  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
  • Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interface level.
  • Sound judgment on tradeoffs: knowing when tighter isolation is worth the cost and when it isn't.
  • A security mindset: you default to least privilege and distrust every input crossing the boundary.

Nice to have

  • Experience across more than one of the three platforms.
  • Kernel, hypervisor, or low-level OS internals work.
  • Fuzzing, exploit development, or red-team experience against isolation boundaries.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer - Technical Lead Pathway | .NET, React, Azure
description:
Job Description

PARts DB builds the B2B fitment data and catalogue platform that sits underneath the automotive parts supply chain. When a workshop, retailer or distributor can tell you in seconds whether a part fits a given vehicle, that answer came from a platform like ours.

We have 25+ years of proprietary fitment data behind us - one of the deepest data sets of its kind in the region - and the backing of GPC Asia Pacific. That combination is unusual: the data depth and stability of a large group, with the pace and short decision paths of a team small enough that your work is visible.

Vehicle fitment is a genuinely hard data problem. High cardinality, messy real-world sources, unforgiving accuracy expectations, and commercial weight behind every answer. It is not CRUD.

The role - and why we have pitched it where we have

We would rather hire someone with the capability to lead a stream and grow into the title than someone who already has the title on their CV. If you are a strong Senior Developer who has been shaping technical design, lifting the people around you and doing lead work without the badge, this is the role where you get the badge - and the support to grow into it.

You will join as a Senior Engineer reporting to the Head of Engineering, with a mapped path to Technical Lead: a defined set of readiness indicators, a development plan against them, and a manager who will tell you plainly what is still missing. Move faster than expected and the title follows.

What you will be doing
  • Leading design and delivery of the most complex, novel and highest-risk work in your stream - cross-system builds, migrations, and performance and scalability problems.
  • Owning the technical design of what your stream ships and making the architectural calls that go with it: security, performance, scalability, data integrity and operational cost.
  • Staying hands-on. This is a technical leadership role, not a step away from the keyboard.
  • Setting the quality bar - thorough code review, engineering-led QA, automation, integration testing and CI/CD discipline.
  • Owning root cause analysis and durable resolution for significant production incidents in your stream.Mentoring Developers, Juniors and Graduates through pairing, review coaching and input into their development plans
  • Working directly with Product Managers, business stakeholders and vendors, translating technical trade-offs into decisions they can act on.
  • Growing into the lead: contributing to estimation, planning and stream direction, deputising for the Technical Lead, and building the people-leadership side deliberately rather than by accident.
  • Setting the standard for AI-assisted development - high throughput on complex work with rigorous verification, and clear judgement about where the tools can and cannot be trusted.
What we are looking for - capability, not years

We are assessing what you can do and how fast you grow, not counting service. In practice this capability tends to show up somewhere around the five-year mark, but if you have it earlier, we want to hear from you.

  • You are the person complex work already gets routed to, and it comes back done.
  • You make design calls and can explain clearly why you made them.
  • You lift the people around you - review feedback that teaches, not just corrects.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity: you interpret the problem, shape the solution and own the outcome.
  • You communicate rather than go quiet, particularly when something is going wrong.
  • You want to lead a team, and you are honest about the parts of that you have not done yet.
Your technical background
  • Strong backend depth in C# / .NET Core, with solid front-end capability in React (Next.js an advantage).
  • Proven experience building and scaling modern web applications, APIs and services in a cloud-native SaaS environment.
  • Azure preferred. We are open to AWS or GCP backgrounds where you have moved between platforms before or can show you have done the homework to pick Azure up quickly.
  • Database design across relational and non-relational stores, with a focus on performance and data integrity.
  • Secure development practice you can embed in a team, not just apply yourself.
  • CI/CD and DevOps as part of how you work, not a separate function.
  • Expert and judicious use of AI development tools, with the ability to teach and standardise that usage.
  • Strong Agile Scrum fluency; experience working with offshore teams is an advantage.
  • Degree in Computer Science, IT or Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

This is not a role for a pure specialist, or for someone who wants a defined queue of tickets. You will be expected to think, decide and own outcomes across the stack.

How we actually work

We asked our own engineers what they would tell a friend about working here. Four things came back, and they are the reason people stay:

  • Real variety. You work across different technologies and different parts of the business, not a single narrow lane - which is the fastest way we know to build the breadth that gets you to the next level.
  • Trust over process. We are light on micromanagement and heavy on outcomes. People here are trusted to work out the best way to get there and given room to try new ideas.
  • No blame culture. When something goes wrong, we work out why and make it better. That is precisely why people here take on work that stretches them.
  • Approachable people who share what they know. If you are stepping up a level, that matters more than any career framework.

Alongside that:

  • A defined engineering pathway with plenty of growth opportunity.
  • A prime Sydney CBD office with genuine hybrid flexibility.
  • Modern engineering practice on a platform that is being actively modernised, not maintained.
  • And customers who depend on us getting the answer right.

title: IT Field Technician - Tulsa, OK
description:
About Darkhorse Tech

Darkhorse Tech provides comprehensive Dental-Specific IT services to our clients including ongoing support (Managed Services), startup projects & expansions (planning, design, buildouts) as well as software & hardware sales and maintenance.

As a leader in the industry, we have created and continue to foster relationships with all leading-edge technology companies servicing the Dental community. Our company was created by founder and CEO, Reuben Kamp who left his job at a nationwide Dental IT company to build a relationship-focused version of a Managed Service Provider (MSP) which creates true partnerships with its clients.

Constantly building on our 13+ years of experience we are now servicing roughly 1400 clients in all 50 states and continue to see massive growth while focusing on maintaining unparalleled support for our Dental Practice partners. With technicians on the ground throughout the country we offer in-person as well as remote support.

About You

Service first. Providing exemplary service means recognizing it. Have you put off a call to your cell phone company because the idea of waiting on hold, requesting a manager only to fight for a solution seems exhausting? Have you ever been pleasantly surprised by a service organization where your call is addressed efficiently, with care and acknowledgement that you are their top priority because you (as a client) are the lifeblood of their business? There is a huge difference in these approaches, and the latter builds loyalty and trust which is vital to the health of any business.

You are solution-oriented and accountable. When given an opportunity to address an issue you follow service standards and quickly provide a solution, if you can’t you are able to escalate the issue and alert your manager to your need/want for knowledge and growth - all while communicating progress in a professional and engaging manner with the client.

Part of our team! While service tickets are addressed individually our crew is always ready to support one another, you will both receive and provide help as we are all working toward the same goal. Together we provide a level of service that our clients dream of and that we stand behind.

As a remote Field Technician in the Tulsa, OK area, you will travel to dental offices in your assigned region to assist with varying technical issues. You will build relationships with clients and help them find solutions while providing exceptional customer service. When you are not working on-site, you will work from home to provide assistance to clients remotely. In this role you will gain exposure to a wide variety of products and services because we assist our clients with technical problems concerning hardware, software, peripheral equipment like phones and printers, and specialized dental imaging products. We also manage routine maintenance and installations for our clients throughout the country.

  • Perform Tier 1 troubleshooting, configuration, and administration pertaining to clients’ printers, wireless network configuration, server-based print queues, antivirus and firewall programs, Microsoft Windows 7 and newer operating systems, Microsoft Office 2010 and newer; Microsoft Office 365; Apple OS, and more

Qualifications and Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Proven time management skills
  • Proven reliability and the ability to work independently
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • 1-2 years of tech support experience

Hours: Monday through Friday 8:00am-5:00pm and rotating Saturday coverage

Please note: This is a hybrid role that requires onsite visits to our clients in and around Tulsa, OK. Candidates should reside in the Tulsa area, and have reliable transportation.

title: VP of Data
description:
Wolfe is a FinTech company embedding AI across its products, operations, and everyday decision-making, and the quality of every AI answer depends on trusted information reaching the right person or agent at the right time.
As VP of Data, you are the directly responsible individual for Wolfe's trusted data supply chain, owning how information is governed, moved, trusted, protected, and made available across employees, AI agents, and business systems.
You will build the Wolfe-specific controls and governance foundation that make Wolfe's data platforms safe, trusted, and valuable, supporting Wolfe's strategy to establish trusted data, ownership, permissions, and governance before scaling AI adoption further.
This is a flat organization, and the Senior Director and Data Engineering team report directly to you; like other senior leaders at Wolfe, you are expected to stay hands-on and contribute to architecture, design, and production code.
This is a 5-day onsite role in Pittsburgh, PA.
  • Build and operate trusted data pipelines that carry ownership, permissions, lineage, freshness, and auditability from source systems to employees, AI agents, and business processes.
  • Establish standards for onboarding, governing, certifying, and retiring information sources, and define authoritative sources with clear ownership, stewardship, and review cycles.
  • Create frameworks for information quality, freshness, conflict resolution, and trust scoring so critical information stays trusted, current, and AI-ready.
  • Partner with AI, Engineering, and Security teams to ensure AI systems use approved information, setting standards for source attribution, answer quality, unsupported-answer handling, and access governance.
  • Directly manage the Senior Director and Data Engineering team, building clear ownership, accountability, and operating rhythms while recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent.
  • Define and monitor metrics for trusted source coverage, data quality and freshness, pipeline reliability, permission compliance, answer quality, and source onboarding speed.

Impact Statement:
For more clarity on the role, below are the success metrics and measurements for this role in the first 90 to 120 days.:
  • 95%+ of priority Wolfe data sources have an identified owner, approval status, and review cycle.
  • A repeatable governance framework is operating for source onboarding, certification, ownership, review, and retirement, with 95%+ of priority information flowing through governed pipelines that preserve permissions, ownership, lineage, and auditability.
  • A trust framework is live with reporting on source ownership, quality, freshness, approval status, and trust scores, and testing confirms approved users receive approved information while unauthorized users do not.
  • Priority AI use cases consume approved, governed, and trusted information sources with measurable answer quality.
  • 12+ years leading data, knowledge, governance, or data engineering organizations, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role owning people, budgets, and strategy.
  • Hands-on technical leader with a track record of building production data platforms and pipelines, and staying close to architecture, design, and code.
  • Deep expertise in data governance, metadata, stewardship, lineage, data quality, and information lifecycle management, with experience building trusted information programs at scale.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across engineering, security, AI, and business teams.
  • Experience in FinTech, regulated industries, or AI-native companies, with enterprise knowledge platforms, AI readiness programs, and governance operating models spanning ownership, stewardship, and trust scoring is preferred.
Wolfe is committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being, along with competitive compensation. Our benefits and perks include but not limited to:
  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

  • Medical, Prescription, Vision, and Dental insurance for employees and dependents (Wolfe pays 80% of premium)

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Onelink Digital

Onelink Digital is a creative and technology-driven digital agency built to turn ideas into reality.

We work across branding, content creation, web design and development, digital marketing, influencer marketing, automation and AI, combining creativity with technology to build experiences that are visually distinctive and commercially effective.

We believe in doing things different, by design. That means challenging predictable creative, experimenting with new technologies and constantly looking for smarter, more interesting ways to bring ideas to life.

We’re now looking for a Video Editor / Motion Graphics Designer to join our team at Emaar Square in Downtown Dubai.

The Role

We’re looking for a highly creative Video Editor / Motion Graphics Designer who can turn ideas, raw footage and creative direction into visually compelling content.

This isn't a role for someone who only cuts footage together.

We want someone who understands motion, kinetic typography, animation, pacing, sound, visual storytelling and design and knows how to combine them to create content people actually want to watch.

You should be able to receive a creative brief and run with it, while also bringing your own ideas, references and creative direction to the table.

What You'll Do

  • Edit high-quality short-form and long-form video content across social media, campaigns, brand content and digital platforms.
  • Create kinetic typography, motion graphics, animations, title sequences, creative transitions and visual effects.
  • Transform raw footage into polished, engaging content without requiring extensive direction.
  • Take creative concepts from idea through to final execution.
  • Bring your own creative ideas to projects rather than waiting for every detail to be provided.
  • Experiment with editing styles, typography, transitions, sound design and visual treatments.
  • Use motion and animation intentionally to elevate storytelling.
  • Select music, sound effects and other creative elements that strengthen the final edit.
  • Create content optimised for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and other digital platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, marketers and the wider creative team.
  • Use AI tools alongside traditional editing software to enhance workflows, generate assets, explore concepts and push creative possibilities.
  • Stay ahead of emerging editing styles, social trends, motion design techniques and AI technologies.
  • Manage multiple projects while maintaining a consistently high creative standard.
  • Maintain organised project files, footage and post-production workflows.


Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 3–4+ years of professional video editing/motion design experience.
  • Currently based in the UAE.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Strong understanding of motion graphics, animation and kinetic typography.
  • Strong understanding of typography, composition, visual hierarchy and graphic design principles.
  • Excellent sense of pacing, rhythm and storytelling.
  • Strong sound design and music selection skills.
  • Experience with colour correction/grading, masking, tracking, compositing and keyframing.
  • Strong understanding of social-first editing, including hooks, retention, pacing and platform-specific formats.
  • Ability to work independently and confidently make creative decisions.
  • Ability to take feedback and creative direction while still contributing your own ideas.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to take relatively simple footage and find ways to make it visually interesting.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced creative environment with multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Curious, experimental and constantly looking for new creative techniques.
  • Experience incorporating AI into video production and post-production workflows.

Bonus Skills

title: Equity Plan Administrator

Equity Plan Administrator

Skillsoft is seeking an experienced Equity Plan Administrator to be responsible for the accurate, timely and compliant administration of Skillsoft’s global equity programs and related public-company reporting activities. In this role, you will have the opportunity to partner closely with Legal, Human Resources, Payroll, Tax and Finance, supports employees and executives, and serves as a key operational owner for equity systems, controls, filings and vendor relationships.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Administer Skillsoft’s equity plans and awards, including RSUs, PSUs, stock options and other awards, from grant setup and participant communication through acceptance, vesting, release, exercise, forfeiture and termination processing.
  • Maintain complete and accurate participant, award, tax, share-pool and plan data in Equity Edge Online and related systems; monitor Workday integrations, resolve exceptions and reconcile equity activity to supporting approvals and records.
  • Coordinate vesting and release events, including validation of market value, tax methods and withholding, payroll reporting, transfer-agent instructions, share issuance and post-event reconciliations.
  • Prepare and coordinate public-company equity and ownership compliance activities, including Forms 3 and 4, Section 16 tracking, EDGAR Next administration, S-8 share tracking and equity-related proxy calculations and support.
  • Execute and document equity-related SOX controls; prepare audit support, periodic reconciliations and monthly, quarterly and annual reporting for Accounting, Tax, Payroll, Legal and Human Resources.
  • Partner with Legal and Human Resources on award approvals, grant agreements, insider-trading administration, blackout and trading-window communications, preclearance requests, stock ownership guideline tracking and required employee communications.
  • Prepare and coordinate international equity reporting and filings with local payroll teams and external advisors; support accurate tax withholding and reporting across jurisdictions.
  • Own day-to-day relationships with the equity platform provider, transfer agent, filing provider and other external advisors; respond promptly and professionally to participant questions and develop training and reference materials.
  • Monitor regulatory and market-practice developments affecting equity administration and recommend process, control and system improvements. Participate in other SEC reporting, governance or special projects as assigned.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of stock plan administration experience, preferably supporting global equity plans at a U.S. public company with a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Human Resources or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Hands-on experience with an equity administration platform such as Equity Edge Online; exposure to Workday, EDGAR Next, Section 16 filing software and transfer-agent processes is strongly preferred.
  • Advanced Excel and data reconciliation skills, with the ability to manage detailed records, complex calculations and competing deadlines with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Working knowledge of equity compensation, payroll and tax coordination, Section 16 reporting, securities-law compliance and SOX control requirements.
  • Excellent judgment, discretion, customer service and written and verbal communication skills; self-directed, highly organized and effective in collaborating across Legal, Human Resources, Payroll, Tax, Finance and external service providers.

title: Junior Electrical Engineering Technician
description:
About Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions

Marcurius Multi-Mission Solutions is a fast-growing defense technology company headquartered in the Tampa Bay area, Florida. Founded by U.S. and U.K. veterans, Marcurius brings decades of frontline experience across Special Operations and Intelligence missions, with deep expertise in asymmetric warfare and the real-world employment of unmanned systems.

Marcurius is building a new kind of unmanned systems company- multi-domain, multi-platform, and mission-driven. We integrate battle-proven platforms, resilient command-and-control architectures, and operator-led doctrine to deliver capabilities that work in contested environments. Our initial focus is the rapid fielding of advanced Unmanned Surface Vessels (USVs) for modern maritime operations.

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Junior Electrical Engineering Technician to join our electrical integration team. In this role, you will build, integrate, and test wire harnesses, low-voltage electrical systems, and autonomy components for marine applications. You will work directly with the lead electrical engineer on marine power distribution, wire sizing, network topologies, and sensitive electronics, ensuring high-quality standards for marine durability and operational reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Harness & Cable Fabrication: Build, break out, route, and terminate low-voltage wire harnesses and custom cable assemblies.
  • Hardware & Systems Integration: Mount and wire autonomy hardware, sensors, marine communications equipment, Ethernet switches, and CAN bus networks.
  • Physical Installation: Route cabling neatly through tight marine spaces, bulkheads, and conduits, ensuring proper strain relief, bend radius, and chafe protection.
  • Testing & Verification: Conduct continuity, pinout, voltage, and ground checks; assist engineering with troubleshooting electrical and wiring faults.
  • Component Assembly: Perform precision hand soldering, weather-sealing, heat shrinking, and lug crimping.

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on Experience: 2+ years of electrical assembly, wire harness building, or technician experience (marine, automotive, robotics, or industrial context preferred).
  • Electrical Diagnostics: Experience using Digital Multimeters (DMM), bench power supplies, and signal test equipment for troubleshooting and pinout validation.
  • Tools & Assembly Techniques: Proficiency in precision hand soldering, heat shrinking, weather-sealing, and operating manual/hydraulic crimpers for heavy-gauge lugs.
  • Power Systems: Practical familiarity working with 12–48VDC and 120VAC electrical systems.
  • Schematics & Diagrams: Ability to accurately read and interpret electrical schematics, pinout tables, and wiring diagrams

Preferred Experience

  • 2–3 years of experience in marine electrical systems, unmanned surface vessels (USVs), or vehicle prototyping.
  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Automotive, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Familiarity with CAN diagnostic tools (Vector CANalyzer, Kvaser, Peak PCAN, Vehicle Spy).
  • ABYC (American Boat and Yacht Council) Electrical Certification.

Work Environment

Primarily onsite at Marcurius facilities in Clearwater, Florida, with direct work in workshops, vessels, docks, and field-testing environments. The role supports prototype development, electrical integration, and sea-trial preparation in a fast-paced setting with changing priorities and close cooperation across engineering, software, operations, and test teams.

Why Marcurius

Marcurius is a people-first, execution-focused organization assembling a small, high-impact team of engineers and operators. This role offers the opportunity to design and field electrical systems that directly enable real-world maritime missions and help build the technical foundation of a next-generation unmanned systems company.

title: NP/PA - Vascular Surgery
location: Saint Joseph Mercy Health System Hospital Campus - Ann Arbor, Mi
description:
Employment Type:

Full time

Shift:

Day Shift

Description:

TRINITY HEALTH ANN ARBOR HOSPITAL

POSITION PURPOSE

The Vascular Surgery NP/PA Surgery provides health care services under the direction of collaborating surgeons in the Department of Surgery under the direction of the Advanced Practice Professional team (APP). Under the direction of the surgeon and the Director of APPs, the NP/PA is responsible for coordinating the health care plan for the assigned patient population by collaborating with consulting physicians and health care professionals. The NP/PA carries out physician orders and maintains the continuum of care through the coordination and integration of all phases of patient care, guided by progress notes, consults, care plans, critical pathways, managed care guidelines, best practice protocols, evidenced based care, and the utilization review processes. In partnership with the supervising physician, the NP/PA evaluates care based on quality and core measures, access and cost effectiveness. The NP/PA contributes to excellence in patient care by focusing on age specific, developmental and spiritual needs and serving as a role model in patient care, consulting, teaching, and leadership.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Clinical care for Vascular Surgery patients:

  • Formulate and implement medical plans of care for acute management of all Surgery (inpatient, emergency department, and consult) patients with collaborating physicians.
  • Assist with evaluation and triage of emergency room patients.
  • Provide direct clinical services for surgical patients according to established protocols, using evidence-based practice and clinical practice standards, under the supervision of the collaborating physicians.
  • Patient work-up, including history and physical examination with ordering of appropriate laboratory tests, x-ray studies and other diagnostic studies as indicated.
  • Completion of daily hospital work rounds including pre and post operations and charting of progress notes as required or as assigned.
  • Completion of discharge summaries, chart rounds, staffing conference summaries and consults as directed by service needs.
  • Participation in the care of off-service patients as indicated by supervising physician request.
  • Order appropriate diagnostic and laboratory data under the direction of the supervising physician and communicate results to physicians and other health care providers.
  • Assess changes in patient status and institutes routine and emergency interventions to stabilize patients under the direction of the supervising physician and APP team.
  • Document plan of care and patient progress in medical records and narrative summaries.
  • Evaluate and document patient outcomes and revises the plan under the direction of collaborating physicians in association with other specialty consultants.
  • Help facilitate discharge planning along with patients, families, other members of the health care team and referral agencies.

Collaborative role with other disciplines:

  • Act as the daily central liaison to all health care team members for patient care concerns
  • Coordinate speech, physical and occupational therapies
  • Participate in patient care conferences and peer quality review with collaborating physician, consulting medical teams, and other health care disciplines

Education Focus:

  • Explain the purpose, preparation and potential effects of the procedure to patient and families
  • Provide pre-operative teaching and discharge planning to patients and families.
  • Design, instruct, and review information and programs pertinent to the inpatient and outpatient surgical population.
  • Participate on hospital, nursing and medical committees as designated.
  • Serve as a hospital resource to staff, patients, and families.
  • Develop and implement a personal continuing education program to maintain current knowledge of surgical care and associated medical concerns.
  • Maintain good rapport and cooperative relationships.
  • Approach conflict in a constructive manner.
  • Help to identify problems, offer solutions, and participate in their resolution.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of information acquired pertaining to patients, physicians, employees and visitors to Trinity Health Ann Arbor.
  • Discuss patient and hospital information only among appropriate personnel appropriately private places.
  • Follow all HIPAA policies and procedures.
  • Behave in accordance with the Mission, Vision, and Values of the Trinity Health System.
  • Adhere to Trinity Health “Performance Standards – Focus on Others.”
  • Assume responsibility for performance of job duties in the safest possible manner, to assure personal safety and that of coworkers, patients and families.
  • Report all preventable hazards and unsafe practices including near misses and actual errors either to management or using the Trinity Health anonymous reporting system (MIDAS).

REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATION/LICENSURE

NP Education:

Master’s Degree in clinical nursing from an accredited Acute Care Nurse Practitioner Program with emphasis on area of certification/licensure.

NP Licensure:

Current certification by a nationally accredited professional nursing organization such as American Credentialing Center (ANCC) or American Academy of Nurse Practitioners (AANP). Successfully pass the certification exam from accredited certifying organization approved by the Michigan Board of Nursing relative to the CNP's designated specialty. Acceptable certifications: Acute Care Adult Gerontology Acute Care and Adult NP. Alternate certifications prior to January 2019 may be accepted or approved if currently practicing at a Trinity Health facility or if there is adequate clinical experience in subspecialty area.

PA Education:

Requires graduation from an ARC-PA accredited PA program.

PA Licensure:

Current License/Certification as Physician Assistant with the State of Michigan.

Experience:

Surgical experience preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Interpersonal skills necessary to initiate and maintain collegial relationships with coworkers and therapeutic relationships with patients and families.
  • Analytic skills necessary to perform principal duties and responsibilities of job description.
  • Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail for up to eighty percent of work time when planning and performing professional nursing care.
  • Ability to walk and stand continuously for 50% of time, ability to sit for 50% of time.

Our Commitment

Rooted in our Mission and Core Values, we honor the dignity of every person and recognize the unique perspectives, experiences, and talents each colleague brings. By finding common ground and embracing our differences, we grow stronger together and deliver more compassionate, person-centered care. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Director of Facilities, Transfusion
description:
Introduction

Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong.

Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care.

Overview

Job Summary

The Facilities Leader plays a critical role in ensuring the Transfusion sites remain safe, compliant, reliable and fully operational, enabling employees and core business activities to function effectively and without disruption. This role is accountable for leading a team of Facilities and Maintenance professionals dedicated to maintaining facilities, grounds, equipment, and environmental health and safety for diagnostic manufacturing, distribution, and business functions as well as supporting the ongoing success and strategy for the Transfusion business. This leader is responsible for all aspects of facility operations, infrastructure, compliance, and expansion across 3 sites located in Georgia, New Jersey and Nova Scotia, Canada. The role is highly cross-functional and requires both strategic planning and hands on execution.

Responsibilities

Key Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end operations of 3 sites with combined office, medical diagnostics manufacturing, and distribution facility, ensuring safety, reliability, and operational excellence across all buiding systems and campuses.
  • Build and manage a high-performing, lean facilities, maintenance, calibration and safey team with clear accountablity and performance standards for both internal resources and external contracted services.
  • Develop and execute long and short term strategic plans to maintain and improve facility systems, buildings and infrastructure in alignment with business strategic plans.
  • Oversee maintenance of critical infrastructure and manufacturing equipment (HVAC, environmental systems, electrical, plumbing, fire and life safety, filling, labeling and packaging) with strong preventative maintenance, calibration programs and rapid responses to maintain required operating conditions for production, including uptime, redundancy planning, capacity forecasting, cost control, and efficiency.
  • Manage and direct physical security and access control systems, ensuring a safe and controlled environment across all campuses.
  • Ensure clean, well-maintained, fully functional, and efficient workspaces across campuses.
  • Partner with internal and external project management, contractors and architects on construction, renovation, and site expansion. Lead facility build-outs from concept through execution, including budgeting, permitting, and timelines, ensuring all projects meet operational, safety, and compliance standards.
  • Manage third-party vendors, establishing contracts and SLAs to ensure high quality and cost effective service, including vendor selection, requirements, quotation, contract negotiation, and ongoing performance management.
  • Lead and own Site Master Plan and Business Continuity Plan for the sites, identifying improvements, risks and mitigations, and executing on improvements.
  • Lead Environmental Health & Safety program including safety education and training, policies and procedures, accident prevention, audits and inspections, environmental and hazardous material management, safety culture, promotion of safe working habits and conditions to ensure safety of employese and site as well as compliance to regulatory agencies and company policies. Identify areas of improvement and work with cross functional leadership to implement corrective actions and improvements.
  • Implement and maintain emergency preparedness plans and incident response protocols, and serve as the around-the-clock emergency point of contact for facility-related issues.
  • Ensure full compliance with OSHA, building codes, fire regulations, and environmental standards, and own audit and inspection readiness across all regulatory bodies and internal quality management system for facilities related systems.
  • Create and implement policies and procedures to maintain compliance, performance, and safety of facilities and equipment.
  • Provide technical, logistical, and planning expertise to resolve all facility related issues.
  • Develop and manage facilities budget for both operational expenses and capital investments.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Networking/Key Relationships:

  • This position will interact with all levels of the organization to foster a culture of collaboration, engagement, and awareness across all teams as develop and maintain key relationships with the senior management team throughout Werfen Transfusion leadership team
  • Positive representation with key city and state council members, service providers, neighboring businesses, and residents.
  • External Regulatory Bodies – Maintain strong relationships and compliance with agencies; ensure readiness for audits and inspections.
  • Vendors – Manage contracted services and partner for audits to ensure quality, reliability, and adherence to safety and compliance standards.

Qualifications

Minimum Knowledge & Experience required for the position:

  • Bachelors degree in engineering, construction management, architecture, facilities management or a related field required, with Certified Facility Manager (CFM) designation highly preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years leading Facilities teams in a regulated and diagnostics environment required.
  • Strong working knowledge of all building systems, both mechanical and controls, including HVAC, electrical, DI water systems, refrigeration, compressed air, emergency, and plumbing systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of filling, labeling and packaging systems.
  • Experience in construction and project management as well as external contracted services.
  • Experience in FDA regulated industries and knowledge of GMPs.
  • Experience building high performing teams and driving continuous improvement.
  • Experience in Clean Room ISO 14644 and ISO 13485 Standards.
  • Experience in equipment automation and maintenance.

Management has the discretion of substituting relevant work experience for a degree and/or making exceptions to the years of experience requirement.

Skills & Capabilities:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions, levels, and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams, creating a collaborative and accountable team culture.
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and situational adpatability in complex or ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to make sound decisions that integrate technical, financial, operational, and business considerations.
  • Excellent understanding of GDP, GMP, Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), FDA, and ISO.
  • Ability to operate with high level of autonomy and multi task, managing both strategic and daily tactical activities.
  • Proficient computer skills including Microsoft Office, project management tools, and Quality Systems.
  • Results-oriented leadership approach with the ability to align execution, ensure accountability, and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Knowledge of life safety systems.

Travel requirements:

Up to 20% of time, to include international travel

Closing

If you are interested in constantly learning and being challenged on a daily basis we encourage you to submit your resume or CV.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation in relation to the online application process, please contact NAtalentacquisition@werfen.com for assistance.

title: IT Network Generalist
description:
A World-Class Team
