Position Summary:

The IT Network Generalist is responsible for supporting and maintaining the network and technology infrastructure within a high-volume, temperature-controlled Perishable Distribution Center (PDC). This is a hands-on onsite (Orlando, FL) role Monday to Friday supporting warehouse operations where network availability directly impacts receiving, storage, picking, shipping, inventory management, voice picking, scanning, printing, and product movement.

The ideal candidate will have 1–3 years of IT/networking experience and a strong interest in hands-on network support. The individual will work closely with Network Engineering, Infrastructure, Operations, Warehouse Technology, and third-party vendors to troubleshoot issues and maintain reliable technology services across the distribution center.

The environment includes Aruba Wireless, Aruba LAN switching, Fortinet SD-WAN, Honeywell Voice/VoCollect, Zebra printers, handheld scanners, RF devices, and other warehouse technology.

Key Responsibilities:

Network Infrastructure

  • Support day-to-day operation of the PDC network infrastructure.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot Aruba wireless access points, Aruba switches, and network connectivity.
  • Perform basic configuration and troubleshooting of Aruba LAN and WLAN equipment.
  • Troubleshoot VLAN, DHCP, DNS, IP addressing, port connectivity, and network access issues.
  • Assist with switch port provisioning, device connectivity, and network changes.
  • Troubleshoot network outages and connectivity issues affecting warehouse operations.
  • Perform network health checks and proactively identify potential issues.
  • Escalate complex network issues to the Network Engineering team with appropriate troubleshooting information.
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, device inventories, port assignments, and cable records.

Aruba Wi-Fi / Wireless

  • Support Aruba APs and wireless infrastructure throughout the distribution center, including warehouse, freezer/cooler, staging, loading dock, offices, and yard areas.
  • Troubleshoot wireless coverage, connectivity, authentication, roaming, latency, and performance issues.
  • Assist with troubleshooting RF-related issues, including interference, weak signal, and poor roaming.
  • Support wireless connectivity for handheld scanners, Honeywell Voice devices, tablets, printers, and other warehouse equipment.
  • Validate wireless connectivity and performance after equipment moves, construction changes, or network modifications.
  • Work with Network Engineering on wireless surveys, AP placement, and optimization activities.

Aruba/Zebra guidance specifically addresses roaming, RF behavior, QoS, and voice-enabled mobile devices, making these important skills for a warehouse-focused network support role.

Fortinet SD-WAN

  • Provide first-level support for Fortinet SD-WAN/FortiGate connectivity.
  • Monitor WAN connectivity and identify circuit, tunnel, or performance issues.
  • Troubleshoot basic LAN-to-WAN connectivity problems.
  • Assist with troubleshooting Internet, MPLS, broadband, and backup WAN connectivity.
  • Validate SD-WAN connectivity following circuit or equipment changes.
  • Escalate complex firewall, routing, VPN, or SD-WAN issues to Network Engineering/Security teams.
  • Understand basic concepts of routing, NAT, VPN, firewall policies, and SD-WAN path selection.

Honeywell Voice / VoCollect

  • Support Honeywell Voice/VoCollect devices and associated wireless connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot voice device connectivity, login, roaming, headset, and communication issues.
  • Support Honeywell voice equipment used by warehouse selectors and operators.
  • Work with warehouse operations and Honeywell support when voice picking issues occur.
  • Troubleshoot whether an issue is related to the device, wireless network, voice application, or backend system.
  • Assist with device provisioning, replacement, testing, and deployment.
  • Maintain spare voice devices and accessories as required.

Honeywell's voice-guided solutions are specifically designed for hands-free warehouse workflows, making network reliability and rapid troubleshooting particularly important in this environment.

Zebra Printers & Handheld Scanners

  • Support Zebra label printers used for warehouse, receiving, picking, inventory, and shipping operations.
  • Troubleshoot wired and wireless Zebra printer connectivity.
  • Support printer IP addressing, DHCP reservations, network ports, and basic configuration.
  • Troubleshoot print queues, connectivity, cabling, and device communication issues.
  • Support Zebra handheld scanners and mobile computers.
  • Troubleshoot Wi-Fi connectivity, device registration, application connectivity, scanning, and battery/accessory issues.
  • Assist with device staging, configuration, replacement, and deployment.
  • Maintain inventory of handheld scanners, printers, charging stations, batteries, and accessories.
  • Coordinate with Zebra or application support when hardware or software issues require vendor assistance.

Distribution Center Operations Support

  • Provide hands-on IT support in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
  • Respond quickly to technology incidents that could impact receiving, picking, shipping, inventory, or transportation operations.
  • Work directly with warehouse leadership and operations teams to understand business impact and prioritize incidents.
  • Support technology during peak operating periods, including nights, weekends, holidays, and seasonal volume increases as required.
  • Assist with technology deployments, moves, adds, and changes throughout the facility.
  • Support new equipment installations and warehouse technology projects.
  • Perform physical troubleshooting in warehouse areas, including racks, docks, staging areas, coolers/freezers, and production areas.
  • Follow all site safety requirements when working around warehouse equipment, conveyors, forklifts, refrigeration areas, and loading operations.

Required Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of IT, networking, infrastructure, or technical support experience.
    • Basic understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, Switching, Routing, Wi-Fi/WLAN, Ethernet, Network troubleshooting
  • Experience troubleshooting network-connected devices.
  • Experience with enterprise wireless networks.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues using ping, traceroute, nslookup, IP configuration tools, and basic network monitoring tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate issues.
  • Strong communication and customer-service skills.
  • Ability to work in a physically demanding distribution center environment.
  • Ability to lift/move IT equipment and work around warehouse operations when required.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends, holidays, or off-hours when operationally required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Aruba Networks / HPE Aruba Networking.
  • Experience with Aruba Central, Aruba switches and wireless access points.
  • Experience with Fortinet FortiGate / Fortinet SD-WAN.
  • Experience with Honeywell Voice/VoCollect, Zebra printers and handheld devices.
  • Experience supporting warehouse management systems or distribution center technology.
  • Experience supporting RF scanners or mobile computers.
  • Experience working in a warehouse, distribution center, manufacturing, grocery, retail, or logistics environment.
  • CCNA, Aruba, Fortinet, or equivalent technical certification.
  • Experience with ticketing systems such as ServiceNow.
  • Basic understanding of network monitoring and logging tools.

Work Environment:

This position is based in a Perishable Distribution Center and requires regular physical presence throughout the facility.

The environment may include:

  • Refrigerated and freezer areas
  • Warehouse racks and aisles
  • Loading docks
  • Shipping and receiving areas
  • Staging areas
  • Conveyor/automation areas
  • Office and administrative spaces
  • Outdoor/yard areas

The position requires the ability to safely work around warehouse equipment and changing environmental conditions while following all applicable safety procedures.

Recommended Certifications:

Preferred but not required:

  • Cisco CCNA
  • Aruba Certified Networking Associate or equivalent Aruba training
  • Fortinet NSE/FCA/FCP or equivalent Fortinet training

Core Mission:

Keep the PDC connected and operational.

The Network Generalist serves as the hands-on technology bridge between the network infrastructure and warehouse operations, ensuring that wireless devices, scanners, voice systems, printers, and other critical technology remain available so the distribution center can receive, pick, move, and ship product without interruption.

At BJ’s Wholesale Club, we carefully consider a wide range of non-discriminatory factors when determining salary. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, education, experience, and qualifications. The pay range for this position is starting from $75,500.00.

We recognize the growing role of AI tools, including ChatGPT, and value familiarity with them. That said, we want to hear from your authentic self. Your application should reflect your own skills, experiences, and insights rather than AI-generated responses.

title: Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer II
description:
American Equity Investment Life Insurance Company is a leading provider of annuity solutions designed to help clients protect and grow retirement income. Part of Brookfield Wealth Solutions, we partner with more than 40,000 financial professionals and help fund over half a million retirements nationwide. Recognized by Newsweek as one of America’s Most Trustworthy Companies and named a Top Workplace in Iowa, American Equity fosters a collaborative and purpose-driven culture where employees are empowered to ignite their passion and help shape the future of financial services.

Headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa, with satellite offices in New York, NY, American Equity provides opportunities for employees to support work across the enterprise, including our sister company, American National, headquartered in Houston, Texas.

GENERAL PURPOSE OF THE JOB:

The Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Engineer II develops, deploys, and supports production machine learning and AI-enabled solutions. This role partners with data scientists, software engineers, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to translate analytical prototypes and business requirements into reliable, scalable, and maintainable applications.

Responsibilities include developing production machine learning pipelines, implementing MLOps practices, building software and APIs, and supporting emerging AI use cases such as retrieval-augmented generation and agent-based solutions. The Machine Learning Engineer II applies established engineering, security, governance, and responsible AI standards throughout the development lifecycle.

**Position sits in Des Moines and will work an onsite schedule**

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partners with data scientists to translate machine learning prototypes and analytical solutions into tested, scalable, and maintainable production software.
  • Develops, deploys, monitors, and supports machine learning models, data pipelines, and feature pipelines using cloud-based platforms such as AWS SageMaker and Snowflake.
  • Designs and develops modular, reusable, and maintainable Python applications, services, and APIs that support machine learning and AI use cases.
  • Applies software engineering and MLOps practices, including source control, code review, automated testing, documentation, CI/CD, model versioning, and production monitoring.
  • Develops and supports AI-enabled applications, including retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise search, and agent-based workflows.
  • Configures and develops AI agents and workflows using approved platforms such as Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Snowflake Cortex, or similar technologies.
  • Integrates machine learning and AI solutions with approved enterprise data sources, APIs, applications, and business systems.
  • Tests and evaluates machine learning and AI solutions for quality, reliability, performance, security, grounding, and appropriate handling of unsupported responses.
  • Applies established architecture, security, privacy, governance, observability, and responsible AI standards.
  • Collaborates with data science, software engineering, data engineering, architecture, security, DevOps, and business teams to deliver production solutions.
  • Troubleshoots production issues involving data, pipelines, applications, integrations, machine learning models, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Stays current on relevant developments and best practices in software engineering, machine learning, MLOps, and AI engineering.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Direct Reports: None

General Description of Indirect Reports (2 and 3-downs): None

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, statistics, mathematics, information technology, or a related field; plus four (4) or more years of progressively responsible related experience in machine learning engineering, software engineering, data engineering, or a related discipline; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. A postgraduate degree may substitute for a portion of the experience requirement under appropriate circumstances.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience developing and deploying production machine learning or data-driven applications.
  • Demonstrated experience developing software in Python.
  • Experience with cloud-based machine learning platforms such as AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with SQL, APIs, automated testing, version control, and CI/CD.
  • Experience supporting production applications, pipelines, or machine learning solutions.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience building generative AI applications, RAG pipelines, enterprise search solutions, or AI agents.
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock, Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Anthropic Claude, Snowflake Cortex, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with containers and cloud deployment technologies.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, observability, or evaluation for machine learning or AI applications.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, PROFESSIONAL DESIGNATIONS: N/A

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Proficient Python software development skills, including modular design, testing, debugging, and dependency management.
  • Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of machine learning concepts, common Python-based ML libraries, and MLOps practices.
  • Understanding of application architecture, cloud development, authentication, logging, monitoring, and error handling.
  • Familiarity with generative AI concepts, including large language models, prompting, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and grounding.
  • Familiarity with AI development platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Anthropic Claude, Snowflake Cortex, or similar technologies.
  • Ability to assess and improve the quality of AI application outputs through testing and established evaluation practices.
  • Understanding of AI security, privacy, responsible AI, and data governance principles.
  • Ability to learn and apply emerging technologies within defined architectural and governance standards.

title: Testing Engineer
description:
StraitSys Inc

Regular

PRIMARY FUNCTION

The Testing Engineer provides software testing and quality validation support for enterprise application modernization efforts supporting the Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR). This individual is responsible for developing, executing, documenting, and maintaining testing activities to verify that application functionality, integrations, data, and system components meet approved business, functional, and technical requirements.

The Testing Engineer works closely with testing leadership, business analysts, functional subject matter experts, developers, security personnel, system administrators, and Government stakeholders to identify defects, validate corrective actions, and support the delivery of reliable and operationally effective solutions. This individual supports testing throughout the system development lifecycle, including functional, integration, system, regression, accessibility, and user acceptance testing activities.

This position is contingent upon Contract Award

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Develop, maintain, and execute test cases, test scripts, test scenarios, and supporting test documentation based on approved business, functional, and technical requirements.
  • Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing of application components and workflows.
  • Validate that implemented functionality satisfies documented requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, and expected system behavior.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and Functional SMEs to understand requirements, operational workflows, use cases, and expected outcomes.
  • Support requirements-to-test traceability to ensure applicable requirements are adequately validated through testing.
  • Test application interfaces, workflows, integrations, data exchanges, user interfaces, and other solution components.
  • Support testing of migrated data to validate accuracy, completeness, integrity, and expected application behavior.
  • Execute test cases, document results, capture supporting evidence, and maintain accurate testing records.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects, including steps to reproduce, expected results, actual results, severity, and supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with developers and other technical personnel to troubleshoot defects and support root cause analysis.
  • Retest resolved defects and perform regression testing to verify corrective actions and ensure changes do not adversely affect existing functionality.
  • Support testing across development, test, staging, and other applicable environments.
  • Support usability, responsive design, and Section 508 accessibility testing as applicable.
  • Assist with test data identification, preparation, and management necessary to execute testing activities.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including preparation of test scenarios, execution support, defect documentation, and validation activities.
  • Participate in solution demonstrations, testing reviews, defect triage meetings, Agile ceremonies, and other project activities.
  • Communicate testing progress, defects, risks, dependencies, and potential impacts to testing and project leadership.
  • Maintain testing documentation and artifacts in accordance with established project and Government requirements.
  • Support implementation, production readiness, post-deployment validation, and stabilization activities.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: No

  • Experience with requirements-based testing and requirements traceability.
  • Experience documenting, managing, retesting, and closing software defects.
  • Familiarity with manual and automated software testing methodologies and tools.
  • Experience testing web-based, cloud-based, Microsoft, or Power Platform solutions.

  • Experience working within Agile software development environments.

  • Ability to clearly document testing results and communicate technical issues to business, functional, technical, and Government stakeholders.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must be a US Citizen.
  • Must be able to successfully obtain and maintain the appropriate Department of Justice (DOJ) Public Trust Investigation (PTI) as required for the position.

title: Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development
description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Roles & Responsibilities

As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development at Firmus, you will lead the electrical engineering discipline across every site where Firmus is building and scaling an AI Factory. This is a principal-engineer-equivalent management role within the Build group, accountable for the consistent, high-quality implementation of Firmus's reference electrical design across our global site portfolio.

The role sits within AI Factory Development (Build) and reports to the Head/Director of AI Factory Engineering. You will lead a distributed team of site-based electrical engineers across Indonesia, Australia, and any future geography where Firmus is active. Your remit is delivery, governance, and technical assurance of the electrical design in construction, commissioning, and handover — not ownership of the reference design itself, though you will be a primary and continuous input into the reference design's evolution.

This is a central leadership role. You are the single accountable owner for electrical engineering execution across the Firmus AI Factory estate, the escalation point for electrical technical issues in the field, and the guardian of design intent from tender through energisation. You will work in tight partnership with the reference design owners, the Mechanical and Thermal, Controls, and Physical Networking Heads, and with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations to ensure every site is electrically built, tested, and handed over to standard.

What you will do

As Head of Electrical Engineering, AI Factory Development, you will own the electrical engineering function within the AI Factory Development group. You will define how the reference electrical design is interpreted, adapted for local codes and site conditions, procured, constructed, and commissioned across every Firmus site. You will set the technical bar for MV/LV distribution, UPS and standby generation, protection and coordination, earthing and bonding, power quality, and the electrical interfaces to liquid-cooled AI compute halls.

You will act as the engineering authority for electrical execution across the AI Factory portfolio — accountable for design governance in the field, deviation management, factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning readiness, and safe, reliable energisation. You will operate the change-control and design-review disciplines that keep every site aligned to the Firmus reference design, and you will be the escalation point when local realities require considered deviation or when the reference design itself needs to evolve.

You will not own the development of the reference electrical design, but you will be one of its most important customers and contributors. You will feed operational learnings, site constraints, vendor performance data, and commissioning findings back into the reference design owners, and you will co-develop the electrical standards, templates, and Basis of Design updates that keep Firmus's design ahead of the industry.

You will build, lead, and scale a geographically distributed electrical engineering team – site-based engineers embedded in Indonesia, Australia, and any additional geography where Firmus operates. You will set the operating rhythm across time zones, establish consistent engineering practice and quality standards across sites, develop the next generation of senior electrical engineers within Firmus, and represent electrical engineering in cross-functional Build, Commissioning, and Operations forums.

Skills & Experiences

You are, first and foremost, an accomplished electrical engineer for mission-critical, high-density digital infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in medium- and low-voltage distribution, UPS systems, standby and prime-power generation, static and rotary switching, protection and relay coordination, arc-flash and safety-in-design, earthing and bonding, and the specific electrical demands of dense GPU compute halls and liquid-cooled AI infrastructure. You understand power system modelling — load flow, short-circuit, motor starting, transient stability — and you have used it to make consequential design and operational decisions.

Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading tender design reviews, consultant and contractor governance, factory acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, level-1 through level-5 commissioning, and handover to operations. You have authored or materially shaped Basis of Design documents, engineering templates, global minimum standards, and change-control processes at a hyperscale operator or equivalent. You are comfortable engaging utilities, regulators, and major equipment vendors, and you know how to drive value engineering, DfMA, and sustainability outcomes without compromising reliability.

Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under construction and commissioning pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of site engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI infrastructure that works reliably from day one.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in electrical power engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (power systems preferred) recognised in at least one of Firmus's operating jurisdictions, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience across hyperscale or mission-critical data centre developments, industrial power systems, or comparable high-availability infrastructure. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as an electrical subject-matter expert and design manager on multi-site programmes, and a proven track record leading design governance, quality assurance, and commissioning readiness across a portfolio of concurrent projects.

This experience should include leading distributed, site-based engineering teams across multiple countries, managing external consultants and EPC contractors to global standards, and working effectively across the build-to-run interface with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations. Experience authoring or contributing materially to global electrical Basis of Design, minimum standards, or reference architecture at a hyperscale, cloud, or specialist AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia and Australia — under diverse regulatory, grid, and utility conditions.

Location & Reporting

  • Australia, or Singapore (with regular travel across the AI Factory portfolio)
  • Reporting to the Head/Director of AI Factory Engineering

title: Senior Workforce Planning Analyst
description:
Overview

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

Role Summary

The Resource Planning Lead owns enterprise workforce forecasting and capacity planning, translating projected workload demand into staffing requirements across operational functions. This role develops and maintains forecasting models, aligns workforce plans with business objectives, and partners with leaders across Operations, Finance, and HR to ensure the organization has the right resources in place to meet service, productivity, compliance, and financial goals. The Team Lead serves as the subject matter expert for forecasting methodologies, workforce planning processes, and capacity management tools.

What You'll Own

  • Lead end-to-end forecasting and capacity planning activities across operational functions, converting projected demand into staffing requirements and hiring recommendations.
  • Develop and maintain short-, mid-, and long-range forecasting models using historical trends, business drivers, workload assumptions, and operational changes.
  • Partner with Operations, Finance, and HR to align workforce plans with budget cycles, hiring strategies, productivity expectations, and organizational goals.
  • Produce actionable staffing plans that proactively identify resource gaps, surpluses, risks, and opportunities.
  • Conduct variance analyses and continuously improve forecasting accuracy, planning assumptions, and workforce models.
  • Collaborate with workforce management and operational leaders to translate capacity plans into executable staffing and work allocation strategies.
  • Support strategic initiatives, including new business implementations, operational expansions, process transformations, technology deployments, and outsourcing assessments.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for workforce planning methodologies, capacity models, forecasting tools, and workforce analytics.

Leadership Competencies

Integrity & Trust — the threshold expectation for every role at HealthEdge, above and ahead of the competency framework.

Core competencies for this role:

  • Leadership & Accountability
  • Grow & Innovate

What You Bring

  • 5 or more years of experience in workforce planning, forecasting, capacity planning, or workforce management.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex workforce forecasting and capacity planning processes operational environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and workforce modeling skills, including advanced Excel proficiency; SQL and planning tools experience preferred.
  • Experience partnering with Finance, HR, and business leaders on headcount and budget planning.
  • Ability to communicate workforce risks, staffing recommendations, and planning insights to leaders at multiple levels.

What Success Looks Like

  • Staffing requirement outputs give leadership enough lead time to close gaps before they create operational or compliance impact
  • Workload forecasting models stay current as intake trends, productivity benchmarks or regulatory requirements shift
  • Capacity plans translate cleanly into daily and weekly work assignment frameworks with minimal rework by WFM scheduling teams

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. title: Marketing Project Manager
description:
Position Summary

When you work at Daktronics, you’ll be part of something amazing. We design, engineer, manufacture and support bold, eye-catching digital LED display technology and audio systems.

Our products bring excitement to professional, college and high school games. They attract customers for businesses around the world, and even provide direction for people as they travel, work and play.

As part of the Daktronics team, you’ll have interesting, impactful work with flexible opportunities. You can learn and grow at a company that provides competitive compensation and meaningful benefits – and the people are second to none.

Role Summary:

Daktronics is seeking a Marketing Project Manager to close a gap identified across our marketing assessment: no single source of truth exists across the market segments and martech stack, hand-offs are manual, and there is no consolidated view of marketing budgets or project status. The Marketing Project Manager owns end-to-end marketing project management, coordinates every functional team toward shared deadlines, manages budget lines with discipline, and builds the centralized repository that keeps the entire marketing organization visible, accountable, and on schedule.

Why this Role Matters:

Marketing project management is a distinct discipline, and the most effective marketing organizations treat it that way rather than leaving coordination to whoever has bandwidth. A project manager's real value comes from replacing fragmented spreadsheets and email threads with one centralized, single source of truth, then using it to track budgets, coordinate teams, and surface issues before they become problems.

Today, the marketing function has no single source of truth, manual hand-offs are common, and multiple disconnected tools make it hard to see the full picture of what's in motion. The Marketing Project Manager role fixes that: one accountable owner for marketing project management, cross-functional coordination, budget discipline, and a centralized repository that finally gives Marketing visibility into everything it's running.

What will the work look like for me?

Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Management
    • Lead the marketing project management function and coordinate with embedded personnel and functional leads across every business segment.
    • Set clear standards for how projects are scoped, staffed, and tracked across the function.
  • Marketing Project Management
    • Own end-to-end project management for marketing initiatives from scoping and timelines through delivery.
    • Translate marketing strategy and vertical priorities into structured, trackable project plans.
    • Proactively surface risks, bottlenecks, and resourcing conflicts before they impact delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Act as the central point of coordination across Creative & Content, Digital & Social, Market Strategists, Trade Show, Events & Associations, and Corporate Communication functions.
    • Facilitate planning and status meetings that keep every workstream aligned and moving.
    • Manage external agency and vendor coordination alongside internal marketing teams.
  • Budget Management
    • Own marketing project budgets, tracking spend against plan across every initiative.
    • Monitor burn rate and resource allocation, flagging issues before they become overruns.
    • Provide regular, accurate budget and status reporting to Marketing leadership.
  • Centralized Repository & Systems
    • Build and maintain a centralized repository of record for all marketing projects, assets, and initiatives replacing fragmented spreadsheets and email threads with one source of truth.
    • Select and administer the marketing project management platform and ensure consistent adoption across teams.
    • Standardize intake, briefing, and approval processes across the marketing organization.
  • Team Growth & Culture
    • Foster a culture of collaboration and open coordination across every marketing function.
    • Build professional growth paths and development opportunities for project management team members.
    • Ensure seamless coordination and handoffs across central functions, embedded roles, and business units.

Where is this opportunity located?

Position located in Brookings, SD.

Qualifications

To be considered for the Marketing Project Manager position, we require the following:

  • Team Management
    • Five (5)+ years leading marketing project management or project management functions.
    • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Marketing Project Management
    • Proven track record managing marketing campaigns and initiatives from concept through delivery.
    • Strong command of project management methodologies (Agile, waterfall, or hybrid) applied to marketing.
    • Experience with marketing project management tools (e.g., Asana, monday.com, Wrike, Jira).
  • Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Demonstrated ability to coordinate diverse teams and working styles toward shared deadlines.
    • Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
    • Comfortable working across creative, technical, and business stakeholders.
  • Budget Management
    • Proven experience owning and managing marketing budgets across multiple concurrent projects.
    • Strong financial acumen and comfort with budget forecasting and reporting.
    • Experience presenting budget status to leadership.
  • Centralized Repository & Systems
    • Experience building and administering centralized project management or work management systems.
    • Strong systems and process orientation.
    • Familiarity with martech and project management platform integration.
  • Team Growth & Culture
    • Experience building collaborative, high-performing team cultures across matrixed or distributed teams.
    • Track record of mentoring and developing talent within a function,
    • Strong coordination skills, ensuring seamless communication and handoffs across cross-functional teams.
  • Other requirements
    • Bachelors degree in marketing, project management, business administration or a related field, or equivalent experience.
    • Effectively exercise discretion and independent judgment.
    • Fluent in English, written and verbal.
    • Applicants must be 18 years of age or older.
    • Daktronics does not sponsor, renew, or extend immigration visas for this position.

title: Analista de Compliance Pleno - PLD/FT
description:

Your Role

Reporting to senior leadership, this position is integral to the Legal Services senior management team. You will be responsible for developing, implementing and supporting health and safety, crisis management, environmental (loss control / risk management) and sustainability strategies. You will also develop and maintain working relationships with industry peers handling similar issues. You will facilitate the integration of health, safety, crisis management and environmental issues into management and union practices as well as daily business operations. You will participate in and influence legislative and regulatory changes regarding health, safety and environment that apply to and may affect CBC/Radio-Canada. In addition, you will ensure the implementation and co-ordination of national emergency preparedness, business continuity and corporate security policies, standards and procedures across all areas of CBC/Radio-Canada.

In this role, you will manage a team of nine direct reports.

This position can be based in Montreal, Toronto or Ottawa.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define corporate strategies and establish objectives and priorities pertaining to health, safety, environment and sustainability. Develop, implement and evaluate policies, programs, procedures and guidelines in consultation with line management.
  • Oversee the development and management of the crisis management portfolio for CBC/Radio-Canada which includes emergency preparedness, business continuity and corporate security. Ensure effective co-ordination across all components so that coherent plans and contingencies are established and updated as required.
  • Develop, establish and maintain procedures to monitor or evaluate compliance with applicable legislation and regulations, as well as CBC/Radio-Canada policies and procedures governing health, safety, environment and crisis management systems.
  • Develop, establish and maintain a hazard identification, assessment and control program in accordance with legislated and regulatory requirements, taking operational needs into consideration.
  • Facilitate the effective operation of the joint union/management Health and Safety Policy Committee and local workplace committees for CBC/Radio-Canada.
  • Define health, safety and environment training requirements; determine course content; and, in consultation with line management and L&D, identify appropriate resources, target audiences and delivery methods. Plan and monitor the corporate training budget for health, safety and environment. Establish training budget allocations across all components.
  • Determine and oversee the management of health, safety, environment and crisis management resources to provide professional and technical advice, guidance, consultation, research, planning and monitoring services.
  • Promote health, safety, crisis management, sustainability and environment objectives and programs among CBC/Radio-Canada personnel. Represent CBC/Radio-Canada in liaising with ESDC, public security authorities, Environment and Climate Change Canada, and other external organizations on health, safety, environment and crisis management matters.
  • Prepare quarterly and annual reports to review the CBC/Radio-Canada health, safety and environment systems and activities. Track and summarize legislative/regulatory changes and identify their impact on CBC/Radio-Canada.
  • Actively participate in internal and external health and safety committees, as needed, to ensure CBC/Radio-Canada’s health and safety priorities are effectively represented.
  • Establish and maintain procedures to ensure effective internal and external communications regarding CBC/Radio-Canada policies, procedures, activities and performance related to health, safety, environment and crisis management. Oversee the maintenance of all CBC/Radio-Canada documentation dedicated to health, safety, environment and crisis management. title: Controller
description:
Come Join Us!

From apartments in New York to hospitals and stadiums in Dallas, libraries at prestigious universities to creating modern retail experiences, our teams contribute architectural glass and building products to projects that shape the way people live, work, heal, learn, and play. At OBE, the work of our employees truly matters. With over 6,500 employees, we operate more than 80 manufacturing and distribution facilities in five countries. You can see some of our favorite projects here.

Start your journey with OBE and help us build the future.

About the Opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Corporate Controller, the Controller, Metal Processing & Projects will lead the accounting, financial reporting, and internal control functions for OBE's metal processing and project-based operations, including two metal processing facilities and seven project facilities.

This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of accounting processes related to inventory valuation, standard costing, inventory controls, bad debt reserves, warranty reserves, back charge reserves, sales cut-off, goods received not invoiced (GRNI), and other key accounting areas.

As a key leader within OBE's accounting organization, this individual will ensure accounting policies, procedures, and controls are consistently applied across the business and maintained in accordance with U.S. GAAP. The successful candidate will bring strong technical accounting expertise, process improvement experience, and a passion for building scalable financial controls in a dynamic and evolving environment.

This is a newly created position that will play a significant role in supporting the company's growth strategy. We are seeking a change-oriented leader who is comfortable driving transformation, enhancing processes, and partnering across the organization to build best-in-class accounting operations.

This hybrid position requires working onsite four days per week from either OBE's Corporate Headquarters in Dallas, TX or the metal processing facility in Terrell, TX.

Organizational Relationships

Reports To:

  • SVP, Corporate Controller

Key Internal Partners:

  • Business Unit Controllers
  • Director of Financial Reporting
  • Director of Accounting, Controls
  • Director of Tax
  • Treasurer
  • Directors of Finance
  • Operations Leadership

Leadership Scope:

  • 5 Direct Reports
  • 10 Indirect Reports

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing accounting team.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Financial Control & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP and company accounting policies.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain effective internal controls using a risk-based approach aligned with public company SOX standards.
  • Oversee accounting for inventory, costing, reserves, project accounting, and revenue recognition-related activities.
  • Partner with internal and external auditors and serve as the primary liaison during audits.

Process Improvement & Transformation

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Drive standardization and consistency across accounting functions and facilities.
  • Support and optimize accounting and finance technologies, including the automation of manual processes.
  • Lead initiatives that strengthen financial reporting accuracy and operational effectiveness.

Business Partnership

  • Build strong partnerships with operations, finance, and executive leadership teams.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making.
  • Influence positive change while balancing business objectives with strong financial governance.

The Ideal Candidate

Leadership Characteristics

Integrity

  • Demonstrates a consistent track record of professional and personal integrity.
  • Committed to upholding the highest ethical standards while supporting sustainable business growth.

Leadership

  • Proven ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational change.
  • Passionate about developing talent and building high-performing teams.

Communication

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to effectively communicate complex accounting matters to executives, business leaders, and cross-functional partners.

Judgment & Decision-Making

  • Makes sound, objective decisions based on facts, analysis, and business needs.
  • Demonstrates strong critical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

Change Leadership

  • Thrives in dynamic environments and embraces continuous improvement.
  • Proven success implementing new processes, controls, and operating models.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA designation required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive accounting leadership experience.
  • Extensive knowledge of U.S. GAAP and technical accounting principles.
  • Experience in manufacturing and/or construction environments.
  • Strong background in cost accounting and percentage-of-completion accounting.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing effective internal controls.
  • Excellent collaboration, leadership, and business partnership skills.
  • Ability to work onsite four days per week in Dallas, TX or Terrell, TX.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Accounting or MBA.
  • Big Four public accounting experience.
  • Experience in a publicly traded company operating within a SOX-compliant environment.
  • Experience working within private equity-backed organizations.
  • Exposure to large-scale ERP systems and accounting process automation initiatives.

Why Join OBE?

At OBE, we're building the future through innovation, operational excellence, and a commitment to our people. This role offers the opportunity to make a measurable impact while partnering with senior leaders across the organization.

What OBE Offers

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Annual incentive opportunity
  • Generous paid time off
  • 10 paid holidays, including 2 floating holidays
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • Career development and advancement opportunities

What OBE Offers You

  • Benefits that benefit you – industry competitive benefits at the lowest cost to the employee
  • Work-life balance – PTO and holidays, including floating holidays you can choose
  • Compensation that rewards your hard work – A pay-for-performance culture with potential for annual raises and bonuses
  • Training – We will equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed

OBE will not discharge or discriminate against employees or applicants for discussing, disclosing, or inquiring about their own or others' pay.

title: Sterilization Technician , 2nd Shift
description:

MTF Biologics processes tissue grafts from human donors that are used in a growing array of clinical applications – positively affecting lives across the globe. Our goal is simple–do what's right for patients, surgeons, tissue donors, and their families through our guiding principles.

Responsible for the handling, decontamination, package process, documentation and sterilization of production supplies, equipment, instruments, tooling to support all core related activities in conjunction with all Business units as well as supporting departments Responsible for the handling, performance of visual and functional inspection of all tooling, decontamination, sterilization, and documentation for the medical device kits for field surgeries. Monday-Friday, 3:15pm-11:30pm

Pay Range $18.50-$21hr.

title: Senior Video Editor, Reporter Video
location: Los Angeles, CA; New York, NY
description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times is an industry leader in visual journalism with reporting that includes extraordinary news coverage, investigations, culture and lifestyle reporting. The Reporter Video team identifies compelling stories and brings the depth and breadth of our news report onto our site and other platforms through video that features the expertise of our world-class journalists.

We are looking for an experienced video editor with a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to deliver engaging work on tight deadlines. You will work across a range of newsroom video coverage focused on vertical video storytelling with The Times' world-class journalists on-camera. You have deep experience in breaking and ongoing news coverage, with a track record of creating digitally compelling short-form video journalism.

Your portfolio and work samples should reveal a strong grasp of modern mobile video storytelling, and it should show that you're a quick learner with creative ideas and the ability to work on small or large teams. You are collaborative and solid technically with a solutions mindset, detail oriented, organized and fast.

Please note we have two positions available in the newsroom. Please speak to your expertise and/or interest(s) in your cover letter:

  • News and Enterprise

  • Culture and Lifestyle (music and film to fashion and real estate)

These are in-office positions based in New York and include regular attendance in the office four days each week. We are open to a Senior Video Editor working out of our LA office for the News and Enterprise role only. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Video editing and color correction of news, culture, enterprise and investigative videos featuring reporters from across the newsroom.

  • Collaborate with video journalists and producers in the pre/post production process, including writing, structure and creative execution. Demonstrate excellent news judgment across projects.

  • Deliver top-notch product under intense deadline pressure, and without the need for direct supervision, continuous editorial guidance, or task management.

  • Work across a range of stories with various newsroom desks including culture and styles, often juggling multiple projects.

  • Work with animators to incorporate animation, motion graphics and house design styles into videos.

  • Experiment with different formats of vertical and mobile visual storytelling.

  • Guide junior staff on edits as needed.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to a Senior Producer based in New York.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of multimedia storytelling, video editing and production experience at a major news video outlet and/or production company. (Minimum 5 years of video editing experience.)

title: Financial Planner (McLean, VA)
description:

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Job Summary:

Financial planning is the foundation of Mercer Advisors. The Financial Planning Group is a centralized team of paraplanners that supports Wealth Management Teams nationwide by creating customized, comprehensive personal financial plans.

This role is responsible for document analysis, data management, financial plan construction, ongoing maintenance, and implementation. Membership in the Financial Planning Group offers an excellent opportunity for individuals seeking to build strong technical expertise in preparation for a career in financial planning or as a future Wealth Advisor.

In this role, you will prepare comprehensive financial planning modules using a variety of industry-leading software and proprietary tools. You will collaborate closely with in-house specialists in investments, tax, estate planning, and insurance solutions. Success in this position requires a genuine passion for financial planning, along with self-motivation, flexibility, strong attention to detail, a process-driven mindset, analytical skills, high follow-through, and excellent communication abilities.

Essential Job Functions for this role include:

  • Preparing financial plans for prospective and existing clients, including:

    • Education funding analysis
    • Stock options analysis
    • Estate planning analysis

This professional role requires availability during standard business hours of Monday through Friday from 8AM to 5PM. At times, the role may have early or late hours to meet business tasks and deadlines for external and internal client needs.

All roles classified as a non-exempt are required to record working time into the timekeeping system daily at the start and end of each workday plus a 30-minute unpaid lunch period.

title: Senior C++ Engineer, Engine
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Job Description

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will:

  • Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D asset pipelines, or GPU/client performance. Deep specialization in one area is not required, but meaningful hands-on experience is.
  • Real-time Performance Mindset: Experience diagnosing tradeoffs among CPU/GPU time, memory, loading latency, visual quality, and frame-time stability on constrained platforms such as mobile or console.
  • Ownership in Ambiguity: A track record of driving work end-to-end when the problem wasn't fully specified: defining the approach yourself, seeing it through implementation, rollout, and production consequences; gathering more information when requirements didn't make sense.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Ability to work effectively across teams (Engine, Rendering, Avatar, Studio, and developer-facing teams) and explain complex technical topics clearly to different audiences.

description:
Intake and Referral Coordinator

Location: This is an in-person position based out of our North Kansas City, MO clinic

Compensation: $22- $24/hour; paid bi-weekly

Employment Type: W2, Full-Time, Non-Exempt

Schedule: Monday-Friday between the hours of 8am and 5pm


Job Summary

The Intake and Referral Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for individuals seeking behavioral health services and for referral sources within the community. This position is responsible for managing referrals for individual therapy and group therapy programs, ensuring timely coordination of services, verifying eligibility, maintaining accurate records, and facilitating access to appropriate clinical care. The Referral Coordinator works closely with clinicians, intake staff, external providers, and clients to support a seamless referral and scheduling process.


Referral Management

  • Receive, review, and process referrals for individual therapy and group therapy services.
  • Coordinate referrals from healthcare providers, schools, community agencies, hospitals, insurance companies, and self-referrals.
  • Maintain referral tracking systems and ensure accurate documentation throughout the referral process.
  • Monitor referral status and follow up with referral sources, providers, and clients as needed.

Intake and Scheduling

  • Contact prospective clients to gather required information and explain available services.
  • Schedule intake appointments and therapy sessions in accordance with program guidelines and clinician availability.
  • Coordinate enrollment into appropriate therapy groups based on clinical recommendations, availability, and participant needs.
  • Manage waitlists and communicate anticipated timelines to clients and referral partners.
  • Ensure all required forms, consents, and documentation are completed prior to service initiation.
  • Answer incoming calls promptly and professionally.

Care Coordination

  • Collaborate with therapists, case managers, clinical supervisors, and administrative staff to facilitate timely access to care.
  • Communicate client needs, referral priorities, and scheduling updates to the clinical team.
  • Assist with transitions between services, including movement from individual therapy to group therapy or vice versa.
  • Provide referral resources when services are unavailable or when clients require a different level of care.

Customer Service and Communication

  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource regarding therapy programs, eligibility requirements, and referral procedures.
  • Respond professionally and promptly to inquiries from clients, families, providers, and community partners.
  • Maintain positive relationships with referral sources and community stakeholders.
  • Provide excellent customer service while demonstrating empathy, professionalism, and cultural sensitivity.

Documentation and Compliance

  • Maintain accurate and confidential client records in accordance with HIPAA and organizational policies.
  • Verify insurance, benefits, and authorizations as required.
  • Generate reports on referral volume, program capacity, waitlists, and service utilization.
  • Ensure compliance with agency standards, state regulations, and accreditation requirements.

Performance Indicators

  • Timely processing of referrals.
  • Reduction of referral-to-intake wait times.
  • Accuracy of referral documentation and data entry.
  • Client and referral-source satisfaction.
  • Successful placement of clients into appropriate individual and group therapy services.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Compensation: $22- $24 per hour; paid bi-weekly
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer match up to 4%
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents
  • HSA (with employer contribution) and FSA options to help manage healthcare and dependent care expenses
  • Employer-paid life insurance and AD&D coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential mental health and life support resources
  • Generous paid time off and additional paid holidays

title: Aircraft Interiors Technician - 1st Shift
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Performs and execute a variety of tasks including adjusting, assembling, equipping, and testing of interior systems in relation to assembly and repair operations. Work will be performed in accordance with the necessary production documentation while meeting the requirements of quality, functionality, safety, deadlines and recording production data. Analyze processes and process improvement opportunities within the production process.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performs a variety of tasks ranging from repetitive to non-repetitive production assembly operations on interior assemblies and subassemblies such as seats, cabinets, panels, partitions, divan, and In-flight entertainment equipment.
  • Works from diagrams and drawings, makes initial layouts, and uses hand and/or power tools, jigs, and saws.
  • Makes continuity checks on work in process and completed while following appropriate clean-as-you go shop practices.
  • May conduct quality inspections on processing line in accordance with quality specifications.
  • May disassemble, modify, rework, reassemble, and test experimental or prototype assemblies and subassemblies according to specifications and under simulated conditions
  • Follows approved assembly procedures for component or aircraft structures, consulting internal procedures that have been FAA approved, original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s) technical data, and work package instructions.
  • Positions and aligns subassemblies in jigs or fixtures, using measuring instruments, following blueprint lines and index points.
  • Inspects completed work to identify any needed rework before signing off; ensures that repaired components meet prescribed standards and tolerances.
  • Performs serviceability tests utilizing test equipment specified in technical manuals.
  • Completes work package documentation per FAA and/or repair station manual.
  • Submits completed work to Quality Assurance for final/in progress inspection and certification of airworthiness.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Education:

  • High School/ GED
  • A&P and mechanical / electrical experience a plus
  • Structures experience a plus.

Experience:

  • Generally, 0-2 years of experience in area of responsibility.
  • Entry Level Technician Role, requiring Basic Skills to perform basic tasks within the Technical Area assigned to in area of responsibility with assembly, mechanical, electrical or aircraft structures as well as able to use all tech data and aircraft drawings to locate part numbers and accomplish repairs.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Assignments require Minimal Knowledge beyond the assigned work. Demonstrates correct understanding of routine aspects of work.
  • Performs basic, less complex and routine Technical Assignments. Assists Journeyman Level or Higher Technicians on moderately complex technical assignments.
  • Proficient in riveting, installation of relate hardware, usage of precision instruments and utilization of hand tools to perform these tasks.
  • Must be able to fabricate parts.
  • Reads work orders, blueprints, and specifications or examines sample or damaged part or structure to determine repair or fabrication procedures and sequence of operations.
  • Repair interior components or structure of aircraft according to specifications.
  • Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance.
  • Be proficient in the usage of air powered hand tools and related equipment.
  • Knowledge of raw materials, production processes, quality control, costs, and other techniques for maximizing the effective manufacture and distribution of goods.
  • Ability to work different shifts and flexible hours if required.
  • Ability to work in a safe professional manner adhering to all regulatory requirements including, OSHA, EPA, State and Federal regulations.

Working Conditions / Environment/ Special Requirements

  • Ability to work in a safe professional manner adhering to all regulatory requirements including, OSHA, EPA, State and Federal regulations.

title: Business Consultant, Exit Strategy - Forney

title: Compliance Associate
description:
Overview

National Debt Relief is seeking a Compliance Associate to join our Legal and Compliance team. This is an entry-level position designed for a candidate at the start of their legal career who wants to build broad experience across commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and consumer financial services.

The Compliance Associate supports the company’s legal and compliance functions with a focus on contract review, transactional support, vendor management, and business advisory matters. Working under the supervision of the Compliance Program Manager, the incumbent will take on responsibility quickly and will gain direct exposure to state and federal regulators, examinations, outside counsel, and senior business leadership across multiple business lines.

The ideal candidate is practical, curious, and detail-oriented, exercises sound judgment, and is looking for a role with meaningful responsibility and a clear path to greater ownership. National Debt Relief operates in a highly regulated environment and this position offers unusually broad substantive experience for an attorney early in their career.

This is a hybrid position based in New York City. The incumbent is expected to work from the New York City office a minimum of two days per week. Additional on-site presence may be required during regulatory examinations, audits, and other periods of business need.

Bar Admission:

This position is open to candidates who have graduated from law school and sat for a bar examination with results pending. A candidate hired prior to admission will perform compliance, contract, and business support work under the direction and supervision of the Director of Regulatory Compliance. Prior to admission, the incumbent will not hold themselves out as an attorney, will not independently render legal advice, and will not issue legal opinions on behalf of the Company or its affiliates.

Upon admission to the bar and confirmation of good standing, the incumbent’s scope of responsibility, title, and compensation will be reviewed and adjusted to reflect licensed status. Admission to the bar of at least one U.S. jurisdiction, and good standing thereafter, is a condition of continued employment in this position. A candidate hired pending admission is expected to obtain admission within twelve months of the date of hire.

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and revise commercial agreements, including vendor agreements, service agreements, confidentiality agreements, and amendments, and support negotiations under the supervision of the Director of Regulatory Compliance.
  • Prepare compliance analysis of transactional matters for review, including legal, regulatory, operational, privacy, data security, consumer protection, and vendor risk considerations.
  • Support internal stakeholders on contract terms, approval processes, and company policies, escalating matters requiring legal judgment.
  • Partner with business teams to support the full contract lifecycle, from intake and review through negotiation, execution, storage, renewal, and termination.
  • Conduct legal and regulatory research related to business transactions, consumer protection, financial services, privacy, advertising, vendor management, and other applicable areas.
  • Assist with regulatory filings, licensing matters, examinations, audits, investigations, and responses to regulatory inquiries, as needed.
  • Collaborate with outside counsel on transactional, regulatory, and compliance matters.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve legal and compliance processes, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate records of contracts, approvals, legal advice, compliance reviews, and related documentation.
  • Ensure the Policies and Procedures remain compliant and adhered to in all areas.
  • Prioritize open items and manage deadlines effectively to ensure timely completion of all compliance-related tasks.
  • Develop, maintain, and demonstrate current knowledge of applicable State and Federal Laws and Industry Regulations.

Qualifications

Education/Experience:

  • Juris Doctor degree from an ABA-accredited law school.
  • Admitted to practice and in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction; or a law school graduate who has sat for a bar examination with results pending and is eligible for admission in New York.
  • No prior post-graduate legal experience is required. This is an entry-level position and the compensation range reflects that.
  • Law school clinical work, journal or moot court experience, judicial internships, and summer or academic-year work in a regulated industry will be considered favorably.
  • Coursework or experience in consumer financial services, commercial contracting, privacy, or administrative and regulatory law preferred.
  • Ability to analyze regulatory and compliance issues and translate them into practical business guidance.
  • Strong legal research and writing skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines independently and to ask for direction when a matter exceeds current experience.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and ability to handle confidential and sensitive information.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and identify trends.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interpret and apply complex regulatory requirements.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to maintaining high ethical standards.
  • Practical legal judgment.
  • Transactional drafting and negotiation.
  • Regulatory and compliance awareness.
  • Discretion and professionalism.
  • Process improvement mindset.

National Debt Relief Role Qualifications:

  • Computer competency and ability to work with a computer.
  • Prioritize multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Punctuality expected, ready to report to work on a consistent basis.
  • Attain and maintain high performance expectations on a monthly basis.
  • Work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting.
  • Use and navigate multiple computer systems with exceptional multi-tasking skills.
  • Remain calm and professional during difficult discussions.
  • Take constructive feedback.
  • Available for full-time position.

Compensation Information

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for each position across the US. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This good faith pay range is provided in compliance with NYC law and the laws of other jurisdictions that may require a salary range in job postings. The salary for this position is $106,500.00 to $117,500.00

About National Debt Relief

National Debt Relief was founded in 2009 with the goal of helping an expanding number of consumers deal with overwhelming debt. We are one of the most-trusted and best-rated consumer debt relief providers in the United States. As a leading debt settlement organization, we have helped over 450,000 people settle over $10 billion of debt, while empowering them to lead a healthier financial lifestyle and feel free to live their best life. At National Debt Relief, we treat our clients like real people. Our purpose is to elevate, empower, and transform their lives.

Rated A+ by the Better Business Bureau, our goal is to help individuals and families get out of debt with the least possible cost through conducting financial consultations, educating the consumer and recommending the appropriate solution. We become our clients' number one advocate to help them reestablish financial stability as quickly as possible.

Benefits

National Debt Relief is a team-oriented environment full of rewards and growth opportunities for our employees. We are dedicated to our employee's success and growth within the company, through our employee mentorship and leadership programs.
